### [1] [CORAL-KV: Compact Cross-Layer Prediction and Residual Coding for Autoregressive Video KV Caches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12514)
*Albert Ge,Akash Haridas,Utkarsh Saxena,Ruijing Yang,Ian Colbert,Frederic Sala,Vikram Appia,Emad Barsoum*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Coral-KV是一种KV缓存压缩框架，利用视频模型中跨层缓存依赖进行预测并量化残差，以更低内存实现更高重建保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型需维护不断增长的注意力KV缓存，内存成为长视频生成的瓶颈。现有基于聚类的量化方法仅利用层内相似性，且后续帧关注压缩历史时重建误差会随视频增长而累积。

Method: Coral-KV（Calibrated Offline, Residual-coded, Adapted Locally）利用每层缓存状态预测后续层的键和值，再量化预测残差。构建紧凑的块对角加低秩（block-DPLR）预测器：块对角分量建模各注意力头内的通道关系，全局低秩项建模头间依赖。支持跨视频复用预测器或针对当前视频重拟合轻量块对角预测器，提供灵活的保真度-内存权衡。

Result: 在HY-WorldPlay和MAGI-1上，可复用配置相比QVG-4分别提升PSNR 0.32 dB和4.95 dB，同时缓存内存减少48%和37%。相比QVG-Pro，视频自适应配置在MAGI-1上提升PSNR 3.77 dB，缓存内存减少33.7%。Coral-KV在延长生成时保持更高重建保真度，减少时间不连续性，且生成延迟相当。

Conclusion: Coral-KV通过挖掘跨层缓存依赖并量化预测残差，在显著降低KV缓存内存的同时提升重建质量与长视频稳定性，且不牺牲生成延迟。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models maintain a growing attention key-value (KV) cache, making memory a key bottleneck for long video generation. Recently, clustering-based quantization has emerged as an effective method to compress video KV caches by grouping similar key and value vectors then quantizing residual errors. However, when later frames attend to the compressed history, small reconstruction errors can compound as the video grows. Beyond the within-layer similarity exploited by clustering, we find strong dependencies across cache layers in video models. This motivates Coral-KV - Calibrated Offline, Residual-coded, and Adapted Locally - a KV-cache compression framework that uses cache states in each layer to predict keys and values in subsequent layers, then quantizes the remaining prediction residuals. We construct compact block-diagonal-plus-low-rank (block-DPLR) predictors: block-diagonal components model channel relationships within each attention head, while a global low-rank term models dependencies between heads. Coral-KV exposes a flexible fidelity-memory trade-off: it can reuse its predictors across videos or refit lightweight block-diagonal predictors to the current video for higher fidelity. Across extensive evaluations on both HY-WorldPlay and MAGI-1, our reusable configuration improves PSNR over QVG-4 by 0.32 dB and 4.95 dB, respectively, while using 48% and 37% less cache memory. Against QVG-Pro, our video-adapted configuration improves MAGI-1 PSNR by 3.77 dB while using 33.7% less cache memory. Coral-KV also maintains higher reconstruction fidelity over extended generation and reduces temporal discontinuities while retaining comparable generation latency.

</details>


### [2] [TraceICL: Thread-Resolved Demonstration Curation with Consistency Calibration for Robust Multimodal In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12516)
*Yigit Yilmaz,Elena Petrova,Mehmet Kaya,Lucia Rossi,Amir Rahman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AVA是一个免训练的多模态上下文学习框架，通过三个可组合模块解决交错图文示例中的绑定错乱、冗余示例与噪声答案问题，在五个视觉语言基准上平均提升1.7分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冻结的大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在交错多模态上下文学习（ICL）中仍很脆弱：示例与图像绑定错误、冗余示例挤占有效信息、噪声答案被逐字复制到预测中。现有方法缺乏对这些问题的系统性组织与校正。

Method: 提出免训练框架AVA，将多模态ICL的示例流程组织为三个可组合阶段：(1) Thread-Resolved Decomposer (TRD)，将交错上下文切分为逐样本线程并以显式边界重接，恢复图文绑定；(2) Influence-scored Demonstration Selector (IDS)，用一次额外前向估计候选示例的边际影响，去冗余并按价值降序排列；(3) Weak-to-Strong Consistency Calibration (WSC)，以弱兄弟模型的重建置信度打分并在解码时对示例贡献软重加权。全程不计算梯度，LVLM保持冻结。

Result: 在五个视觉语言基准的交错4-shot设置下，AVA相比最强同设定基线平均提升+1.7分，VizWiz上最高提升+2.4分；缩小了ScienceQA-IMG上需视觉能力的性能差距；在30%噪声示例下仍保留大部分增益；延迟开销26%，可由离线缓存摊销。

Conclusion: AVA以纯推理期、免训练的方式系统性地提升了多模态ICL的鲁棒性与准确性，噪声容忍度高且开销可控，为冻结LVLM的高效适配提供了可组合的实用方案。

Abstract: Interleaved multimodal in-context learning (ICL) lets frozen large vision-language models (LVLMs) acquire new tasks from a handful of image-text-answer demonstrations, yet it remains fragile: demonstrations bind to the wrong images, redundant exemplars crowd out informative ones, and noisy answers are copied verbatim into predictions. We present AVA, a training-free framework that organizes the demonstration pipeline of multimodal ICL into three composable stages. A Thread-Resolved Decomposer (TRD) segments the interleaved context into per-sample threads and re-stitches them with explicit boundaries, restoring image-text binding. An Influence-scored Demonstration Selector (IDS) estimates each candidate's marginal influence with one extra forward pass, removes redundancy, and orders the survivors by descending value. A Weak-to-Strong Consistency Calibration (WSC) module scores each demonstration by a weak sibling model's reconstruction confidence and softly reweights its contribution during decoding. On five vision-language benchmarks with interleaved 4-shot prompts, AVA improves the strongest same-setting baseline by +1.7 points on average, with gains of up to +2.4 points on VizWiz, shrinks the require-visual performance gap on ScienceQA-IMG, and retains most of its gain under 30% noisy demonstrations, at a 26% latency overhead that an offline cache amortizes. No gradients are ever computed; the LVLM stays frozen.

</details>


### [3] [TerraAgent: Demonstration-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Long-Context Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12517)
*Jingwen Huang,Yiming Fang,Hanxiao Wu,Boyuan He,Keyi Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架AVA，将冻结的遥感多模态大模型封装为检索、分解与反事实审计三模块，提升视觉依赖性并降低先验作答与幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前RS-VQA主要用准确率评估，无法判断正确答案是否真正依赖图像证据，模型可能仅凭语言先验作答而不看图。

Method: AVA为免训练框架，包含GDR（按GSD分桶、基于场景图的示例检索并过滤答案无图像支撑的示例）、MACE（将查询分解为分类型子问题DAG，路由至感知工具并记录证据账本，带有限重感知）、CVA（对引用证据做消融与替换等反事实扰动审计，计算视觉依赖性分数用于置信度校准与强制重查询）。

Result: 在RSVQA-LR/HR、VRSBench、LHRS-Bench上，准确率较最强同条件基线最高提升2.40分；视觉依赖性分数由0.28升至0.49；纯先验作答率由46.2%降至21.7%；幻觉率由17.1%降至9.8%；成本约为单次骨干网络前向的2.6倍，且无需微调。

Conclusion: AVA证明免训练、证据导向的检索-推理-审计框架能同时提升RS-VQA准确率与视觉证据依赖性，抑制先验作答和幻觉。

Abstract: Remote sensing visual question answering (RS-VQA) requires answers that truly depend on image evidence, yet current remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS MLLMs) are still evaluated mainly by accuracy, which cannot reveal whether a correct answer was produced without using the image. This setting introduces three challenges: demonstrations retrieved across different ground sample distances (GSD), sensors, and city textures may be poorly matched; real queries often involve long visual contexts from multi-scale tiles, multi-temporal frames, and retrieved knowledge, where evidence can be diluted and errors can propagate through multi-step reasoning; and prior-only answering remains invisible to standard metrics. We present AVA, a training-free framework that wraps a frozen RS MLLM with three modules. GDR performs GSD-bucketed, scene-graph-based demonstration retrieval and filters demonstrations whose answers are unsupported by their images. MACE decomposes each query into an evidence-typed sub-question DAG, routes sub-questions to suitable perception tools, and records verified provenance in a shared evidence ledger with bounded re-perception. CVA audits the final answer through counterfactual perturbations of cited evidence, including ablation and swap, and computes a visual-dependency score for confidence calibration and evidence-forcing re-query. On RSVQA-LR/HR, VRSBench, and LHRS-Bench, AVA improves average accuracy by up to 2.40 points over the strongest same-setting baselines, raises the visual-dependency score from 0.28 to 0.49, reduces the prior-only answer rate from 46.2 percent to 21.7 percent, and lowers the hallucination rate from 17.1 percent to 9.8 percent, with 2.6x the cost of a single backbone forward pass and no fine-tuning.

</details>


### [4] [MIRAGE: Metric Inference and Reliability-Aware Gaussian Estimation from Feed-Forward Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12568)
*Xinzhe Wang,Changjian Jiang,Kaiwen Song,Xudong Li,Kerui Ren,Ran Yi,Lizhuang Ma,Chunhua Shen,Linning Xu,Tao Lu,Mulin Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 MIRAGE，将前馈视觉几何先验锚定到 LiDAR-IMU 度量运动，并按对应支持度与跨模态一致性对在线位姿修正进行调节，从而同时实现度量准确的位姿估计与高质量高斯重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈 3D 先验可从图像流高质量重建，但缺乏可靠度量尺度且存在长期轨迹漂移；LiDAR-惯性估计度量准确却缺乏图像空间一致性，难以支持高保真重建。二者互补，故需融合以兼顾度量精度与重建质量，并弥补长时序大规模室内重建基准的稀缺。

Method: MIRAGE 以前馈视觉几何为图像空间先验，将其锚定到 LiDAR-IMU 的度量运动；依据对应支持度（correspondence support）与跨模态一致性（cross-modal agreement）在线调节位姿修正，并耦合成高斯（Gaussian）重建。此外搭建多模态数据采集平台，为新的纯视觉基准生成准确 6-DoF 参考轨迹。

Result: 在 Oxford Spires、M2DGR 与 INS 数据集上，MIRAGE 实现了准确的度量轨迹估计，性能超过计算代价高昂、常被用作纯视觉基准参考的 COLMAP。在自建的长时序大规模室内数据上，对近期单目大规模重建方法进行了系统性评测。

Conclusion: 通过将前馈视觉几何与 LiDAR-IMU 度量运动融合并一致性调节，MIRAGE 兼顾度量位姿估计与高保真高斯重建；所建平台与基准为长时序室内单目重建提供了系统评估依据，弥补了现有基准的不足。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D priors enable high-quality reconstruction from image streams but often lack reliable metric scale and suffer from long-term trajectory drift. In contrast, LiDAR--inertial estimation provides metrically accurate motion but lacks the image-space consistency needed for high-fidelity reconstruction. We propose $MIRAGE$, which anchors feed-forward visual geometry to LiDAR--IMU metric motion and regulates online pose corrections according to correspondence support and cross-modal agreement, jointly enabling accurate metric pose estimation and high-fidelity Gaussian reconstruction. Experiments on Oxford Spires, M2DGR and INS show that MIRAGE achieves accurate metric trajectory estimation, outperforming COLMAP, a widely used but computationally expensive reference for vision-only benchmarks. Motivated by the scarcity of long-horizon monocular benchmarks for large-scale indoor reconstruction, we further build a multimodal data-collection platform and use MIRAGE to establish accurate 6-DoF reference trajectories for a new vision-only benchmark. We benchmark recent monocular large-scale reconstruction methods on this dataset, providing a systematic evaluation of their performance in long-horizon indoor scenes.

</details>


### [5] [Scaling Multi-Teacher Distillation for Digital Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12574)
*Sofiène Boutaj,Pierre Marza,Varun Belagali,Dimitris Samaras,Maria Vakalopoulou,Stergios Christodoulidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出改进的多教师蒸馏（MTD）方法，通过让学生学习教师特定表示（learnable teacher tokens、定制注意力、MoE层与对比损失），解决了传统MTD随教师数量增加而性能下降的问题，并发布了高效的基础模型系列OMNI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多教师蒸馏可从多个"教师"网络向单个"学生"网络迁移知识，在数字病理等领域很有前景（近年出现许多强大的基础模型）。但作者发现：标准多教师蒸馏方法在增加教师数量时性能反而变差，如何随教师数量扩展是关键问题。

Method: 作者指出学习"教师特定表示"是MTD可扩展的关键，并提出多项设计：可学习的教师token（learnable teacher tokens）、定制的注意力机制（tailored attention scheme）、额外的混合专家层（mixture-of-experts layers）以及对比损失（contrastive loss），以更好地学习教师特定表示。

Result: 所提方法在教师数量增加时扩展性更好，可训练紧凑的学生编码器，其效率最高比大型教师基础模型高10倍，同时在大量tile-level和slide-level任务上匹配甚至超越教师性能。作者在39个任务、10个以上基础模型上进行了充分验证，并发布了由10个SOTA基础模型知识训练的高效基础模型集合OMNI。

Conclusion: 作者对学到的教师特定表示进行了分析，揭示了它们之间的互补性，并解释了为何这些表示能够在下游阶段被轻松聚合。最终发布了高效且强大的OMNI基础模型集合。

Abstract: Multi-teacher distillation allows transferring knowledge from multiple "teacher" networks to a single "student" network. This method is promising in fields such as digital pathology, where many powerful foundation models were proposed recently. However, as we show in this paper, the standard multi-teacher distillation approach reacts poorly to an increase in the number of teachers used to train a student encoder. We demonstrate that learning teacher-specific representations is a key to scaling in MTD. Importantly, different design choices, such as learnable teacher tokens, a tailored attention scheme, additional mixture-of-experts layers and a contrastive loss, are proposed to better learn such teacher-specific representations. We show that our method better scales with respect to the number of considered teachers, allowing us to train compact student encoders, up to 10x more efficient than larger teacher foundation models, while matching their performance and even outperforming them on a large set of tile-level and slide-level tasks. We conduct a thorough empirical validation, evaluating more than 10 foundation models on 39 tasks spanning tile and slide levels. As a result, we release a new collection of strong and efficient foundation models, named OMNI, trained from the knowledge of 10 state-of-the-art foundation models. We finally conduct an analysis of the learned teacher-specific representations, highlighting their complementarity and explaining why they can be easily aggregated at downstream time.

</details>


### [6] [Mind the Temporal Gap: Evaluating Video Models for Temporal Understanding in Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12575)
*Shiva Sreeram,Erfan Aasi,Tsun-Hsuan Wang,Alaa Maalouf,Daniela Rus*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过受控的自车运动任务，检验视频-语言模型在驾驶场景中的时序推理可靠性，发现各类提示方法均不可靠，而LoRA微调与中间视觉特征探针能恢复强运动判别性能，表明运动线索存在于模型内部但未被视频到语言的最终通路有效利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频-语言模型日益被视为通用视频推理器，但其在驾驶等安全关键场景中是否能稳健捕捉时序动态尚不明确，因此需要在受控条件下系统检验其时间推理的可靠性。

Method: 设计受控的自车运动（ego-motion）任务，要求从驾驶视频中识别动作；在多个视频-语言模型上系统评估标准提示、视觉提示、少样本提示与思维链提示；并对比轻量LoRA微调与基于中间视觉特征训练的简单探针。

Result: 标准、视觉、少样本与思维链提示均表现不可靠，高度依赖任务与模型，且存在持续的类别偏差，尽管较新模型在特定任务上取得显著少样本提升；相较之下，LoRA微调与简单探针在运动判别上取得强性能。

Conclusion: 在驾驶场景中，现有多模态大模型仍是不可靠的时序推理器，更接近帧级、偏差驱动的识别器，而非可信的时序世界模型；运动相关线索虽已存在于模型内部，却未被最终的视频到语言通路可靠利用。

Abstract: Modern video-language models are increasingly treated as general-purpose video reasoners, yet it remains unclear whether they robustly capture temporal dynamics in safety-critical settings such as driving. We study this question through controlled ego-motion tasks that require identifying actions from driving videos. Across video-language models, we find that standard prompting, visual prompting, few-shot prompting, and chain-of-thought prompting remain unreliable and highly task- and model-dependent, with persistent class biases, although newer models show substantial task-specific few-shot gains. In contrast, lightweight LoRA finetuning and simple probes trained on intermediate visual features recover strong motion-discriminative performance, indicating that motion-relevant cues are often present inside the models but are not reliably used by the final video-to-language pathway. These results suggest that, in driving, current video-language models remain unreliable temporal reasoners and often behave more like frame-level, bias-driven recognizers than dependable temporal world models.

</details>


### [7] [MemReg: Streaming Outdoor LiDAR Point Cloud Registration with Hybrid Memory Buffers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12624)
*Jiuming Liu,Mengmeng Liu,Guangming Wang,Lihao Liu,Michael Ying Yang,Yunpeng Zhang,Francesco Nex,Hao Cheng,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MemReg，一种带姿态相关记忆缓冲的多帧室外LiDAR点云配准网络，利用流式序列的长期时序上下文提升配准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有室外LiDAR配准方法多受限于成对（pair-wise）输入范式，忽略了流式序列中固有的时序相关性；而长期时序序列可提供丰富的全局上下文信息，用于补全稀疏测量、滤除离群点并缓解低重叠问题。

Method: 设计两种混合记忆缓冲：隐式记忆特征缓冲与显式记忆姿态缓冲，用于存储并动态更新姿态相关的时序特征；并提出动态历史加权模块，自适应融合当前与历史姿态相关特征。

Result: 在KITTI、nuScenes、Apollo-Southbay三个室外数据集上达到SOTA，超越所有先前成对方法及多帧SLAM系统；在3DMatch、3DLoMatch、ScanNet等室内多视图配准场景中也表现出较强泛化能力与竞争力。

Conclusion: 多帧流式建模结合姿态相关记忆机制可有效利用时序上下文，显著提升室外LiDAR配准性能并具备跨场景泛化性。代码将开源。

Abstract: Prior outdoor LiDAR registration works are commonly limited by the pair-wise input paradigm, which neglects temporal correlations inherent within streaming sequences. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-frame outdoor point cloud registration network for streaming LiDAR scans enhanced with pose-related memory buffers. The key observation is that long-term temporal LiDAR sequences can provide rich global contextual information to complete sparse measurements, filter outliers, and address low-overlap problems, thereby boosting registration performance. Specifically, two hybrid memory buffers are designed, including an implicit memory feature buffer and an explicit memory pose buffer, to store and dynamically update pose-related temporal features. Moreover, a novel dynamic history weighting module is developed to adaptively fuse current and history pose-related features. Extensive experiments on three outdoor datasets, including KITTI, nuScenes, and Apollo-Southbay, demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of MemReg, surpassing all previous pair-wise methods and also multi-frame SLAM systems. Our method also generalizes surprisingly well to multiview indoor registration scenarios with rather competitive performance on 3DMatch, 3DLoMatch, and ScanNet. Code will be released at https://github.com/IRMVLab/MemReg.

</details>


### [8] [ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12625)
*Zekai Gu,Peng Wang,Jiahao Lu,Yongsen Mao,Cheng Lin,Yuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种在自回归视频扩散模型中按图像块动态分配去噪步数的框架，简单块提前停止、困难块多步细化，在保持视觉质量的同时将总去噪步数减少约50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型在生成下一视频块时对整个空间采用统一的计算预算，即所有patch共享相同的去噪调度与函数评估次数。这忽视了视频内容的空间异质性：静态、简单或重复区域更易去噪，而其他区域仍需进一步细化或补充上下文。统一预算导致简单patch上冗余计算，而直接降低固定步数又会使困难patch细化不足。

Method: 提出一种通用框架，对单个patch动态分配去噪步数：简单patch提前停止以提升效率，困难patch获得更多细化步数。该方法兼容大多数现有少步自回归扩散模型，仅需一个轻量级路由模块和适度的训练。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在将视频patch上总去噪步数减少约50%的同时，保持与四步基线相当的视觉质量。

Conclusion: 通过空间自适应的逐patch去噪步数分配，可在几乎不损失生成质量的前提下显著加速自回归视频扩散模型的生成。

Our results reveal distinct attention dynamics: CNNs tend to exhibit a more global focus, with spatially more diffuse saliency maps that correlate well with human perception in general contexts, while ViTs demonstrate fine-grained, patch-level attention, often focused on discriminative microfeatures. The Mamba architecture shows biased behavior: it achieves strong explainability in medical tasks but exhibits divergent intensity distributions in natural images; our analytical characterization of the metrics makes this dissociation explicit, since near-unit support overlap is attained simultaneously with a vanishing linear correlation. ### [14] [Shift-Aware Identity-Guided Latent Refinement for Referring Audio--Visual Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12783)

TL;DR: 本文提出SAIL（Shift-Aware Identity-guided Latent）细化框架，通过双token策略解耦帧级动态与全局语义锚点，并结合移位感知细化模块与连续记忆更新的解码器，解决Ref-AVS任务中的目标漂移问题，在两个基准上显著超越现有方法。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Ref-AVS需基于视觉与听觉线索，依据自然语言表达精确识别并分割特定目标，涉及视觉-音频-语言的细粒度三模态交互。现有方法在遭遇目标漂移（transient occlusions、声学衰减、身份歧义导致的焦点错误转移）时难以保持一致性。

Abstract: Referring Audio--Visual Segmentation (Ref-AVS) is an emergent multimodal task requiring the precise identification and segmentation of a specific object based on a natural language expression grounded in both visual and auditory cues. Unlike traditional AVS, which segments generic sound sources, or referring video object segmentation (Ref-VOS), which relies solely on visual--textual grounding, Ref-AVS necessitates fine-grained tri-modal interaction across vision, audio, and language. However, existing methods often fail to maintain consistency when subjected to target shift, a phenomenon where the model erroneously transfers its focus between objects due to transient occlusions, acoustic fading, or identity ambiguities. To address this, we propose a novel Shift-Aware Identity-guided Latent (SAIL) refinement framework. It introduces a dual-token strategy that decouples frame-level dynamics from a global semantic anchor to explicitly model target-shift cues. We design a shift-aware refinement module that rectifies drift by aligning tokens with domain-specific evidence. Finally, we leverage a decoder that integrates the refined embeddings with a continuous memory update to maintain spatio-temporal coherence and identity consistency throughout the video sequence. Extensive experiments conducted on two Ref-AVS benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method, significantly outperforming existing AVS, Ref-VOS, and Ref-AVS approaches. The code will be released after publication.

</details>

Abstract: 3D reconstruction of building components using image-based scanning requires appropriate segmentation of the objects in the 2D building images. This advances the application of Group Anything with Radiance Fields (GARField) in 3D, enabling better segmentation of building structures for 3D auto-reconstruction.

### [16] [Spend Where It Matters: Particle Search with MH Refinement for Budget-Constrained Audio-Visual Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12811)
*Shivanshu Shekhar,Raghavendra Addanki,Tong Zhang,Uttaran Bhattacharya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Spend Where It Matters (SWIM)，一种两阶段、免训练、奖励无关的推理时对齐框架，在固定计算预算下结合粒子搜索与 Metropolis-Hastings 精炼，自适应地在去噪检查点分配粒子，从而提升联合音视频生成的奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励引导的推理时对齐可改善联合音视频生成，但多目标优化需要大量昂贵的模型评估，现有方法在有限算力下成本过高。粒子搜索具备全局探索能力，却因有限种群带来估计误差；Metropolis-Hastings (MH) 能局部精炼候选，但依赖良好的初始化。

Method: 提出 SWIM：第一阶段利用在线方差估计，在去噪检查点间自适应分配粒子，以最小化估计方差并将算力集中在最有用处；第二阶段以该搜索得到的优质候选初始化 MH，在完整输出上使用局部 noise-and-denoise 提议进一步提升奖励。整个框架免训练、奖励无关，且在固定计算预算下运行。

Result: 在匹配算力下，粒子搜索与 MH 精炼结合优于任一单独方法。在 JavisBench-Mini 上，与 JavisDiT++ 配合时，相对 BoN 平均七项指标提升 30.7%、相对 EvoSearch 提升 14.1%；与 LTX-2 配合时相对 BoN 提升 9.2%、相对 EvoSearch 提升 17.0%。在 SD1.5 图像生成上，自适应粒子分配相比均匀分配使 AestheticScore 提升 2.2%、ImageReward 提升 6.0%。

Conclusion: SWIM 通过将粒子搜索的全局探索与 MH 的局部精炼在固定算力预算下有机结合，自适应分配计算资源，显著提升联合音视频生成的奖励表现，并可推广至图像生成任务。

Abstract: Reward-guided inference-time alignment can improve joint audio-visual generation, but optimizing multiple alignment objectives requires many expensive model evaluations, making existing methods costly under limited compute. Particle-based search enables global exploration but incurs estimation error with a finite population, while Metropolis-Hastings (MH) can refine candidates locally but benefits from a strong initialization. We introduce \textbf{S}pend \textbf{W}here \textbf{I}t \textbf{M}atters (\modelname), a two-stage, training-free, reward-agnostic framework that combines particle search with MH refinement under a fixed compute budget. In the first stage, we adaptively allocate particles across denoising checkpoints using online variance estimates, minimizing estimation variance while concentrating compute where it is most useful. This search provides a promising candidate for MH refinement, which uses local noise-and-denoise proposals on completed outputs to further improve reward. By starting from a strong candidate, MH can recover additional reward without requiring a larger particle population or costly global exploration. We show that, at matched compute, combining particle search with MH refinement achieves higher rewards than either approach alone. On \textsc{JavisBench-Mini}, at closely matched compute, \modelname achieves mean relative gains across seven metrics of $30.7\%$ over BoN and $14.1\%$ over EvoSearch with JavisDiT++, and $9.2\%$ over BoN and $17.0\%$ over EvoSearch with LTX-2. Beyond joint audio-visual generation, we also demonstrate the benefits of adaptive particle allocation on SD1.5 image generation, improving AestheticScore by $2.2\%$ and ImageReward by $6.0\%$ over uniform allocation.

</details>

*Chun Liu,Yuxin Wang,Zhenxiang Huo,Linlin Zhu,Tao Xu,Henggang Han*

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机热成像与卫星影像在颜色、亮度和视角上存在显著跨模态差异，导致传统基于外观的匹配方法难以建立可靠对应关系。现有方法主要处理全局模态偏移，却忽视了热成像与卫星视图之间固有的共享场景结构。

Method: SAMF框架包含两个模块：方向结构增强模块（DSEM）通过捕捉方向性和低频空间模式来强化稳健的结构表征；模态感知仿射重映射模块（MARM）对增强后的特征施加仿射校正，进一步促进跨模态对齐。此外，作者基于Thermal-UAV数据集构建了Thermal-UAV-Paired基准。

Conclusion: SAMF通过显式利用跨模态稳定的结构线索，有效提升了无人机热成像地理定位性能，代码与数据集已开源。

Abstract: UAV thermal-to-satellite geo-localization localizes UAVs by matching real-time thermal images against georeferenced satellite images, enabling autonomous navigation in GNSS-denied and low-visibility conditions. However, substantial cross-modal disparities in color, brightness and viewpoint hinder conventional appearance-based methods from establishing reliable correspondences. While existing approaches predominantly address global modality shifts, they overlook the invariant scene structures inherently shared between thermal and satellite views. To bridge this gap, we propose SAMF, a Structure-Aware Matching Framework that explicitly exploits stable cross-modal structural cues to improve UAV thermal geolocalization. Specifically, the Directional Structure Enhancement Module (DSEM) strengthens robust structural representations by capturing directional and low-frequency spatial patterns, and the Modality-Aware Affine Remapping Module (MARM) subsequently applies affine correction to these enhanced features, further promoting cross-modal alignment. Additionally, we introduce the Thermal-UAV-Paired benchmark derived from the Thermal-UAV dataset. Extensive experiments on both the Boson-nighttime and Thermal-UAV-Paired datasets show that SAMF achieves state-of-the-art performance. </details>


### [18] [APEX: Asynchronous Prefix Denoising for Extreme Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12843)
*David Dinkevich,Nisan Chiprut,Yoav HaCohen,Dani Lischinski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: APEX 将分层潜空间与按通道分组的异步去噪结合，在极端压缩（64x/128x）下缓解重建-生成两难，性能优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 减少潜 token 数量可降低扩散模型成本，但激进压缩会产生"重建-生成两难"：增加通道数能提升重建质量，却使生成（去噪）变得更困难。

Method: 提出 APEX（Asynchronous Prefix denoising for EXtreme compression）：一是自编码器将通道前缀按"结构到细节"排序，构建分层潜空间；二是使用单个共享去噪器，在不同"局部时间"上对通道组进行交错（异步）去噪，且不增加 token 数量。

Result: 在 ImageNet-512 上，APEX 在 64x 与 128x 压缩下、所有评估的通道数配置中均优于现有方法；在训练与引导采样计算量匹配的条件下，于每个评估预算下均优于 256-token 模型，且在计算量越低时增益越大。

Conclusion: 通过分层潜空间与异步前缀去噪的协同设计，APEX 在极端压缩下同时改善重建与生成，验证了通道分组异步去噪作为高效扩散生成范式的有效性。

Abstract: Fewer latent tokens promise cheaper diffusion. Yet aggressive latent compression creates a reconstruction-generation dilemma: adding channels improves reconstruction but makes generation harder. We introduce APEX, short for Asynchronous Prefix denoising for EXtreme compression, which pairs a hierarchical latent space with asynchronous denoising over channel groups. Our autoencoder orders channel prefixes from structure to detail, while one shared denoiser generates them at staggered local times without adding tokens. On ImageNet-512, APEX outperforms existing methods at every evaluated channel count under 64x and 128x compression. At matched training and guided sampling compute, it also outperforms a 256-token model at every evaluated budget, with larger gains at lower compute. Code is available at https://daviddinkevich.github.io/APEX.

</details>


### [19] [CaptchaAgent: Verifiable Visual Reasoning for CAPTCHA Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12866)
*Shangquan Sun,Ruoyu Chen,Zhirui Liu,Xiang Liu,Chenghao Qian,Wenqi Ren,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CaptchaAgent 结构化视觉推理框架，通过视觉中间表示、ASCII 协议、局部证据精炼与反事实一致性校验，显著提升交互式验证码求解的 Pass@1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代推理型验证码要求细粒度感知、组合关系推理与基于浏览器的交互落地，端到端视觉语言模型智能体在此场景下十分脆弱——漏检物体、计数错误或关系混淆会直接传播到最终动作。因此需要一种显式、可校验的结构化推理方式来抑制误差累积。

Method: 1) 先构建视觉中间表示（V-IR），显式记录实体、属性及空间/拓扑关系，而非从截图直接预测动作；2) 采用仅含符号的 ASCII 协议，强制解析器对具体对象集合与数量作出明确承诺；3) 在该全局表示基础上进行局部证据精炼，以更高有效分辨率复核歧义区域；4) 引入反事实一致性校验，检验所得动作在保任务变换下是否仍稳定。

Result: 在 Open CaptchaWorld 上，使用三个专有骨干模型时，CaptchaAgent 相比商用浏览器智能体基线在同一骨干下将 Pass@1 提升 21.3–25.8 个百分点；在离线 Oedipus-data 基准上，三个匹配骨干下平均 Pass@1 相比 Oedipus 求解器提升 9.2–12.3 个百分点。

Conclusion: 中间推理轨迹表明，精确计数、连续几何与有序执行仍是所评估智能体自动化的主要难点，这为设计更具鲁棒性的组合式验证码提供了实践指导；结构化中间表示与一致性校验可有效缓解组合推理中的误差传播。

Abstract: Modern reasoning CAPTCHAs require fine-grained perception, compositional relation reasoning, and grounded browser interaction. End-to-end vision-language model agents remain brittle in this setting because a missed object, incorrect count, or confused relation can propagate directly to the final action. To address this problem, we present CaptchaAgent, a structured visual reasoning framework for interactive CAPTCHA solving. Instead of predicting an action directly from a screenshot, CaptchaAgent first constructs a visual intermediate representation (V-IR) that explicitly records entities, attributes, and spatial or topological relations. A symbol-only ASCII protocol further requires the parser to commit to a concrete object set and count. Building on this global representation, localized evidence refinement revisits ambiguous regions at higher effective resolution, while counterfactual consistency verification tests whether the resulting action remains stable under task-preserving transformations. Across three proprietary backbones on Open CaptchaWorld, CaptchaAgent improves Pass@1 by 21.3-25.8 percentage points over a commercially available browser agent baseline evaluated with the same backbones. On the separate offline Oedipus-data benchmark, it further improves average Pass@1 by 9.2-12.3 percentage points over the Oedipus solver across three matched backbones. The intermediate traces show that exact counting, continuous geometry, and ordered execution remain major sources of automation difficulty for the evaluated agents, providing practical guidance for designing more resilient compositional CAPTCHAs.

</details>


### [20] [Selective Spatio-Temporal Fruit Inspector (S$^2$FI): A Mamba-based Framework for Rotational Fruit Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12868)
*Hao Tian,Jie Hu,Guoqi Shan,Fan Wang,Wenzhuo Zhang,Youshan Zhang*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球果蔬产业中，中小规模种植户面临采后分拣难题：大型智能分拣系统成本过高，人工分拣效率低、标准不一致、劳动需求大。研究旨在填补昂贵设备与低效人工之间的空白。

Method: 提出Selective Spatio-Temporal Fruit Inspector（S²FI）架构，融合3D卷积编码器与基于Mamba的主干网络：高效提取时空特征、在果实旋转过程中自适应加权信息帧、以线性复杂度建模长程依赖，从而减少运动模糊与遮挡影响。硬件采用双传送带与弧形轨道设计，支持家用电源、快速部署及轻量级嵌入式部署以提升经济性；并构建了含6,460个样本的传送带式水果质量视频数据集。

Result: 在留出测试集上，该方法在精度、效率与实用性之间取得最佳权衡，性能优于所对比的基线方法，实现了适用于真实分拣场景的精度、速度与实用性良好平衡。

Conclusion: 所提低成本、高效、轻量的深度学习分拣系统可有效服务于中小种植户，兼具精度、速度与实用性优势，为实际果蔬分拣提供可行方案。

Abstract: The global fruit and vegetable industry confronts severe post-harvest sorting challenges for small and medium-scale growers. Large intelligent sorting systems are too costly, while manual sorting suffers from low efficiency, inconsistent standards, and high labor demand. To bridge this gap between expensive equipment and inefficient manual work, this study develops a low-cost, high-efficiency, lightweight fruit sorting system driven by deep learning, suitable for small and medium growers. We propose the Selective Spatio-Temporal Fruit Inspector (S$^2$FI) architecture, which combines a 3D convolutional encoder with a Mamba-based backbone.It efficiently extracts spatiotemporal features, adaptively weighs informative frames during fruit rotation, and models long-range dependencies with linear complexity, reducing motion blur and occlusion. The hardware uses a dual-conveyor and curved rail design, supporting household power, fast deployment, and lightweight embedded deployment to improve affordability. We also built a conveyor-based fruit quality video dataset with 6,460 samples. Experiments on the held-out test set show that our method achieves the best trade-off among accuracy, efficiency, and practicality, outperforming the compared baselines on the test set, achieving an excellent balance of accuracy, speed, and practicality for real-world sorting.

</details>


### [21] [ROSETTA: Rotation Subspace Estimation for Training-free Transmodal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12871)
*Alex Junho Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练校准层ROSETTA，通过EM估计白化特征空间中编码器之间的局部旋转，实现跨模态/设备/表示/主干的对齐，查询开销为毫秒级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当查询需与使用不同传感器构建或由不同编码器处理的数据库匹配时，独立训练的编码器在特征空间上施加了各自的坐标系；不存在可对齐所有编码器的规范参考系，且尚无单一训练流程完全弥合这一差距。

Method: 作者首先刻画编码器间相对变换：在白化特征空间中其为空间保持的旋转，其角速度呈白噪声特性（范数大、时间不相关、无法由特征本身预测）；编码器输出的互协方差具有低有效秩，仅约束少量旋转参数，故局部对齐可行。ROSETTA作为免训练校准层，用期望最大化（EM）过程估计局部旋转，查询时无需共观测量。

Result: 在三个公开驾驶数据集上验证，覆盖LiDAR、相机、热成像与事件模态，在跨模态、跨设备、跨表示、跨主干设置下均有效，每查询开销为毫秒级。

Conclusion: 相对编码器坐标系可由低有效秩互协方差约束的局部旋转刻画，ROSETTA以无监督、免训练方式完成对齐，无需查询时共观测量，具备跨模态跨设备的实用性与毫秒级效率。

Abstract: When a query must be matched against a database built with a different sensor or processed by a different encoder, the independently trained encoders impose distinct coordinate systems on the feature space. No canonical reference frame exists to which all encoders can be aligned, and no single training procedure has fully closed this gap. We show that the relative transformation between any two such systems is a spatially preserving rotation in whitened feature space, whose angular velocity exhibits white-noise characteristics: large in norm, temporally uncorrelated, and unpredictable from the features themselves. However, the cross-covariance between encoder outputs has low effective rank, constraining only a small fraction of the rotation parameters, therefore local alignment is tractable. ROSETTA is a training-free calibration layer that estimates the local rotation via an expectation-maximization procedure, requiring no coobservation at query time. We validate ROSETTA on three public driving datasets spanning LiDAR, camera, thermal, and event modalities in cross-modal, cross-device, cross-representation, and cross-backbone settings, with milliseconds overhead per query.

</details>


### [22] [Win-Win Fusion: Multi-Modal Image Fusion with Visual-Semantic Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12887)
*Hao Zhang,Xuhui Zuo,Jiayi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出W2F，一种面向多模态图像融合的视觉-语义互增强范式，通过分割引导融合损失、嵌入式信息恢复先验、多模态交互注意力机制、视觉与语义融合的耦合协作机制以及梯度校正策略，弥合视觉域与语义域之间的优化鸿沟，兼顾视觉观感与决策精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态图像融合方法在视觉域与语义域之间存在优化鸿沟，导致感知能力提升受限，难以在视觉观感与下游决策精度之间取得协同。

Method: 一、强化视觉-语义协作基础：1）分割引导融合损失，为视觉融合引入目标感知的结构引导；2）嵌入式信息恢复先验，提升退化条件下视觉融合为语义分支提供可靠感知证据的能力。二、构建强多模态信息交互机制：交互式门控混合注意力（IGM-Att）与渐进耦合注意力（PC-Att），从局部与全局视角保证场景表征的完备性。三、构建视觉融合与语义融合的协作机制：采用特征搜索模块从两任务中提取互补关键特征，并以梯度校正策略从优化层面保障协作，通过一致性学习同时提升视觉与语义融合性能。

Conclusion: W2F通过视觉-语义互增强的统一范式，有效缓解了多模态图像融合中视觉与语义域的优化鸿沟，实现了视觉质量与下游任务精度的协同提升。

Abstract: Existing multi-modal image fusion (MMIF) methods generally face an optimization gap between the visual and semantic domains, limiting the enhancement of perception capabilities. To overcome this long-standing barrier, this work proposes W2F, a new visual-semantic mutual reinforcing paradigm for MMIF. First, we reinforce the foundation for visual-semantic collaboration by amplifying feature complementarity through two targeted designs. Specifically, the segmentation-guided fusion loss introduces object-aware structural guidance into visual fusion, while the embedded information restoration prior strengthens the ability of visual fusion to provide reliable perceptual evidence for the semantic branch under degraded conditions. Then, we introduce a strong multi-modal information interaction mechanism composed of interactive gated mixed attention (IGM-Att) and progressive coupling attention (PC-Att). These modules ensure comprehensive scene representation from both local and global perspectives, providing informational support for visual-semantic collaboration. Finally, we construct a collaborative mechanism to couple visual fusion and semantic fusion. It employs a feature search module to extract complementary key features from both tasks, enriching the representational potential of visual and semantic information. Meanwhile, a gradient correction strategy ensures collaboration from the optimization perspective, enhancing performance for both visual and semantic fusion through consistency learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that W2F surpasses state-of-the-art methods in both visual appeal and decision accuracy. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/HaoZhang1018/W2F.

</details>


### [23] [MeshBind: Point-to-Mesh Binding for Non-Rigid Scene Flow Automatic Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12895)
*Yinqi Chen,E Li,Shuaijun Wang,Weiyuan Peng,Meiying Zhang,Qi Hao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MeshBind：利用网格模型为非刚性物体自动生成逐点场景流的标注方法，配套交互式工具SF-Studio与基准SFB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 场景流估计对自动驾驶与机器人应用至关重要，但行人等非刚性物体的场景流真值极难获取，导致非刚性场景流的数据与评测严重不足。

Method: 三项核心技术：1）多视角模块，从六路环视相机重建关节式网格模型并配准到LiDAR坐标系；2）局部绑定技术，通过逐三角形切向-法向标架将点绑定到网格，对刚体运动不变且能适应关节变形；3）三层流配准管线，结合自车运动补偿、包围盒绑定与网格绑定生成全场景逐点流。并实现交互式标注工具SF-Studio支持人工网格修正与自动重算。

Result: 发布SFB（SUScape-Flow Benchmark）大规模基准，基于公开SUScape数据集，覆盖41k帧逐点非刚性行人标注，并提出刚性/半刚性/非刚性评测协议；实验表明在SFB上微调可将三向EPE降低2-3倍，并将非刚性EPE降至与刚性EPE相当的水平。

Conclusion: MeshBind通过网格绑定实现非刚性场景流的自动标注，并提供数据基准与评测协议，有效缩小了非刚性与刚性场景流估计的性能差距。

Abstract: Scene flow estimation is essential for many autonomous driving (AD) and robotic applications, but obtaining ground-truth scene flow for non-rigid objects such as pedestrians is highly difficult. We present MeshBind, an automatic annotation method that uses mesh models to generate per-point scene flow for non-rigid objects. The novelty of this work is threefold: 1) developing a multi-view module that reconstructs an articulated mesh model from six surround cameras and registers it to the LiDAR frame; 2) developing a local-frame binding technique that attaches each point to the mesh via a per-triangle tangent-normal frame, invariant under rigid motion yet adaptive to articulated deformation; 3) developing a three-layer flow registration pipeline that combines ego-vehicle motion compensation, box binding, and mesh binding to produce full-scene per-point flow. We implement MeshBind in SF-Studio, an interactive annotation tool that visualises flow and allows human mesh corrections with automatic recomputation. We also release SFB (SUScape-Flow Benchmark), a large-scale benchmark built on the public SUScape dataset, covering 41k frames with per-point non-rigid pedestrian annotations and a Rigid/Semi-Rigid/Non-Rigid evaluation protocol. Experiments show that fine-tuning on SFB reduces three-way endpoint error (EPE) by 2-3x, and brings non-rigid EPE to the same level as rigid EPE.

</details>


### [24] [AD-SRF: Attack-Defense Semantic Reinforcement for Multi-Modal Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12897)
*Hao Zhang,Zhiqian Zheng,Linfeng Tang,Xinyu Xiang,Jiayi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出攻击-防御语义强化框架AD-SRF，通过解耦并无损重组视觉质量与语义属性的优化，实现多模态图像融合的双赢。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像融合方法难以兼顾视觉质量与语义属性，二者优化目标存在固有冲突。

Method: 1）构建基于Transformer的复原式视觉融合网络作为强视觉基线，配备跨模态检索模块与信息复原-融合协同损失；2）引入攻击-防御博弈机制，攻击者学习损害下游分割的扰动模式，防御者从原始输入恢复缺失语义并通过不可感知语义图重组进融合图像。

Result: 大量实验表明AD-SRF在视觉质量与语义属性上均取得双赢表现，提升下游分割性能且不损害视觉质量。

Conclusion: 通过解耦优化与无损重组，AD-SRF有效缓解视觉质量与语义属性之间的冲突，为多模态图像融合提供新范式。

Abstract: Existing image fusion methods struggle to balance visual quality and semantic attributes due to the inherent conflict between their optimization objectives. To address this challenge, we propose an attack-defense semantic reinforcement framework for multi-modal image fusion, termed AD-SRF. By decoupling the optimization of these two aspects and then losslessly reintegrating them, this framework injects rich semantic attributes into the fused image without compromising its visual quality. First, we develop a transformer-based restorative visual fusion network as a strong visual baseline. Equipped with the cross-modal retrieval module and the information restoration-fusion collaborative loss, it produces highly visible fused images even under degraded conditions. Second, we introduce an attack-defense game mechanism to strengthen the semantic attributes of the fused images. The attacker learns perturbation patterns that impair downstream segmentation, whereas the defender restores missing semantics from the original inputs and reintegrates them into the fused image through an imperceptible semantic map. Through iterative adversarial interaction, this mechanism drives the defender to continually strengthen the fused image's semantic attributes, boosting downstream segmentation performance without compromising visual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AD-SRF achieves a win-win performance in both visual quality and semantic attributes. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/HaoZhang1018/AD-SRF.

</details>

*Yating Gao,Zhenlong Zhu,Wen Zihao,Lenan Zhang,Jiexiong Wang,Yang Yang,Guanjun Jiang,Yixiong Zou,Takuya Maekawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级速度残差校正框架，在不改变冻结6B少步生成器参数、不增加前向次数、保持原有采样计划的前提下，显著提升复杂提示的图像生成指令遵循能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步文本到图像生成器虽能少前向生成高质量图像，但在多主体、交互、空间关系、计数与属性绑定等复杂提示上表现不佳。核心问题是：能否在不改变生成器参数、不增加前向次数的前提下减少这些错误。

Result: 在目标复杂场景分布上，成对指令遵循评估中相对冻结的Z-Image-Turbo取得+17.60个百分点的NetWin，每张图仅增加26.9 ms（0.84%）端到端时延，主干评估次数不增加。

Conclusion: 这是首个对完全冻结少步文本到图像生成器进行轻量速度残差适配、且保持原采样计划与前向次数的框架，以极低的参数与延迟代价有效提升复杂提示的指令遵循。

Abstract: Few-step text-to-image generators produce high-quality images with few network forward passes, yet struggle with complex prompts involving multiple subjects, interactions, spatial relations, counting, and attribute binding. Can these errors be reduced without changing the generator's parameters or increasing its forward-pass count? We propose a lightweight correction framework for a frozen 6B-parameter generator. The generator predicts velocities that determine how its intermediate image representation is updated; a corrector with fewer than 20M parameters learns residual adjustments at selected sampling steps. Because earlier corrections change the states encountered at later steps, our On-Trajectory Flow-Bridge Supervision derives residual targets at the states actually reached during corrected generation. A single corrector is shared across selected steps and runs in parallel with the generator. Only the corrector is trained, requiring neither reward optimization nor re-distillation. To our knowledge, this is the first framework for lightweight velocity-residual adaptation of fully frozen few-step text-to-image generators that preserves their original sampling schedule and forward-pass count. On our target complex-scene distribution, the framework achieves a +17.60-percentage-point NetWin over frozen Z-Image-Turbo in pairwise instruction-following evaluation, with only 26.9 ms (0.84%) additional end-to-end latency per image and no increase in backbone evaluations.

</details>


### [26] [JMT-YOLO: Multi-task Domain Adaptation via Segmentation-Guided Consistency Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12901)
*Zhenhua Yu,Jiahao Zhang,Wenchao Zhang,Ou Ye,Hengxiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出JMT-YOLO联合多任务学习框架，基于Mean Teacher架构引入辅助语义分割任务与掩码机制，缓解细粒度特征退化和实例级对齐不足，在三个域自适应目标检测基准任务上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 域自适应目标检测（DAOD）旨在缓解源域与目标域分布偏移导致的性能下降。现有方法因细粒度特征建模不足、实例级对齐有限，在极端天气、目标遮挡等复杂环境下效果较差，亟需增强前景-背景语义边界建模与实例级特征对齐。

Method: JMT-YOLO基于Mean Teacher架构，引入辅助语义分割任务和掩码机制：1）设计带密集连接结构的多尺度上下文感知分割头，有效捕获局部与全局上下文特征，降低细粒度特征退化；2）对目标域图像施加随机掩码操作构建掩码一致性损失，引导网络学习结构上下文，提升实例级特征对齐。

Result: 在Pascal VOC→Clipart1k、Cityscapes→Foggy Cityscapes、KITTI→Cityscapes三个基准域自适应任务上，检测性能分别达到46.9%、57.3%和61.0%，优于现有最先进方法与基线方法。

Conclusion: JMT-YOLO通过联合多任务学习有效提升复杂环境下的域自适应目标检测性能，验证了其有效性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Domain adaptive object detection (DAOD) aims to reduce performance degradation due to distribution shifts between training (source) and testing (target) datasets. However, owing to insufficient modeling of fine-grained features and limited instance-level alignment, existing approaches become less effective under complex environmental conditions, such as extreme weather conditions and object occlusion. We overcome these challenges by proposing JMT-YOLO, a novel joint multi-task learning framework for DAOD. JMT-YOLO is based on the Mean Teacher architecture. It introduces an auxiliary semantic segmentation task and a masking mechanism to enhance the modeling of foreground-background semantic boundaries in the target domain. Specifically, fine-grained feature degradation is reduced by introducing a multiscale context-aware segmentation head equipped with a dense connection structure to effectively capture local and global contextual features. A mask-consistency loss is formulated by applying random masking operations to target images, thereby guiding the network to learn structural context and improving instance-level feature alignment. Extensive experiments on three benchmark domain adaptation tasks (Pascal VOC to Clipart1k, Cityscapes to Foggy Cityscapes, and KITTI to Cityscapes) demonstrate that JMT-YOLO achieves detection performances of 46.9%, 57.3%, and 61.0%, respectively. These results demonstrate superior performance over existing state-of-the-art and baseline methods, thereby validating the effectiveness and generalization of JMT-YOLO.

</details>


### [27] [BLEND: Balancing Personalization vs. Generalization in Federated Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12907)
*Payam Abdisarabshali,Fardis Nadimi,Kasra Borazjani,Naji Khosravan,Richeng Jin,Seyyedali Hosseinalipour*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BLEND：一种面向联邦视觉语言模型的框架，通过选择性微调与聚合策略（全局视觉/文本适配器+客户端个性化投影适配器）及基于零样本VLM投影头的锚点损失，联合提升个性化与泛化能力，实验一致优于SOTA基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦视觉语言模型（FedVLMs）是新兴方向，目标是在VLM微调流程中融入联邦学习。然而如何在FedVLM中同时兼顾客户端个性化与全局泛化能力仍具挑战，现有方法难以有效平衡二者。

Method: 提出BLEND框架：（1）选择性VLM参数微调与聚合策略，包含跨客户端共享的全局视觉与文本适配器，以及每个客户端专属的个性化视觉投影适配器；（2）新颖损失函数，融合全局适配器与个性化适配器输出以实现个性化，同时借助零样本VLM投影头设计的原则性锚点来促进泛化。代码已开源。

Result: 大量实验表明，BLEND在多种系统设置下持续优于当前最先进的基线方法，展现出在个性化与泛化之间取得有效平衡的能力。

Conclusion: BLEND通过共享全局适配器与客户端个性化适配器的结合及锚点式损失设计，为FedVLM中个性化与泛化的联合优化提供了有效方案，并验证了其优越性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Federated vision-language models (FedVLMs) represent one of the emerging frontiers of machine learning, aiming to integrate federated learning within the fine-tuning pipelines of vision-language models (VLMs). In this work, we introduce BLEND, a new framework designed to jointly enhance the personalization and generalization capabilities of FedVLMs. BLEND proposes a selective VLM parameter fine-tuning and aggregation strategy that consists of (i) global vision and text adapters shared across clients, and (ii) a personalized vision projection adapter tailored to each client. BLEND further introduces a novel loss function that blends the outputs of the global and personalized adapters to achieve personalization, while simultaneously promoting generalization through a principled anchor design implemented via the projection heads of the zero-shot VLM. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BLEND consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting its ability to effectively balance personalization and generalization across diverse system settings. (Code is available at: https://github.com/payamsiabd/BLEND.git)

</details>


### [28] [What Egocentric Video Embeddings Encode and How to Combine Them with Inertial Sensors for Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12926)
*Kansuke Habano*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究头戴式自我中心视频嵌入的语义含义及其与身体惯性传感器的融合方式。发现主流视频模型嵌入的主成分主要由相机朝向决定；惯性信号预测的部分可跨人区分活动，而视频嵌入的其余部分则在同一被试内区分动作组。据此提出在去除主成分的被试内视频图上传播惯性预测，将WEAR数据集被试级宏F1由0.648提升至0.852。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我中心视频与可穿戴惯性传感器常被同时采集，视频通常由预训练模型编码，但相机位于头部时这些嵌入究竟表征什么、应如何与惯性感知结合，此前鲜有关注。作者希望厘清两种模态各自承载的信息及其互补关系，以指导更有效的多模态融合。

Method: 分析VideoMAEv2、CLIP、DINOv2与自我中心模型VC-1的嵌入主方向，用头部朝向（Ego-Exo4D）和场景布局（WEAR）进行回归解释；考察惯性信号可预测部分与视频嵌入残余部分在跨人/被试内的区分能力；提出在移除主导成分的被试内视频图上传播惯性预测（去除时序、每1秒片段随机取一肢体），并与单分类器融合、图加惯性边等方案对比。

Result: 嵌入的领先主方向被相机朝向主导：Ego-Exo4D上头部朝向对自我中心相机可解释R² 0.49–0.70，对非自我中心相机不成立；WEAR上由场景布局解释。惯性信号预测部分可跨人区分活动，视频嵌入残余部分在被试内区分锻炼组。在WEAR上，所提传播方法将被试级交叉验证宏F1从0.648提升至0.852。

Conclusion: 视频与惯性承担不同角色：视频用于找到同一组的片段，惯性分类器负责为其打标签。在去除主导成分的被试内视频图上传播惯性预测最有效，优于单分类器融合或向图添加惯性边。多模态结合应尊重两模态的分离角色，而非简单融合。

Abstract: Egocentric video and body-worn inertial sensors are increasingly recorded together, and the video is usually encoded by pretrained models. What these embeddings represent when the camera sits on the head, and how they should be combined with inertial sensing, has received little attention. Across VideoMAEv2, CLIP, DINOv2 and the egocentric VC-1, the leading principal directions of the embedding are dominated by where the camera looks. Measured head orientation explains them on Ego-Exo4D for egocentric (R^2 0.49-0.70) but not exocentric cameras, and the scene layout explains them on WEAR. The part that the limbs' inertial signals predict separates activities across people. In a set-level probe, the rest separates exercise sets within a participant but not activities across people. This is consistent with separate roles: the video finds the clips of the same set, and the inertial classifier labels them. On WEAR, with temporal order removed and one random limb per one-second clip, we propagate inertial predictions over a within-participant video graph whose leading components are removed. This raises subject-wise cross-validated macro-F1 from 0.648 to 0.852. In our comparisons, propagation helps only over the video graph, and fusing the modalities in one classifier, or adding inertial edges to the graph, performs worse.

</details>


### [29] [UniDeblur: Unified Motion Deblurring via Fourier Convolution Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12941)
*Xintian Mao,Jiansheng Wang,Huaiyuan Wang,Qingli Li,Yan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个基于傅里叶卷积学习的统一运动去模糊框架，并构建多源数据集与数据清洗流程，在域内和域外基准上均取得有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像去模糊方法主要针对单一场景专门化，面对不同相机和图像内容时性能显著下降。这是因为现有网络依赖像素级映射，忽视了模糊的卷积本质，导致网络倾向于拟合图像内容本身而非学习卷积过程，难以处理多源模糊图像。

Method: 1) 构建多源数据集，并设计数据剪枝与质量控制流程；2) 提出统一运动去模糊框架，采用傅里叶卷积学习（Fourier Convolution Learning）；3) 不依赖空间映射，而在傅里叶空间进行模糊自适应的全局滤波器学习，从而避免核估计空间支持受限的问题。

Result: 大量实验表明，该统一模型能有效处理来自不同来源和场景的运动模糊，在域内（in-domain）与域外（OOD）基准上均取得有竞争力的性能。代码将在 github.com/DeepMed-Lab-ECNU/Single-Image-Deblur 发布。

Conclusion: 通过在傅里叶空间学习模糊自适应的全局滤波器，该工作突破了空间核估计的局限，实现了跨场景、跨相机的统一运动去模糊，验证了从“像素级映射”转向“卷积过程建模”这一思路的有效性。

Abstract: Image deblurring is a fundamental task in computer vision, yet existing methods mainly specialize in isolated scenarios. Consequently, the deblurring performance of these models drops significantly across scenarios with different cameras and image contents. This motivates the development of a unified motion deblurring framework that can handle diverse blur patterns. To this end, we construct a multi-source dataset and develop a data pruning and quality control pipeline. Then, to restore blur images with various motion blur kernels across different scenarios, we propose a unified motion deblurring framework via Fourier Convolution Learning. Existing deblurring networks usually rely on pixel-level mappings and overlook the convolutional nature of blur. Thus, the network mostly fits the image content itself rather than learning the convolution process, making it difficult to handle multi-source blur images. Instead of relying on spatial mapping, we perform blur-adaptive global filter learning in Fourier space, which avoids the limited spatial support of kernel estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our unified model effectively handles motion blurs across diverse sources and scenes, achieving competitive performance across both in-domain and OOD benchmarks. Code will be released at github.com/DeepMed-Lab-ECNU/Single-Image-Deblur.

</details>


### [30] [In-Context Learning Can Help Vision-Language Models Overcome Training Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12942)
*Kun Wang,Xindi Wu,Sanghyuk Chun,Olga Russakovsky,Esin Tureci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过受控的视觉上下文学习（visual in-context learning）发现，视觉语言模型在违背训练先验的反事实样本上经常出错，但这种错误多源于未能关注视觉证据而非能力缺失。只需提供示范即可大幅纠正这类错误，同时不损害先验一致样本的性能，表明模型已具备被标准评测忽视的视觉 grounding 能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在训练中习得强烈的统计规律（先验），当输入图像违反这些规律时，模型往往无法正确依据视觉证据作答。困难在于：难以区分这类"先验诱导的错误"与模型本身缺乏底层视觉能力所导致的错误。作者希望厘清模型究竟是"不会看"还是"没去看"。

Method: 采用受控的视觉上下文学习：在五个视觉中心任务上，向模型提供示范（demonstrations），引导其关注视觉证据，并对比模型在先验冲突的反事实样本与先验一致样本上的表现。同时在五个 VLM 家族上验证泛化性，并分析视觉表征以考察注意力分配的变化。

Result: 示范在反事实样本上带来大幅提升（Qwen3-VL 235B 提升 +27.2%，Qwen3-VL 32B 提升 +15.1%），而在先验一致样本上准确率几乎不变；该结论在五个 VLM 家族上泛化，增益范围为 +9.7% 至 +30.3%。表征分析显示，示范确实将注意力重新导向 grounding 线索，同时降低对支持先验线索的依赖。此外，当底层视觉能力薄弱或缺失时，上下文学习的效果有限。

Conclusion: 当前 VLM 实际具备标准评测可能忽视的视觉 grounding 能力，先验冲突错误多为"未关注视觉证据"所致而非能力缺失；这凸显了在诊断与提升模型能力时采用受控评测设计的必要性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) learn strong statistical regularities during training, which can make them fail to properly respond to visual evidence when input images violate those regularities. It is challenging to disambiguate these prior-induced errors from errors caused by the model missing the underlying visual capabilities. In this work, we use controlled visual in-context learning to encourage the model to focus on the visual evidence, and demonstrate that this alone is frequently sufficient to correct the errors -- suggesting that the models in fact do possess the relevant visual capabilities. Specifically, we show that across five vision-centric tasks, demonstrations yield large gains on prior-conflicting counterfactual examples ($+27.2\%$ for Qwen3-VL 235B and $+15.1\%$ for Qwen3-VL 32B) while leaving accuracy on prior-aligned examples nearly unchanged. These findings generalize across five VLM families with gains from $+9.7\%$ to $+30.3\%$. We analyze visual representations and find that demonstrations indeed redirect attention toward grounding cues while reducing reliance on cues that support the learned prior. Finally, we find that in-context learning is limited when the underlying visual capability is weak or absent. Together, these results show that current VLMs possess visual grounding capabilities that standard evaluations may overlook, underscoring the need for controlled evaluation design in diagnosing and improving model capability.

</details>


### [31] [Video Codec-Guided Training-Free Token Compression for Video Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12959)
*Xihua Sheng,Ruijie Liu,Chang Wen Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种视频编解码器引导的免训练视觉token压缩方法，利用压缩视频中已有的编码信息作为低成本搜索先验，在不修改基础VLLM的前提下提升token压缩的精度-复杂度权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLLM依赖长视觉token序列理解复杂时序内容，导致推理效率低。现有免训练压缩方法虽减少送入语言模型的token数量，但压缩过程本身仍需大量视觉特征比较，尤其在帧内token保护和帧间时序token合并环节开销显著，因此需要降低压缩过程自身的计算成本。

Method: 利用压缩视频中已有的编码信息作为低成本搜索先验：将参考帧依赖关系、运动矢量和残差对齐到视觉token网格；残差信息构建紧凑的候选池用于token保护；运动信息沿参考帧链传播，为稀疏采样帧间的时序token合并构造局部候选；随后仅在候选范围内进行局部视觉特征相似度比较以做出最终压缩决策，全程不修改基础VLLM。

Result: 在三种代表性VLLM和四个视频理解基准上，性能与最先进免训练基线FlashVID相当，部分设置下超越之，同时大幅减少token保护和时序匹配所需的特征比较次数。

Conclusion: 编解码器信息可有效改善视频token压缩的精度-复杂度权衡，为VLLM高效推理提供了一种低成本、免训练的压缩方案。

Abstract: Video large language models (VLLMs) rely on long visual token sequences to understand complex temporal content, which makes visual token compression important for efficient inference. Existing training-free compression methods mainly reduce the number of tokens sent to the language model, but the compression process itself can still require many visual feature comparisons, especially for intra-frame token protection and inter-frame temporal token merging. Abstract: Video diffusion models can reconstruct visually compelling content from severely compressed representations at ultra-low bitrates, but they impose a rigid deployment trade-off. This tension is particularly relevant when a video stream must be decoded in real time yet is also stored for later, quality-oriented playback, making AR and BI models natural choices for the live and replay stages, respectively. UniGVC-BI employs a BI-DiT with dense attention for quality-oriented random-access decoding, whereas UniGVC-AR uses windowed AR-DiT for low-delay streaming. Both paths share a hierarchical latent codec that recurrently produces the same conditions with ultra-low bitrates, allowing UniGVC-BI to serve as a conditional teacher for single-step distillation of UniGVC-AR. On standard 1080p benchmarks, UniGVC-BI achieves the best overall rate-distortion-perception trade-off among the evaluated methods and produces temporally stable video at rates as low as 0.0005 bits per pixel. Meanwhile, UniGVC-AR remains competitive while decoding 1080p video at 36.85 FPS, over $250\times$ faster than UniGVC-BI. Code and models will be released later.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) inherit powerful priors from pretrained video generation models, but their variational autoencoder (VAE) representations are optimized for visual reconstruction rather than manipulation. We systematically compare visual representations, five integration mechanisms, and feature combinations under controlled settings. Our study yields three main findings. First, strong general-purpose visual representations provide broader robustness gains and can match or outperform representations pretrained for specific visual capabilities. Second, channel-wise joint prediction achieves the highest average success rate; further analyses suggest that future-feature prediction and the action expert's effective use of added visual information contribute to its gains. Third, additional sources should be selected for the task-relevant information they contribute beyond existing representations, as the same source can help one combination but harm another. However, even the best evaluated composition provides a smaller additional gain than the initial improvement from adding a strong general-purpose representation to the VAE-only baseline. We instantiate the resulting Representation Recipe as R$^2$-WAM. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop with an 84.7% success rate and reaches 92.8% on RoboTwin 2.0, improving over the VAE-only baselines by 5.9 and 2.2 percentage points, respectively. Taken together, these findings suggest that future work should prioritize stronger general-purpose visual representations and more effective mechanisms for integrating them into WAMs, with feature composition serving as a supplementary route to improvement.

</details>

Code is available at https://github.com/BrainFM/brainfm-profiler/tree/main/representation_utility.

</details>

*Yongxin Zheng,Hao Wu,Fang Li,Hu Fu,Peiran Yin,Xudong Wang,Haozhe Hu,Xinghao Chen,Yunpu Ma,Wei Zhang,Xiaoyu Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoGR是一个两阶段框架，通过场景表示压缩与视觉计算压缩，在多视角3D视觉语言模型中实现性能与效率的良好权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视角表示使预训练图像和视频视觉语言模型能够理解3D场景，但过长的视觉token序列导致推理成本高昂。冗余来源有二：一是跨视角对同一场景区域的重复观测，二是在每个LLM层处理所有视觉token，无论其与当前计算是否相关。

Result: 在LLaVA-OneVision-7B和Video-3D LLM-7B上，GeoGR分别保留密集后训练模型95.2%和96.8%的性能，同时将LLM预填充加速6.8倍和6.1倍。

Abstract: Multi-view representations enable pretrained image and video vision-language models to understand 3D scenes, but their long visual token sequences make inference costly. At the projector level, GeoSemZip consolidates cross-view observations into 3D voxel tokens and combines semantic saliency with spatial coverage to construct a compact scene representation. Unselected voxel features are aggregated into contextual anchors to retain scene information that would otherwise be discarded. At the LLM level, we identify an effective visual computation window and observe that query-conditioned token relevance remains locally stable but changes over longer layer intervals. Guided by these findings, GroupRoute combines late entry and early exit with recoverable group-wise skipping. Low-relevance tokens bypass complete LLM layers while retaining their hidden states and can rejoin the active group at subsequent anchor layers selected under a computation budget. For compression-aware post-training, we construct a compact dataset of 67K samples by retaining 30% of the original training pool. With this protocol, GeoGR retains 95.2% and 96.8% of the dense post-trained models' performance on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Video-3D LLM-7B, respectively, while accelerating LLM prefill by $6.8\times$ and $6.1\times$. These results demonstrate the consistent effectiveness of GeoGR across 3D VLMs with and without explicit 3D spatial encoding, highlighting a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/GeoGR.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

We propose Temporal-Response Guidance (TRG), which measures representation responses to local temporal perturbations, adds the teacher correction's projection onto their span back to the original correction, and restores its original norm. The projection is not normalized separately, and correction components outside the response space are retained. With an orthogonal tangent projector and a detached target, TRG changes the supervision direction while preserving the cosine-loss value and aligned-representation gradient norm at target construction. </details>

*James Rose,Jingwen Liang,Wenchao Ma,Oren Jacob,Haomiao Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NOFACE3D 是一个免训练框架，通过在推理时对生成网格中的细节关键区域进行局部放大与重编码，并配合空间可变噪声调度的流式采样进行精修，再无缝整合回原资产，从而在冻结的预训练生成器上提升几何与纹理细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单图到3D生成模型在全局形状与外观上已具说服力，但细尺度区域（细小、纤薄、细长或细节丰富处）重建模糊、分辨率不足。根本原因在于固定分辨率空间网格对所有表面采用相同采样密度，无法兼顾大面积平滑曲面与承载主要细节的薄壁高曲率结构。

Conclusion: NOFACE3D 通过推理时局部精修有效缓解固定分辨率网格的细节欠采样问题，在不训练、不改动预训练生成器的前提下提升细节保真度，为图像到3D生成的质量增强提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Recent image-to-3D models generate complete, high-quality assets from a single image, with global shape and appearance that are already convincing; what remains is the fine scale, where small, thin, elongated, or detail-rich regions are reconstructed softly and under-resolved. This gap can arise in generators with fixed-resolution spatial grids: the same spatial sampling density is used for a large, smooth, low-curvature surface and for a thin, high-curvature structure that carries most of the perceived detail. To this end, we introduce NOFACE3D, a training-free framework that refines these detail-critical regions while preserving the rest of the asset. Given a generated mesh, its input image, and a refinement box, NOFACE3D extracts the selected submesh, scales it up to fill the generator's input volume, and re-encodes it into the full-resolution latent grid. Conditioned on the image crop, it refines the region through flow-based sampling with a spatially varying noise schedule that anchors boundary latents. The refined region is then integrated back into the original asset, preserving the surrounding geometry and appearance. We implement NOFACE3D on TRELLIS.2 and its sparse voxel representation; all of it operates purely at inference time on the frozen pretrained generator. We evaluate NOFACE3D on PAniC-3D, TexVerse and BigDetail, a new benchmark of 339 assets with annotated detail-critical regions. On all three, it generates sharper geometry and finer texture detail than the baselines. Project page: https://idkcouscous.github.io/NoFACE3D/

</details>

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniMergeTrack 提出层次化模型合并范式，保留模态特定优化同时实现跨任务知识融合，在 RGB-Thermal、RGB-Event、RGB-Depth 跟踪基准上达到 SOTA 或竞争性能。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用 RGB-X 跟踪器存在两类范式局限：独立任务特定训练导致知识隔离与模型冗余；跨模态组合联合训练则引入异构任务间的优化干扰。因此需要一种既能保留任务特定优化、又能有效整合跨任务知识的新方法。

Conclusion: UniMergeTrack 通过层次化模型合并有效平衡了任务特定优化与跨任务知识整合，为 RGB-X 跟踪提供了一种规避知识隔离与优化干扰的新范式。源代码将在接收后于 https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenEvTracking 发布。

Abstract: RGB-X tracking leverages complementary modalities, such as thermal infrared, event, or depth, to improve robustness under challenging conditions. Existing general-purpose RGB-X trackers typically follow two paradigms: independent task-specific training and joint training across modality combinations. However, the former suffers from knowledge isolation and model redundancy, while the latter introduces optimization interference across heterogeneous tasks. In this work, we present UniMergeTrack, a new model merging paradigm that preserves task-specific optimization while enabling effective cross-task knowledge integration. UniMergeTrack first trains modality-specific trackers independently and then performs hierarchical model merging. Specifically, transferable backbones are merged across RGB-X tasks via high-pass-filtered merging, and complemented by lightweight task-specific experts that preserve modality-specific cues. Tracking heads are merged within each task using optimal transport-guided channel alignment to mitigate hidden channel mismatch. Extensive experiments on the LasHeR, RGBT234, VisEvent, VOT-RGBD22, COESOT, and CDTB benchmarks demonstrate that UniMergeTrack achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance across RGB-Thermal, RGB-Event, and RGB-Depth tracking tasks, while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen datasets. The source code will be released upon acceptance. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenEvTracking.

</details>

*Noel D'souza,Zhijian Yang,Nishank Singla,Pranay Doshi,Krisztian Koos,Fei Tan,Bruno Nunes,Laszlo Rusko,Bernadett Kolozsvari,Eszter Sabo,Emanuele Valeriano,Vikash Gupta,Seyed Iman Zare Estakhraji,Marc Lebel,Farzin Haddadpour,Taha Kass-Hout,Erhan Bas*

Abstract: Recent advances in large-scale foundation models have enabled strong generalization across a wide range of clinical and research tasks in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Across a diverse set of downstream tasks, A4-MR outperforms existing foundation models, including a +1.7 AUROC improvement over MedSigLIP for abnormality detection. Using a frozen encoder, A4-MR also surpasses an end-to-end task-specific MedNeXt model for knee segmentation by +1.4 Dice and performs comparably to the best task-specific model for abdominal organ segmentation on AMOS, within 0.4 Dice. Finally, without anatomical prompts, A4-MR localizes 3D anatomy comparably to MedSAM2 provided with ground-truth bounding boxes. Together, these results demonstrate that anatomy-level multimodal alignment and abnormality-aware representation learning can enable a single MRI foundation model to support localization, segmentation, and pathology-related tasks.

</details>


### [45] [Evolving Creatives with Clicks: CTR-Driven Advertising image Editing via Attribute Disentanglement and Preference Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13066)
*Xu Zhang,Haohan Wang,Zheng Zhang,Yingjie Xia,Wei Feng,Honghe Zhu,Jingjing Lv,Changping Peng,Xuheng Qin,Zehua Zhang,Zheng Luo,Qicheng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ECC（Evolving Creatives with Clicks），将电商广告创意优化从"从头生成"重构为"细粒度编辑"，仅针对损害 CTR 的属性进行定向修改并保留有益属性；通过 ANOVA 与随机森林回归筛选出 28 个与 CTR 显著相关的属性，基于属性对比指令微调提示模型并用真实点击偏好精修，同时提出一致偏好优化（CPO）缓解 DPO 过拟合并提升偏好泛化，实验表明其 CTR 提升显著超越现有最优模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商广告创意的优化目标已从美学质量转向 CTR 等在线业务指标。现有方法基于 CTR 构建奖励信号并用强化学习改进提示生成，但这类范式对表现不佳图像中的所有属性"一视同仁"地施加惩罚，忽略了其中部分属性实际上对点击有益，从而造成有益属性的误伤与优化效率低下。

Method: 1) 将创意优化重新表述为细粒度编辑而非从头生成，仅选择性地修正损害 CTR 的属性、保留贡献正向的属性；2) 面对海量图像构成的丰富属性空间，先用 ANOVA 与随机森林回归识别出 28 个与 CTR 显著相关的属性；3) 依据高/低 CTR 图像间的属性对比，指令微调提示模型以生成编辑建议，再利用真实点击偏好对其进行精修（因基于参考图得到的建议并非一致有益）；4) 提出一致偏好优化 CPO，通过对语义等价的打乱建议施加一致性约束，缓解 DPO 过拟合并提升偏好泛化能力。

Result: 大量实验表明 ECC 显著提升了广告图像的 CTR，并以较大幅度优于当前最先进模型。作者同时承诺在论文录用后开源完整数据流水线（含属性提取与分析）、生成的数据集及源代码。

Conclusion: 细粒度、属性级的编辑范式优于整体生成式优化，可有效避免对有益属性的误伤；将 CTR 相关的属性分析与真实点击偏好相结合，并通过 CPO 保证偏好学习的一致性，是实现高 CTR 广告创意的有效路径。

Abstract: The optimization objective for e-commerce advertising creatives has shifted from aesthetic quality to online business metrics like click-through rate (CTR). Recent methods generate appealing ad images from product images by constructing CTR-based reward signals and refining prompt generation via Reinforcement Learning. Such paradigms equally penalize all attributes within an underperforming image, even though some are actually beneficial to clicks. In this work, we propose Evolving Creatives with Clicks (ECC), which reformulates creative optimization as fine-grained editing rather than generation from scratch. ECC selectively refines attributes that hurt CTR while preserving those that contribute positively. Specifically, faced with a rich attribute space across massive images, ECC first identifies 28 attributes significantly correlated with CTR via ANOVA and Random Forest regression. (2) Necessity follows the attention source: head-sets discovered from query-span attention are more nec- essary than last-token ones (difference 0.083, p=6 x 10^-10), and the two re- ferring + query-span sets lie 17-19 standard deviations above 250 layer-matched random sets (Holm-adjusted p=0.048). In contrast, perception and recall are highly separable at the state level under the present validation protocol. Abstract: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires an agent to track progress through an extended instruction, identify landmarks relevant to its current objective, and understand the surrounding spatial structure to act. Without explicit guidance on the evidence underlying each decision, however, policies can overfit to correlations predictive of training actions rather than learn the task-relevant grounding and geometry needed for generalization. Our insight is to guide the representations that connect instructions to actions: identifying what remains to be done determines which visual evidence matters, while understanding the geometry around that evidence informs how to move. We introduce GuidedNav, a unified framework that explicitly shapes these representations through training-time guidance. Subtask and landmark guidance steer native pre-action attention toward the active instruction segment and relevant visual regions, grounding action prediction in the current objective. Spatial guidance aligns the policy's internal representations with geometric features that capture long-horizon context and local spatial structure. Together, these objectives strengthen navigation capabilities while avoiding the inference overhead of intermediate textual reasoning and online geometric encoding. We also introduce Guided-R2R and Guided-RxR, two annotation-enriched navigation datasets that support more interpretable VLN research. GuidedNav establishes state-of-the-art performance among the compared monocular RGB policies, improving success rates by 8.1% and 13.1% relative to the strongest prior results on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, respectively, while achieving faster inference. Abstract: Image-based 3D reconstruction provides a scalable representation for building inspection and maintenance. However, photorealistic reconstruction alone does not fully provide the geometric measurability, semantic structure, and interactive information access required for engineering applications. This study proposes a measurable semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework with region and depth supervision for interactive building inspection from multi-view imagery. Mask-based region supervision suppresses irrelevant backgrounds and focuses optimization on target regions. Point-wise depth supervision guides Gaussian centers toward physical surfaces using reference geometry derived from multi-view stereo (MVS) point clouds, providing geometric anchors for measuring physical dimensions and areas. A semantic Gaussian field associates learnable class features with individual Gaussian primitives, enabling semantic rendering and component-level inspection. These capabilities are operationalized through AEC-SplatTwin, an interactive building inspection platform supporting real-time visualization, semantic analysis, quantitative measurement, and multimodal large language model (MLLM)-assisted interaction. On the synthetic UAV-inspection QuakeCity and smartphone-captured HKUPB datasets, the framework reduces Gaussian-center depth MAE by 58.1% and 86.8%, while its semantic field achieves mIoU values of 0.8529 and 0.8642. On HKUPB, the mean relative errors for height, width, and area measurements are 0.33%, 1.07%, and 0.60%. These results show that the proposed framework extends 3DGS beyond visual reconstruction into a measurable, semantically structured, and interactive engineering representation for building inspection.

### [52] [From Glance to Focus: Mitigating Recognition Laziness in MLLMs for Fine-Grained Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13154)

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FGVR Laziness现象，并据此设计了免训练框架LIVE，通过联合优化候选类别列表与识别引导来激发MLLM潜在的细粒度视觉识别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM虽具备视觉感知与广泛类别知识等FGVR基础，但在细粒度视觉识别任务上表现不佳。现有方法多依赖领域特定的后训练来弥补，但可能损害对未见过域的泛化能力。

Method: 从实证与理论双视角重新审视MLLM的FGVR机制，发现推理阶段的FGVR Laziness现象（视觉线索与类别概念关联不足）。为此提出免训练框架LIVE，包含三部分：查询自适应候选推理以得到紧凑可靠的候选列表；通过挖掘类内特征与类间差异构建类别特定FGVR技能；依据识别不确定性与类别混淆度选择性调用详细技能引导。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) generally fall short of expectations in Fine-Grained Visual Recognition (FGVR), although they exhibit promising FGVR foundations, i.e., visual perception and broad category knowledge. Most existing studies seek to remedy this deficiency by adopting domain-specific post-training, at the risk of compromising generalization to unseen domains. Different from these efforts, in this paper, we revisit the FGVR mechanism underlying MLLMs from both the empirical and theoretical perspectives and uncover an inference-time phenomenon termed FGVR Laziness. In brief, FGVR Laziness refers to the insufficient association between visual cues and category concepts under certain candidate category lists and recognition guidance, leaving the FGVR foundations of MLLMs largely under-utilized. To mitigate FGVR Laziness, we propose Laziness-resIstant Visual rEcognition (LIVE), a training-free framework which jointly refines candidate lists and recognition guidance to elicit the latent FGVR capability of MLLMs. Specifically, LIVE first performs query-adaptive candidate inference to derive a compact yet reliable candidate list. Meanwhile, LIVE constructs category-specific FGVR skills by mining the intra-category characteristics and inter-category differences. Finally, LIVE selectively invokes detailed skill guidance according to recognition uncertainty and category confusion, shifting MLLM-based FGVR from a cursory glance to a focus on associating discriminative visual cues with category concepts. Extensive experiments on 13 benchmarks against 24 state-of-the-art methods spanning fine-grained category recognition, action recognition, and general category recognition, verify the effectiveness and generalizability of LIVE across different MLLM backbones. The code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>

*Yilai Liu,Wenqi Pei,Zhifeng Lu,Shiyuan Zhang,Zongxi Liu,Hongyang Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PreCoG迭代框架，通过PreQA低成本预览诊断与PreEdit编辑缓存轨迹纠正语义失败，减少重复计算与内容扰动。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Iterative text-to-video generation relies on feedback to correct compositional and temporal failures. PreQA diagnoses failures from low-cost previews and constructs corrective conditions, while PreEdit edits cached generation trajectories under these conditions, attenuating orthogonal changes to limit disruption of already correct content. PreCoG completes generation only for the selected candidate, reusing its cached trajectory to reduce redundant computation and help preserve semantic consistency between the preview and the final video. Experiments show that PreCoG achieves the highest VBench and T2V-CompBench scores and approaches VSR's leading VS2 score at $0.56\times$ its inference time. It also outperforms GENMAC on all three quality and alignment metrics at $0.86\times$ its inference time.

</details>

*Nadav Alali,Ohad Ben-Shahar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出STITCH：一种自监督兼容性度量（CM），通过比对拼块内部冻结ViT patch token并用轻量cross-attention头（约249K可训练参数）训练，绕开缺失边界问题；配合原兼容性求解器在JPwLEG-5、ImageNet 7×7、GAP等基准上大幅超越现有方法，并具跨腐蚀程度与缺失率鲁棒性。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 性能跃升来自可插拔的CM模块，核心结论是"修正匹配，而非修正求解器"；STITCH为侵蚀、不规则、高缺失率真实拼图提供了通用且稳健的兼容性度量方案。

Abstract: Unlike the clean and pixel-aligned complete pieces of standard jigsaw benchmarks, real-world puzzle fragments lose their boundary regions to erosion, destroying the signal that classical compatibility measures (CMs) rely on. We first re-establish, via oracle experiments, that the CM, not the solver, is the performance bottleneck: with a perfect CM, even a simple greedy solver achieves perfect reconstruction. This motivates STITCH, a self-supervised CM that sidesteps missing boundaries by comparing frozen ViT patch tokens from piece interiors via a lightweight cross-attention head (~249K trainable parameters), trained without manual annotation. Plugged into unchanged compatibility-based solvers, STITCH reaches .992/.954 Abs/Perf on JPwLEG-5 (+.629 Perf over the best prior method), nearly saturating the benchmark. On a new ImageNet 7x7 benchmark, it outperforms all alternatives, including inpaint-then-match pipelines built on modern generative models. Importantly, performance remains robust across erosion levels and generalizes to puzzles with over 40% missing pieces without retraining. Trained on the recent GAP datasets of irregular, heavily eroded fragments, the same CM recipe enables compatibility-based solvers to surpass recent learning-based solvers on GAP-3 and GAP-5. </details>


### [55] [CompactSplat: Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Distribution for Feedforward Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13177)
*Bing He,Jingnan Gao,Yunuo Chen,Zhengxue Cheng,Rong Xie,Li Song,Wenjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CompactSplat：一种前馈框架，通过内容感知的高斯分配实现稀疏视图三维重建，用更少基元达到高保真效果。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏视图重建三维场景且无需逐场景优化仍具挑战，尤其在恢复精确几何与细节纹理方面。现有可泛化的前馈3D高斯泼溅方法通常对每个像素分配一个或多个高斯，这种均匀分配在均匀区域浪费大量基元导致表示冗余，同时未利用平面表面的几何先验，结构建模次优。

Method: 提出CompactSplat，一种新颖的前馈框架，实现内容感知的3D高斯分配。通过整合纹理引导的空间划分与分层采样，自适应分配基元：在复杂区域集中密集高斯，在平坦区域用扩展的、尺度调制的高斯进行平铺。框架天然支持推理时的动态稀疏控制，无需重新训练网络即可在渲染保真度与内存占用间灵活权衡。

Result: 在RealEstate10K、DL3DV和ScanNet上的大量实验表明，CompactSplat在标准指标和高分辨率渲染一致性上持续优于现有方法，以显著更少的基元实现高保真重建。

Conclusion: CompactSplat通过内容感知的高斯分配与动态稀疏控制，有效解决了稀疏视图重建中的表示冗余与结构建模问题，在多个基准上实现高保真、低基元的重建效果。

Abstract: Reconstructing 3D scenes from sparse views without per-scene optimization remains highly challenging, especially for recovering accurate geometry and fine textures. While recent feedforward approaches leverage generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for scene generation, they typically assign one or multiple Gaussians to each pixel. Such uniform allocation not only produces highly redundant representations by wasting primitives in homogeneous areas, but also fails to exploit the inherent geometric priors of planar surfaces, often resulting in sub-optimal structural modeling. To address these limitations, we present CompactSplat, a novel feedforward framework that enables a content-aware allocation of 3D Gaussians. By integrating texture-guided spatial partitioning with hierarchical sampling, CompactSplat adaptively distributes primitives - concentrating dense Gaussians in complex regions while tiling flat areas with expanded, scale-modulated primitives. Moreover, our framework inherently supports dynamic sparsity control at inference time, enabling seamless trade-offs between rendering fidelity and memory footprint without requiring network retraining. Extensive experiments on RealEstate10K, DL3DV, and ScanNet demonstrate that CompactSplat consistently outperforms prior methods on both standard metrics and high-resolution rendering consistency, achieving high-fidelity reconstructions with significantly fewer primitives.

</details>
