Abstract: Infographic generation challenges text-to-image models because a single image must satisfy numerous visual, textual, and semantic constraints. Iterative agentic refinement with a multimodal verifier is a natural remedy, but existing methods face a scale mismatch: local edits cannot correct global composition errors, while full regeneration may destroy already-correct regions. We introduce Stride, a constraint-grounded multi-agent framework that treats refinement over any frozen generator as a history-aware evolution strategy. Stride separates constraint evaluation - whether each requirement is satisfied - from visual grounding - where and how it is violated. It then routes global revisions to a composer subagent and local corrections to a retoucher subagent. Each subagent conducts internal planning and generates multiple candidates, while Stride accepts a candidate only when it improves the verifier score, reducing regression across iterations. Because stochastic generators and imperfect verifiers make any single step unreliable, it is this combination of scale-aware routing, per-step redundancy, and monotonic acceptance that yields stable improvement across iterations. With fully open-weight generator-verifier systems, Stride outperforms proprietary systems including Nano-Banana-2.0 and Seedream-5.0-Pro on BizGenEval, matches GPT-Image-2.0 and surpasses Seedream-5.0-Pro on IGenBench, and achieves a new state-of-the-art score on WISE, while substantially outperforming existing agentic methods across all evaluated benchmarks.

</details>


### [90] [SplatQ: Interaction-Aware Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Quadratic Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13503)
*Hongbin Ye,Haixu Liu,Shenwei Kang,Wenxiu Wei,Tinglan Wang,Hongdong Zhu,Fan Tang,Qi Gao,Yin Ma,Kai Wen,Hai Wei,Nuo Qian,Wei-Shi Zheng,Shaobo Chen,Fa-Ting Hong,Jingke Meng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SplatQ组合式剪枝算法，通过区域预算分配与联合高斯选择的协同优化，在固定预算下提升3DGS重建质量与空间均衡性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS剪枝方法主要依赖独立重要性分数的全局Top-K选择，缺乏区域预算控制，且忽略高斯之间的联合删除效应，因此无法保证场景各区域重建质量的均衡性。

Method: SplatQ将高斯按空间邻近性和外观相似性划分为大小受限的块，把全局选择分解为特定规模的子问题；对基于重要性的块保留配额进行平滑，防止预算过度集中；利用代表性像素颜色对高斯不透明度变化的响应构建联合删除效应的二次近似，将个体响应、成对交互与配额惩罚整合到QUBO目标中，并使用模拟退火（SA）或相干伊辛机（CIM）求解，实现高斯的联合选择。

Result: 在5个基准上，SplatQ在整体重建质量、空间质量均衡性和渲染速度方面均优于当前最先进的剪枝方法。消融实验证实，预算平滑改善了局部细节重建，交互建模提升了固定预算下的高斯选择质量。

Conclusion: SplatQ通过区域预算分配与联合选择协同的组合式剪枝范式，有效解决了现有方法区域质量失衡与忽略联合删除效应的问题，验证了配额平滑与交互建模各自的贡献。

Abstract: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pruning methods primarily rely on global Top-K selection based on independent importance scores, lacking regional budget control and ignoring joint deletion effects. Consequently, they cannot ensure balanced reconstruction quality across a scene. We propose SplatQ, a combinatorial pruning algorithm that coordinates regional budget allocation and joint Gaussian selection under a fixed budget. SplatQ partitions Gaussians by spatial proximity and appearance similarity into size-limited blocks, decomposing global selection into subproblems of a specific size. It then smooths importance-based block retention quotas to prevent excessive budget concentration. Finally, it constructs a quadratic approximation of joint deletion effects using the responses of representative pixel colors to changes in Gaussian opacity. Individual responses, pairwise interactions, and quota penalties are incorporated into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) objective, solved using simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM) to jointly select Gaussians. Experiments on 5 benchmarks demonstrate that SplatQ outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods in aggregate reconstruction quality, spatial quality balance, and rendering speed. Ablations confirm that budget smoothing improves local detail reconstruction, while interaction modeling improves Gaussian selection quality under a fixed budget.

</details>


### [91] [S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13527)
*Zhiyuan Shi,Xiang Li,Xingzhuo Guo,Shangchen Miao,Weiliang Chen,Qiyu Dai,Jinshan Ren,Jiangran Lyu,Fangfu Liu,Mingsheng Long,Jialong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）内部存在一个线性子空间 S-Space，用于编码物体表征的连续空间坐标，并证明其作为内部空间“工作区”支撑空间感知、推理与语言输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs 虽展现出有前景的空间推理能力，但其内部机制仍缺乏理解。作者旨在揭示支撑空间推理的内部表征结构，并借此诊断空间推理失败的原因。

Method: 通过对外部空间答案得分关于物体 token 激活求导来识别沿水平、垂直、距离三轴的线性表征轴；采用因果干预检验其功能；结合案例研究分析未见实体与观察者的定位；并将 S-Space 作为诊断工具，做方向词读出与“感知—计算”分解。

Result: S-Space 为模型内在表征而非由特定数据或提示诱导，在非空间问题下仍可读出；感知将物体位置编码其中并可直接读取以支持空间判断；内部推理可对其变换以应对视角变化；语言回答选择性地访问该空间，因果干预能改变空间判断而基本保留非空间回答。诊断发现基数与图像相对参考系存在系统性耦合，且瓶颈在于视角变化所需的“空间变换”而非感知表征形成。

Conclusion: S-Space 可作为 MLLMs 的内部空间工作区与诊断工具，既体现大规模语言训练带来的能力（可为未见实体与观察者分配位置、连接物理方向与抽象语义），也暴露其局限：可靠跨视角推理的主要短板在空间变换环节。

Abstract: Multimodal language models (MLLMs) exhibit promising spatial reasoning capabilities, yet the internal mechanisms supporting them remain poorly understood. We uncover S-Space, a linear representation subspace in which object-token representations encode continuous coordinates along horizontal, vertical, and distance axes. Although we identify these axes by differentiating spatial-answer scores with respect to object-token activations, S-Space is intrinsic rather than induced by specific data or prompts, remaining readable under non-spatial questions. We show that S-Space functions as an internal spatial workspace of MLLMs. Perception encodes object locations into it, forming spatial representations that can be directly read out to support accurate spatial judgments. Internal reasoning transforms it for changing viewpoints. Verbal responses selectively access it, evidenced by causal interventions that alter spatial judgments while largely preserving non-spatial responses. Case studies further show that S-Space assigns locations to unseen entities and the observer, and connects physical directions with abstract linguistic meanings, suggesting both the capabilities and limitations of large-scale language training. Finally, we use S-Space as a diagnostic tool for spatial reasoning failures. Direction-word readouts reveal systematic coupling between cardinal and image-relative reference frames. More importantly, a perception-computation decomposition exposes a key bottleneck: MLLMs can form capable spatial representations, yet fall short in the spatial transformations required to reason reliably across viewpoint changes.

</details>


### [92] [Knowing Whether, Not Just Where: Anchor-Probing Distillation for Open-Set Remote Sensing Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13535)
*Zhihao Chang,Lei Zhai,Shuyuan Yang,Zhixi Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AnchorProbe-Distill（APD）师生框架，将遥感开放集视觉定位重构为"视觉支持"（Visual Support）学习，使模型同时完成定位与拒识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有封闭集定位模型对不存在的目标也会输出貌似合理的框，把定位置信度与真实视觉证据（Visual Support）混淆；遥感开放集场景要求模型不仅判断目标在哪，还要判断图像是否提供了足够证据。

Method: 核心洞见：有支持的查询应诱导一致的空间锚点，不支持或错配的查询则产生不稳定或误导性的定位模式。APD-T以原始查询作为参考锚点（Reference Anchor）解读三类查询扰动：语义保持查询保留标注目标；近类歧义查询依据其是否形成可靠替代锚点或坍缩到参考锚点来判定；远类反事实查询提供拒识监督。该参考感知推理被蒸馏到APD-S，实现单图像—查询对的统一定位与拒识。

Result: 实验表明APD在拒绝缺失目标的同时，还能提升对存在目标的定位性能（既拒识又定位更准）。

Conclusion: 通过将开放集定位转变为视觉支持学习并借助参考锚点引导的查询扰动监督与师生蒸馏，APD统一了定位与拒识，缓解了封闭集模型过度输出框的问题，验证了视觉支持作为开放集遥感定位判别依据的有效性。

Abstract: Open-set visual grounding in remote sensing requires models to determine not only where a queried object is located, but also whether the image provides sufficient evidence for the query at all. Existing closed-set grounding models, however, tend to return plausible boxes even for absent objects, blurring localization confidence with genuine Visual Support. We introduce AnchorProbe-Distill (APD), a teacher-student framework that recasts open-set grounding as Visual Support learning. APD builds on the insight that supported queries should induce coherent spatial anchors, whereas unsupported or mismatched queries tend to produce unstable or misleading localization patterns. APD-T therefore uses the Original Query as a Reference Anchor to interpret query perturbations: Semantic-Preserving Queries retain the annotated target, Near-Category Ambiguous Queries are resolved according to whether they form a reliable alternative anchor or collapse onto the Reference Anchor, and Far-Category Counterfactual Queries provide rejection supervision. This reference-aware reasoning is distilled into APD-S, enabling unified localization and rejection from a single image--query pair. Experiments show that APD enables the resulting model to reject absent targets while also improving its localization of present targets.

</details>


### [93] [Efficient Confidence-Aware Densification for 3DGS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13541)
*Manuel Hofer,Thomas Köhler,Felix Windisch,Bernhard Kerbl,Markus Steinberger,Lukas Radl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出置信度感知的误差驱动致密化方法，在固定预算MCMC框架下取代基于不透明度的采样，实现无先验条件下优于3DGS-MCMC的重建效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS-MCMC用基于不透明度的采样替换梯度驱动的密度控制，已成为固定图元预算下无先验致密化的事实标准。但不透明度在重建较好的区域保持较高，导致新图元集中分配到前景，背景重建不足；低预算时基于先验的方法（ConeGS、EDGS）虽更优，却依赖预训练辐射场或稠密图像匹配及独立初始化阶段。

Method: 在固定预算的MCMC框架内回归误差驱动的致密化：保留3DGS-MCMC的固定预算与渐进增长机制，但按图像误差而非不透明度放置图元；新图元主要采样于屏幕空间梯度较大处；优先选择学习置信度低的图元（标识重建仍较差的区域），并将对渲染图像贡献最小的图元重定位到这些位置。

Result: 在24个场景上平均，该方法在100k至2M图元的所有预算下，PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS均优于3DGS-MCMC。100k时无需先验或初始化阶段，即恢复ConeGS相对3DGS-MCMC领先的1.05dB PSNR中的0.84dB；500k起，在所比较的所有固定预算方法（含ConeGS和EDGS）中PSNR与SSIM最高。虽本质无先验，该方法也能利用先验：从ConeGS或EDGS初始化出发，100k时PSNR与SSIM与ConeGS持平，500k时三项指标均最优。

Conclusion: 误差驱动的置信度感知致密化在固定预算MCMC框架中优于基于不透明度的采样，兼顾无先验性能与先验利用能力，为固定预算致密化提供了有效替代方案。

Abstract: 3DGS-MCMC has replaced the gradient-driven density control of 3D Gaussian Splatting with opacity-based sampling and relocation, and is now the de facto standard for prior-free densification under a fixed primitive budget. Because opacity stays high where the scene is already well reconstructed, this sampling sends most new primitives to the foreground and leaves the background under-reconstructed. At low budgets, prior-based methods such as ConeGS and EDGS outperform it, at the cost of a pre-trained radiance field or dense image matches and a separate initialization stage. We argue for a comeback of error-driven densification within the fixed-budget MCMC framework. Our confidence-aware densification keeps the fixed budget and gradual growth of 3DGS-MCMC, but places primitives by the image error instead of the opacity. New primitives are drawn mostly where screen-space gradients are large. We favor primitives with a low learned confidence, which marks regions the reconstruction still explains poorly, and relocate the primitives that contribute least to the rendered images to these places. Averaged over 24 scenes, our method outperforms 3DGS-MCMC in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS at every budget from 100k to 2M primitives. At 100k, without a prior or an initialization stage, it recovers 0.84dB of the 1.05dB PSNR by which ConeGS leads 3DGS-MCMC, and from 500k on, it has the highest PSNR and SSIM of all fixed-budget methods we compare with, including ConeGS and EDGS. While inherently prior-free, our densification can also exploit priors: from the ConeGS or EDGS initialization, it matches ConeGS in PSNR and SSIM at 100k and is best in all three metrics at 500k.

</details>


### [94] [MOSAIC: Multi-Scale Object-Centric Slot Adaptation with Image-Guided Prototype Conditioning for Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13547)
*Liuqian Wang,Hanyu Xie,Rongzhen Zhao,Qi Ming,Chunjie Ma,Wentao Chao,Yufei Gao,Chengming Liu,Lei Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MOSAIC：面向生成式图像复原的以对象为中心的结构化条件表征学习框架，用于遥感图像超分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练扩散Transformer虽具强生成先验，但适配结构敏感任务困难；现有方法依赖稠密低分辨率特征作条件，易将显著对象与主导背景纠缠，且对跨尺度、跨样本的重复结构抽象不足。

Method: MOSAIC将退化观测组织为结构槽，分别捕获对象级与布局级证据；跨分辨率整合，并从共享原型记忆中检索重复先验以补全不完整的图像特定信息；所得表征通过轻量残差调制注入冻结扩散Transformer的选定层，保留预训练生成先验。以遥感图像超分为实例验证。

Result: 在UCMerced、AID、RSSCN7上，×2与×4设置下PSNR一致提升，×4下LPIPS表现更优；定性结果显示小目标、结构边界与重复空间模式保持更好。

Conclusion: 以对象为中心的结构化条件学习可有效适配冻结扩散Transformer，提升结构敏感复原任务性能，遥感超分验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Pretrained diffusion Transformers provide powerful generative priors for image restoration, yet adapting them to structure-sensitive tasks remains challenging. Existing methods mainly rely on dense low-resolution features as conditions, which often entangle salient objects with dominant backgrounds and provide limited abstraction for recurring structures across scales and samples. We propose MOSAIC, an object-centric representation learning framework that learns compact structural conditions for generative model adaptation. MOSAIC organizes degraded observations into structural slots that capture complementary object-level and layout-level evidence, integrates them across resolutions, and retrieves recurring priors from a shared prototype memory to complement incomplete image-specific information. The resulting representations are injected into selected layers of a frozen diffusion Transformer through lightweight residual modulation, preserving its pretrained generative prior. We instantiate MOSAIC for remote sensing image super-resolution, where small objects, repetitive structures, and large-scale variation provide a challenging testbed. Experiments on UCMerced, AID, and RSSCN7 show consistent PSNR improvements across $\times 2$ and $\times 4$ settings and favorable LPIPS results at $\times 4$. Qualitative results further demonstrate improved preservation of small objects, structural boundaries, and repetitive spatial patterns.

</details>


### [95] [Auditing VLM Benchmarks from Existing Evaluation Runs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13548)
*Denis Degtiarev,Anna Gromova,Sergey Katkov,Artem Mikhailin,Safina Mukhamedshina,Albert Nasybullin,Karina Shaikhutdinova,Artem Tuzov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文复用VLM评测中已被丢弃的逐题产物，在VLMEvalKit中新增审计层（六个检测器+一次去除视觉输入的纯文本重跑），对MMStar基准进行审核，发现20.2%的题目图像无聚合精度增益，并识别出其他基准异常。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM评测每轮都会产生逐题产物（预测、判定正确性、元数据），但排行榜只把它们压缩成单一分数后即丢弃。作者希望复用这些产物来审计基准本身，而非仅评测模型，从而发现基准中图像是否真正被需要、是否存在可疑题目等质量问题。

Method: 在VLMEvalKit中新增审计层：六个检测器以保存输出为输入进行后处理，外加一次移除视觉输入的纯文本重跑，输出逐题报告。报告包含逐题发现与聚合审计统计，对关键量附加置换零假设超额、比例区间估计及对模型池的敏感性分析。以三个模型审计MMStar基准，并做项目匹配的置换零假设检验；另用精确字符串匹配替换LLM评判以验证结论稳健性。

Result: 在MMStar上，20.2%的题目图像未带来聚合精度增益；项目匹配置换零假设可解释17.0%，剩余+3.2个百分点超额（校正置换p=0.001），集中于数学与科学类别，而粗粒度感知类别无此现象。第二个检测器标记出134道题：所有以可解析形式作答的模型都选择了同一非正确选项，这些题目集中于感知类别。将LLM评判替换为精确字符串匹配不改变结论，两者间评分差异均源于某一模型自由格式答案无法被解析。在二元是/否基准上检测器明显失准，构成可测量的适用范围边界。

Conclusion: VLM评测的既有逐题产物可被有效复用于基准审计，能揭示图像无贡献、模型一致错选等基准缺陷，且审计结论对评判方式具有稳健性。作者同时界定并报告了检测器在二元基准上失准的适用范围边界，并随投稿提供审计层、预测产物与生成报告。

Abstract: Every evaluation run of a vision-language model (VLM) already produces per-question artifacts (predictions, judged correctness, metadata) that leaderboards reduce to a single score and then discard. We reuse those artifacts to audit the benchmark itself, and add an audit layer to VLMEvalKit: six detectors that run as post-processing over saved outputs, plus one additional text-only rerun with visual inputs removed, emitting a per-question report. The layer reports per-question findings together with aggregate audit statistics; for the headline quantities, it attaches permutation-null excess where applicable, interval estimates for proportions, and sensitivity to the model pool. Auditing MMStar, a benchmark curated specifically so that the image is indispensable, with three models, we find zero aggregate accuracy gain from the image on 20.2% of its questions. An item-matched permutation null accounts for 17.0%, leaving a +3.2 pp excess (corrected permutation p = 0.001). This excess is concentrated in the mathematics and science categories and is absent from coarse perception, a localization consistent with knowledge substituting for visual evidence; confirming that mechanism would require item-level review. A second detector flags 134 questions on which every model that answered in parseable form picked the same non-gold option, and these candidates peak in the perception categories, whereas the zero-gain excess is largest in mathematics and science & technology. Replacing the LLM judge with exact string matching changes no conclusion, and every scoring discrepancy between the two traces to one model whose free-form answers a parser cannot read. On a binary yes/no benchmark the detectors measurably fall out of calibration, a scope boundary that we measure and report. The audit layer, the prediction artifacts and the generated reports accompany this submission.

</details>


### [96] [ELMA: Benchmarking Anaphoric Compositions for Long-Term Text-to-Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13549)
*Shun Kato,Dixin Yang,Kotaro Amaya,Yuiga Wada,Kazumi Fukuda,Takashi Shibuya,Yuki Mitsufuji,Mariko Isogawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"指代性长时人体动作生成"新任务，并构建带跨段依赖标注的ELMA数据集，通过微调现有模型显著提升长时动作的物理真实性与语义对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型在短片段动作生成上已有进展，但面对含指代（anaphora）的多段指令时表现不佳——前段建立的约束需在后续时间段持续保持，模型难以进行长程状态建模。

Method: 1) 定义"指代性组合指令驱动的长时动作生成"新任务；2) 构建ELMA数据集：通过全自动采集与过滤流水线，从野外视频中提取30秒连续高质量片段，并进行密集的分段级标注以保留跨段依赖；3) 利用该数据微调SOTA动作生成模型，使其融入长程上下文。

Result: 实验揭示了当前模型在处理上下文依赖指令时的根本性缺陷；ELMA使全局物理真实性与语义对齐均获得显著提升。

Conclusion: ELMA为长时动作合成建立了稳健的新基线，并提供了支持长程状态建模的 episodic 数据资源。

Abstract: Text-guided long-term human motion generation is essential for applications such as continuously operating digital avatars. Despite recent progress on short clips, existing models struggle with multi-segment instructions that involve anaphora, where constraints established in earlier segments must be preserved over time. In this paper, we introduce a novel task of long-term motion generation from such anaphoric compositions. To mitigate this, we present ELMA, an episodic long-term motion dataset with dense segment-level annotations that preserve cross-segment dependencies. Built via a fully automated collection and filtering pipeline, ELMA extracts high-quality, continuous 30-second clips from in-the-wild videos, capturing the episodic narratives necessary for long-range state modeling. Leveraging this dataset, we fine-tune state-of-the-art motion generation models to incorporate long-range context. Extensive experiments reveal fundamental shortcomings in current models when handling context-dependent instructions. We demonstrate that ELMA enables significant improvements in both global physical realism and semantic alignment, setting a robust new baseline for long-term motion synthesis.

</details>


### [97] [Learning Holistic Scene Layout against View Shifts in Cross-View Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13553)
*Chao Yang,Songlian Li,Zhigang Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出空间上下文建模(SCM)与高频信息引导(HFIG)两个模块，用于跨视角地理定位，在标准基准上具竞争力，并在未知朝向与受限视场下表现鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨视角地理定位受视角变化导致的外观剧烈变化与几何畸变影响，极具挑战。现有方法多依赖判别性特征学习或显式几何对齐，却忽视了人类匹配场景时是基于多地标的空间上下文整合，而非孤立局部视觉线索这一关键观察。

Method: 受上述观察启发，提出空间上下文建模(SCM)模块：沿四个正交方向遍历特征图，并在每个空间位置上建模所得方向性表示之间的交互，通过聚合互补的方向观测构建更丰富的场景布局表示。由于可靠的空间上下文依赖稳健的视觉特征，进一步引入高频信息引导(HFIG)模块，从频域提取稳定的结构线索，通过强调对外观变化不敏感的边缘与轮廓，促使模型学习更鲁棒的表征。

Result: 在标准跨视角地理定位基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并在未知朝向、有限视场(FoV)等更具挑战性的场景下展现出强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过模拟人类整合多地标空间上下文进行场景匹配的机制，并结合频域高频结构线索，可有效提升跨视角地理定位的表征鲁棒性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Cross-view geo-localization remains challenging due to drastic appearance variations and geometric distortions caused by viewpoint changes. Existing methods primarily rely on discriminative feature learning or explicit geometric alignment, yet often overlook an important observation: humans tend to match scenes by integrating the spatial context of multiple landmarks rather than relying solely on isolated local visual cues. Inspired by this, we propose a Spatial Context Modeling (SCM) module, which traverses feature maps along four orthogonal directions and models interactions among the resulting directional representations at each spatial position. By aggregating complementary directional observations, SCM constructs richer scene layout representations. Since reliable spatial context depends on robust visual features, we introduce a High-Frequency Information Guidance (HFIG) module that extracts stable structural cues from the frequency domain. By emphasizing edges and contours that are less sensitive to appearance variations, HFIG encourages the model to learn more robust representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance on standard cross-view geo-localization benchmarks while exhibiting strong robustness under more challenging scenarios with unknown orientations and limited fields of view (FoVs).

</details>


### [98] [What We Talk About When We Talk About Emotion Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13558)
*Xingzu Zhan,Lin Gu,Ruogu Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ROI-ReFT，一种基于神经表征参考的情感图像编辑方法。利用fMRI编码模型TRIBE v2分析现有方法的表征偏差，发现其隐藏状态更偏向视觉区域而非情感区域，据此设计双分支框架，以源图像视觉响应为内容参考、预测情感响应变化为编辑方向，引导冻结编辑器生成。在400个编辑请求上达到91.75%目标情感准确率与83.25%联合成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 情感图像编辑需在保留内容的同时改变场景传达的情感。由于同一场景可承载不同情感解读，实现情感目标需要以源上下文为基础的视觉修改。受Component Process Model（将情感反应与事件评估相联系）启发，作者希望以神经表征作为编辑决策的参考依据，探究现有方法是否真正依据情感相关表征进行编辑。

Method: 采用TRIBE v2（fMRI编码模型），分析覆盖八类情感、400对源-目标样本。发现EmoEdit、EmoEditor、AffectDelta的隐藏状态与预测目标图像响应的对应关系在视觉区域强于情感相关区域。据此提出ROI-ReFT：以源视觉响应作为内容参考、预测情感响应变化作为编辑方向，两个交互分支共同引导冻结编辑器完成生成；并用生成图像的预测响应监督情感变化、约束视觉漂移。

Result: 在事后退选（post hoc selected）的400个编辑请求子集上，ROI-ReFT取得91.75%的目标情感准确率与83.25%的联合成功率（同一输出既匹配目标情感，又达到源-输出DINO-I不低于0.80）。

Conclusion: 神经表征分析揭示现有情感编辑方法存在偏向视觉区域、情感区域表征不足的失衡问题。ROI-ReFT通过神经响应引导的双分支条件机制有效弥补该失衡，在情感准确性与内容保真度上同时取得较好表现，代码与数据集将公开。

Abstract: Emotional image editing aims to change the emotion a scene conveys while preserving its essential content. Because the same scene can support different emotional interpretations, achieving an emotional goal requires visual changes grounded in the source context. Motivated by the Component Process Model, which links emotional responses to event appraisal, we investigate neural representations as a reference for these editing decisions. Using TRIBE v2, an fMRI encoding model, we analyze 400 source-target pairs across eight emotion categories. Hidden states from EmoEdit, EmoEditor, and AffectDelta correspond more strongly to predicted target-image responses in visual regions than in affect-related regions. This imbalance motivates ROI-ReFT, which combines source visual responses as a content reference with a predicted affective response change as an editing direction. Two interacting branches use both conditions to guide a frozen editor throughout generation. Predicted responses of the generated image supervise affective change and constrain visual drift. On a post hoc selected subset of 400 editing requests, ROI-ReFT achieves 91.75% target-emotion accuracy and 83.25% joint success, with the same output both matching the target emotion and reaching source-output DINO-I of at least 0.80. Our code and dataset will be publicly released.

</details>


### [99] [Thyroid Nodule Segmentation in Ultrasound Images with Conformal Uncertainty Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13604)
*Francesco Teodori,Pierpaolo Brutti,Umberto Ferraro Petrillo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出集成DeepLabV3+、通道注意力模块与后处理式符合预测的甲状腺结节分割框架，在TN3K基准上取得优于现有方法的结果，并提供像素级不确定性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 甲状腺结节在人群中占比高，虽多为良性但恶性比例不可忽略。超声是主要诊断手段，而精确的结节分割是CAD系统进行恶性分类与转移风险评估的前提。现有二值分割掩码缺乏预测置信度信息，无法支撑风险分级。

Method: 以DeepLabV3+为分割主干，利用空洞空间金字塔池化（ASPP）捕获多尺度上下文；采用EfficientNet-B5作为编码器以平衡精度与效率。测试三种通道注意力模块（SE、CBAM、分组通道注意力GCA）与两种损失函数（Dice-BCE、Boundary）的组合。由于二值掩码不反映置信度，在训练好的模型外接入分裂式符合预测（split conformal prediction）层，生成具有统计覆盖率保证的像素级不确定性图。任务定位为包含恶性分类与转移风险预测的整体流程的第一阶段。

Result: 在TN3K公开基准上使用固定数据划分进行评测，并与当前最先进方法直接对比。仅使用原始主干网络即已超过此前报道的结果，其中CBAM+Dice-BCE为综合表现最佳配置。

Conclusion: 将通道注意力与符合预测引入甲状腺超声结节分割，可在提升分割精度的同时给出像素级不确定性估计，为该流程后续的恶性分类与转移风险评估提供更可靠的基础。

Abstract: Thyroid nodules affect a large proportion of the general population. Although most are benign, a non-negligible fraction is malignant. Ultrasound imaging is the primary diagnostic modality, and accurate nodule segmentation is a prerequisite for CAD systems to classify malignancy and assess metastatic risk.\\ In this work, we propose a thyroid nodule segmentation framework that integrates a DeepLabV3+, channel-attention modules and post-hoc conformal prediction, providing both accurate mask and pixel-level uncertainty estimates. We address thyroid ultrasound nodule segmentation as the first stage of a pipeline that also includes malignancy classification and metastatic risk prediction. We adopt DeepLabV3+, whose Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) captures multi-scale context, with an EfficientNet-B5 backbone for its accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Additionally, we test three channel-attention modules: Squeeze-and-Excitation, CBAM and Grouped Channel Attention (GCA), paired with two loss formulations (Dice-BCE and Boundary).\\ Since binary masks do not indicate prediction confidence, we wrap the trained model with a split conformal prediction layer that produces pixel-level uncertainty maps with statistical coverage guarantees.\\ We evaluate all configurations on the TN3K public benchmark using a fixed split and directly compare them with state-of-the-art methods. The plain backbone already improves upon previously reported results, with CBAM + Dice-BCE emerging as the best overall configuration.

</details>


### [100] [OccludeBench: Can VLMs Find What's Missing?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13790)
*Jasin Cekinmez,Addison J. Wu,Ryo Mitsuhashi,Linrong Cai,Xingyu Fu,Zhuang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出OccludeBench基准与OccludeTrace四阶段诊断，考察视觉语言模型对图像中被完全遮挡物体的恢复推理能力，发现模型在"直接线索"任务上显著弱于"场景推断"任务，瓶颈在于从全图投影中定位并恢复目标物体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型能否对图像中"缺失内容"进行推理尚不清楚。既有工作多关注可见内容的识别与理解，缺少对完全遮挡物体恢复能力的受控评测，因此需要构建专门的基准与诊断方法来定位其失败环节。

Method: 构建人工标注基准OccludeBench，区分直接情形（依赖特定物理线索如阴影、反射恢复被遮挡物体）与推断情形（依赖更广的场景上下文推断）；评测五个VLM并与人类对比。进一步提出OccludeTrace四阶段诊断，隔离视觉推理过程各阶段的失效位置。同时尝试扩展推理、工具调用、少样本提示，以及"先修复再对照"（inpaint-then-confront）干预（先生成候选隐藏物体，再用可见物理线索检验该假设）。

Result: 五个VLM平均准确率：直接情形42.7%，推断情形62.7%，差距20.0个百分点；人类为63.4%与68.5%，无显著差距。四阶段诊断显示瓶颈出现在"从全图投影中恢复相关物体"阶段：在失败样本上仅50%成功，而在答对样本上达91%。扩展推理、工具调用、少样本提示提升不稳定，无法可靠消除差距。inpaint-then-confront干预对两个具备图像生成能力的模型将差距缩小至统计上不显著。

Conclusion: OccludeBench与OccludeTrace提供了一个可控、可诊断的框架，用于隔离并定位VLM在图像缺失内容推理中的薄弱环节；结果表明模型并非普遍缺乏场景推断能力，而是受限于从全图视觉证据中定位并恢复被遮挡物体的过程，且该瓶颈可通过"先生成候选再对照线索"的干预得到缓解。

Abstract: How well can vision-language models (VLMs) reason about what is missing from an image? We study this question with OccludeBench, a manually curated benchmark for recovering fully occluded objects from the visual evidence that remains. OccludeBench distinguishes direct cases, where the hidden object must be recovered from a specific physical cue such as a shadow or reflection, from inferential cases, where it can be inferred from broader scene context. Across five VLMs, accuracy averages 42.7% on direct cases versus 62.7% on inferential cases, exhibiting a 20.0-point gap. Humans attain higher accuracies of 63.4% versus 68.5% for direct and inferential images, respectively, with no significant gap. To locate this failure, we introduce OccludeTrace, a four-stage diagnostic that isolates where the visual reasoning process breaks down. The bottleneck emerges when models must recover the relevant object from the projection within the full image: they succeed on only 50% of failed examples, compared with 91% of examples they answer correctly. Extended reasoning, tool use, and few-shot prompting yield inconsistent improvements and do not reliably eliminate the gap. In contrast, an inpaint-then-confront intervention, which prompts models to first generate a candidate hidden object and then evaluate that hypothesis against the visible physical cue, reduces the gap to a statistically non-significant difference for both models with image-generation capabilities. Together, our results establish a tractable, controlled diagnostic for isolating how VLMs reason about visual content that is missing from an image.

</details>


### [101] [CUBE: Class-conditioned Unknown Boundary Evidence for Open-Set Insect Species Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13610)
*Hao Tan,Qimin Zhang,Zhe Xiao,Zekai Zuo,Wanting Liu,Jinghui Qin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CUBE框架，用类别条件边界证据建模未知性，解决细粒度未知昆虫识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放集昆虫识别中，未知物种常与已知类视觉相近、不发散，落在已知类的决策边界附近，导致闭集预测不可靠，与一般OOD样本差异明显。

Method: CUBE将未知性建模为围绕每个已知类的类别条件边界，相对于最相似已知类进行局部拒绝；从辅助物种学习边界证据，推理时保留辅助物种作阴影参考，并加入分类学候选校准以保证生物合理性；CUBE-E进一步在生态元数据可用时加入轻量位置一致性项，且不改动视觉主干。

Result: 在Open-Insect C-America上，CUBE在local、non-local、non-moth未知划分AUROC分别达95.8%、98.7%、99.1%，闭集准确率94.9%；CUBE-E提升至96.0%、99.7%、99.5%，闭集准确率95.2%，均优于SOTA基线。

Conclusion: 类别条件的局部边界证据建模能有效应对视觉混淆的细粒度未知昆虫，结合分类学校准与生态位置一致性可进一步提升开放集识别性能并保持闭集精度。

Abstract: Open-set insect species recognition faces significant challenges when deployed in real-world biodiversity scenarios, particularly when encountering unknown species that are visually close to known training classes. Unlike generic out-of-distribution samples, fine-grained unknown insects are often not visually anomalous. They instead tend to appear near the decision boundary of specific known species, leading to unreliable closed-set predictions. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{Class-conditioned Unknown Boundary Evidence (CUBE)}, a novel evidence-based framework that models unknownness around each known species rather than as a single global unknown class. Our key idea is to evaluate a test sample relative to the known species it most closely resembles, enabling local rejection for visually confusable unknown insects. CUBE learns class-conditioned boundary evidence from auxiliary species, preserves auxiliary species as shadow references during inference, and incorporates taxonomic candidate calibration to verify biological plausibility. When ecological metadata is available, we further introduce CUBE-E, which adds a lightweight location-consistency term without modifying the visual backbone. Experiments on the Open-Insect C-America benchmark show that CUBE achieves superior performance, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines with 95.8\%, 98.7\%, and 99.1\% AUROC on local, non-local, and non-moth unknown splits, respectively, while maintaining 94.9\% closed-set accuracy. With ecological metadata, CUBE-E further improves the results to 96.0\%, 99.7\%, and 99.5\% AUROC with 95.2\% closed-set accuracy.

</details>


### [102] [Benchmarking Answer-Grounding Consistency in Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13636)
*Ping Guo,Zhiqi Huang,Xinran Li,Linkun Yu,Jingyin Pei,Kamata Seiichiro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AESP协议评估接地遥感VQA中答案与证据的一致性，并构建G-RSVQA基准，实验揭示七个模型在证据支持上普遍失效，正确回答中高达50.82%缺乏证据支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有接地遥感VQA评估仅衡量答案正确性与定位质量，未直接评估答案-接地证据的一致性，即证据是否支持模型自身答案。

Method: 提出Answer-Evidence Support Protocol（AESP），针对存在、计数、比较三类问题应用任务特定规则评估证据支持；构建G-RSVQA基准，含15,027个样本，包含问题、参考答案及全部相关物体级标注。

Result: 在七个接地视觉-语言模型上实验，三类问题均出现证据支持失效；证据评估子集中正确回答高达50.82%不被所提供的接地证据支持。

Conclusion: 答案正确性不能保证接地证据的一致性，需引入AESP类协议与G-RSVQA基准以推动更可靠的接地遥感VQA评估。

Abstract: In grounded remote sensing visual question answering, a model produces a textual answer and identifies relevant objects in the image as grounding evidence. Existing evaluations measure answer correctness and localization quality, but do not directly assess answer-grounding consistency. We propose the Answer-Evidence Support Protocol (AESP) to assess this consistency through evidence support: whether the grounding evidence supports the model's own answer. AESP applies task-specific rules to existence, counting, and comparison questions. We further construct the Grounded Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering (G-RSVQA) benchmark, containing 15,027 samples with questions, reference answers, and all related object-level annotations. Experiments on seven grounded vision--language models reveal failures of evidence support across all three question types. Up to 50.82% of correct answers in the evidence evaluation subset are not supported by the provided grounding evidence.

</details>


### [103] [PhysForge: Material-Controllable 3D Reconstruction with Separable Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13681)
*Yuchen Wang,Yanqi Bao,Zheng Gu,Zhengqing Chen,Jieqi Shi,Jing Huo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysForge 是一个基于视频扩散模型（VDM）的框架，通过 PhysFit 与 PhysComp 两个模块，实现材料可控的物理拟合与组件级交互建模，在物理属性估计与材料响应控制上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物理 3D 生成方法虽能生成视觉逼真且具可仿真力学行为的资产，但对材料行为的控制有限，仅依赖外观推断，且难以从物体与语义部件间的复杂交互中估计物理属性。

Method: 提出 PhysForge，含两个互补模块：(1) PhysFit：以材料条件化的 VDM 动力学作为物理属性拟合参考，引入 windowed fitting 聚焦揭示材料的交互，并用 Hallucinated Forcing 将 VDM 幻觉出的非物理运动与材料响应解耦；(2) PhysComp：将复杂交互分解为单个物体与语义组件，使其物理参数可独立优化并灵活组合用于联合仿真。

Result: 在 PhysAssets 与 Google Scanned Objects 上，PhysForge 相比现有方法对材料相关物理响应控制更强，支持复杂交互的组件级物理建模；在常见与非常见材料上均取得最佳 CLIP 与物理可控性得分，定性比较、组件级消融与用户研究进一步验证了改进。

Conclusion: PhysForge 通过 VDM 驱动的材料条件化拟合与组件级交互建模，有效提升了对材料行为的物理控制与从复杂交互中估计物理属性的能力。

Abstract: Recent advances in physical 3D generation have enabled visually faithful assets with simulatable mechanical behavior. However, existing methods provide limited control over material behavior beyond appearance-based inference and struggle to estimate physical properties from complex interactions between objects and semantic parts. Therefore, we present PhysForge, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM)-based framework for addressing these challenges, comprising two complementary modules for material-controllable physical fitting and componentlevel interaction modeling. The first, PhysFit, leverages material-conditioned VDM dynamics as references for physical-property fitting, introducing windowed fitting to focus on material-revealing interactions and Hallucinated Forcing to disentangle nonphysical motion hallucinated by the VDM from material responses. The second, PhysComp decomposes complex interactions into individual objects and semantic components, enabling their physical parameters to be optimized independently and flexibly composed for joint simulation. Experiments on PhysAssets and Google Scanned Objects demonstrate that, compared with existing methods, PhysForge provides stronger control over material-dependent physical responses while supporting component-level physical modeling for complex interactions. It achieves the best CLIP and physical controllability scores on both common and uncommon materials, with qualitative comparisons, component-level ablations, and a user study further supporting these improvements. Our project page is available at https://masterwanna.github.io/PhysForge.html .

</details>


### [104] [X-AVDD: Cross-Attentive Audio-Visual Dataset Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13687)
*Saumyaranjan Mohanty,Aravind Reddy,Konda Reddy Mopuri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 X-AVDD，一种基于交叉注意力的音视频数据集蒸馏方法，通过解耦跨模态对齐与联合优化，显著降低显存开销并提升合成数据的跨模态语义对齐与下游泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音视频数据集蒸馏方法（如 DM、AVDD）存在两大局限：一是显存开销大，难以扩展到复杂网络结构与更高的每类样本数（SPC）设定；二是难以保持强跨模态语义对应关系。

Method: 提出 X-AVDD，利用交叉注意力在合成过程中显式建模模态间关系，并将跨模态对齐与联合优化解耦，从而在提升显存效率的同时生成高度对齐的合成数据。

Result: 端到端合成开销降低约 8 倍 GPU 小时。VGGSound 上，SPC=10 时 top-1 准确率由 8.2% 提升至 24.0%，SPC=20 时由 9.8% 提升至 26.5%；AVE 数据集 SPC=50 时 ViT 目标模型跨架构泛化由 25.5% 提升至 35.3%；在 AudioCLIP 等复杂架构上，仅用 5.65% 数据达到 62.3% 准确率（全量数据为 72.4%），训练时间缩短 9 倍。

Conclusion: X-AVDD 在显存效率、跨模态语义对齐、跨架构泛化及大规模复杂模型可扩展性方面均优于现有音视频蒸馏方法，验证了显式跨模态建模与解耦优化的有效性。

Abstract: Audio-visual dataset distillation aims to synthesize a small dataset from a large paired audio-visual dataset, while nearly preserving the training utility for neural networks. Existing approaches such as DM and AVDD face two critical limitations: 1) they are memory-intensive, making them difficult to scale to complex architectures and higher samples-per-class (SPC) settings, and 2) they often fail to preserve strong cross-modal semantic correspondence. To tackle these issues, we propose X-AVDD, a cross-attention-based distillation method that explicitly captures inter-modal relationships during synthesis. By decoupling cross-modal alignment from joint optimization, X-AVDD is substantially more memory-efficient, reducing end-to-end synthesis cost by $\sim 8\times$ GPU-hours, while producing highly aligned synthetic data. Empirically, X-AVDD significantly outperforms other audio-visual distillation methods. On VGGSound, an audio-visual dataset of short YouTube clips, X-AVDD improves top-1 test accuracy from $8.2\%\rightarrow24.0\%$ at SPC=$10$ and $9.8\%\rightarrow26.5\%$ at SPC=$20$. Furthermore, X-AVDD improves cross-architecture generalization (e.g., $25.5\%\rightarrow35.3\%$ for a ViT target on AVE dataset at SPC $=50$) and successfully scales to complex architectures such as AudioCLIP, achieving $62.3\%$ accuracy using only $5.65\%$ of the full dataset, against the full dataset accuracy of $72.4\%$ while completing in $9\times$ lower training time compared to the full dataset.

</details>


### [105] [Improving Semantic Coverage in AI Test & Evaluation through Generative Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13697)
*Connor Hashemi,Bharadwaj Ravichandran,Connor Anderson,Shitij Govil,Brandon RichardWebster,Brian Hu,Keith Fieldhouse*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出三阶段生成式AI流水线（DEDUCE），在无真值语义标签条件下检测并填补测试集的语义覆盖缺口，仅增强测试集而不重训模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T&E通常只能访问held-out测试集，不了解训练数据及其语义构成；当关键输入条件（时段、天气、场景位置等）在测试集中欠代表时，会产生语义覆盖缺口，使评测结论失真（偏向于未能评估模型在缺失语义下的表现）。

Method: 三阶段流水线：1）用VLM对语义因子做零样本二分类标注，并在嵌入空间聚类，识别对下游模型行为影响最大的语义；2）用扩散式图到图模型把已覆盖图像转换到欠代表语义域，保留场景内容、增强高层外观；3）对增强图像嵌入做统计分析，验证合成图像是否提升数据集覆盖度后再纳入测试集。

Result: 在图像分类与目标检测上，针对昼/夜语义缺口进行验证；增强后的测试集能更好地区分"接触过"与"未接触过"缺失语义的模型，使T&E结论更接近理想全覆盖数据集的结论。

Conclusion: 无需语义真值标签即可检测并填补测试集语义覆盖缺口；合成数据仅用于丰富测试集、不用于重训模型，从而提升T&E评测的有效性与结论可信度。

Abstract: In test and evaluation (T&E) of AI models, evaluators typically have access only to a held-out test dataset and no knowledge of the training data or its semantic composition. If critical input conditions---such as time-of-day, weather, or scene location---are underrepresented in this test dataset, T&E results can be misleadingly due to this semantic coverage gap. We propose a three-stage generative AI pipeline to detect and fill such semantic gaps without requiring ground-truth labels of these semantics. First, vision-language models (VLMs) perform zero-shot binary labeling of semantic factors, and an embedding-space clustering step identifies which semantics most affect downstream model behavior. Second, diffusion-based image-to-image models transform existing covered images into the underrepresented semantic domain, preserving scene content while augmenting high-level appearance. Third, statistical analysis of the augmented image embeddings verifies that the synthetic imagery improves dataset coverage before it is incorporated. Crucially, the synthetic data is used only to enrich the test set and no model retraining is performed for T&E. We validate the full pipeline on both image classification and object detection under day/night semantic gaps, showing that the augmented test datasets better distinguish models with and without exposure to the missing semantic, thereby yielding T&E conclusions that more closely match those of an ideal, fully covered dataset. Code available at https://github.com/Hashe037/DEDUCE

</details>


### [106] [GLIMPSE: Global-Local Indexing with Multi-Precision Spectral Encoding for Explorable Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13706)
*Zhufeng Xu,Henglei Lv,Bailin Deng,Yikang Ding,Xiaoqiang Liu,Guoxin Zhang,Hongbo Fu,Lin Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GLIMPSE——一种全局-局部记忆接口，通过分频段多精度坐标与几何条件谱衰减，降低位置传输对不准确投影地址的敏感度，在相同检索与读取预算下提升几何对应与光度一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机可控视频世界模型要求相机回到某场景时保持一致性。将存储特征渲染到目标帧的记忆方法会把深度与位姿误差转化为重影或结构重复；位置传输（positional transport）虽通过迁移历史patch的地址而非其内容回避重采样，但对不准确的投影却赋予了完整的位置精度，导致敏感。

Method: GLIMPSE由两类记忆组成：局部patch记忆提供视图特定的外观，循环全局记忆提供场景上下文。核心机制包括：(1) band-wise多精度坐标，按频段分配不同的位置精度；(2) 几何条件谱衰减，根据几何可靠性抑制高频信息；(3) footprint引导的检索，在固定的局部读取预算下选择历史patch。

Result: 在匹配的检索与读取预算下，GLIMPSE相较确定性位置传输方法在几何对应和光度一致性上均有提升。

Conclusion: 通过分频段多精度坐标与几何条件谱衰减，可在不增加读取预算的前提下有效缓解投影地址不准确带来的误差，实现更一致的可控视频世界建模。

Abstract: A camera-controlled video world model must keep a scene consistent when the camera returns to it. Memories that render stored features into the target frame can turn depth and pose errors into ghosting or duplicated structure. Positional transport avoids that resampling by relocating a historical patch's address rather than its content, but assigns full positional precision even to inaccurate projections. We present GLIMPSE, a global-local memory interface with band-wise multi-precision coordinates and geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation to reduce sensitivity to inaccurate projected addresses. Local patch memory supplies view-specific appearance, while recurrent global memory provides scene context. Footprint-guided retrieval selects historical patches under a fixed local read budget. Under matched retrieval and read budgets, GLIMPSE improves geometric correspondence and photometric consistency over deterministic positional transport.

</details>


### [107] [State-Isolated Vision Mamba via Update-Tendency Routing for Underwater Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13720)
*Yan Luo,Laibin Chang,Zefan Feng,Yi'ang Chen,Kui Jiang,Zhengguo Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出状态隔离（State Isolation）原则与IsoMamba架构，通过将更新行为兼容的token路由至独立Mamba专家，缓解视觉恢复中的状态争用问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Vision Mamba研究多聚焦token序列化、扫描策略或专家路由，忽视了状态层面的问题：如何为空间异构的视觉恢复任务组织循环状态。作者发现，将更新行为异构的token强行作用于共享隐状态会导致持续的内容间干扰，即"状态争用"（State Contention）。

Method: 提出状态隔离原则：按token兼容性而非token排序来组织状态演化，兼容的token在独立循环状态流中演化。实现为IsoMamba：Δ引导架构，构建模型内在更新表示，通过无标签聚类发现更新兼容的token组，并按"聚类—路由—隔离"范式路由至独立Mamba专家；同时设计动态通道重加权目标以补偿水下图像中波长相关的重建难度。

Result: 在多个水下图像增强基准上持续取得SOTA性能，并呈现更干净的隐状态响应。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了状态隔离式循环建模的有效性，为Vision Mamba的状态组织提供了新视角。

Abstract: Vision Mamba has recently emerged as an efficient alternative to convolutional and Transformer-based architectures by modeling long-range spatial dependencies through recurrent state evolution. Existing studies primarily improve token serialization, scanning strategies, or expert routing, yet largely overlook a state level question question: how should recurrent states be organized for spatially heterogeneous visual restoration? In this paper, we show that forcing tokens with heterogeneous update behaviors to recurrently modify a shared hidden state leads to persistent cross-content interference, which we term \textbf{State Contention}. We further argue that effective recurrent modeling should organize state evolution according to token compatibility rather than token ordering. Based on this observation, we introduce \textbf{State Isolation}, a new recurrent state organization principle for Vision Mamba,tokens with compatible state-update tendencies evolve within independent recurrent state streams. To instantiate this principle, we propose \textbf{IsoMamba}, a $Δ$-guided architecture that constructs model-intrinsic update representations, discovers update-compatible token groups through label-free clustering, and routes them to isolated Mamba experts following a \textbf{cluster--route--isolate} paradigm. In addition, we develop a dynamic channel-wise reweighting objective to compensate for wavelength-dependent reconstruction difficulty in underwater images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IsoMamba consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple underwater image enhancement benchmarks while providing cleaner hidden state responses, validating the effectiveness of state isolated recurrent modeling.

</details>


### [108] [LAPT-Scale: Scaling Embodied Policies with Latent Action Pre-Training on Human Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13732)
*Zhiyuan Xiang,Peidong Liu,Mingyang Li,Jiawei Li,Wenhow Li,Wenbo Ding,Xiang Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LAPT-Scale 可扩展潜在动作预训练范式,通过连续潜在动作从大规模第一视角人类视频中提供隐式动作监督,显著提升真实机器人操作成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人策略的可扩展性受限于具身交互数据采集成本过高;大规模第一视角人类视频虽富集,却缺乏机器人动作标签,且现有动作标注方法在真实视觉复杂性与多样操作动力学下噪声较大。

Method: LAPT-Scale 包含两部分:LAPT-Scale-LAM 通过解释人类视频中帧间视觉过渡学习连续潜在动作作为人类衍生监督;LAPT-Scale-Policy 经人类视频潜在动作预训练、目标机器人具身对齐与任务特定后训练得到 VLA 策略。区别于以往向量量化 LAM,采用连续潜在空间保留细粒度运动与交互动力学,并融合感知、语义与光流对齐信号以超越像素重建的过渡级监督。

Result: 在 23.3K 小时第一视角视频上训练,LAPT-Scale-LAM 为策略预训练提供隐式动作监督,带来一致的规模扩展增益:标注人类视频从 1K 增至 5K 小时时,真实机器人成功率由 63.3% 提升至 85.0%,且所学策略可泛化至未见视觉条件。

Conclusion: 连续潜在动作预训练结合多信号对齐,可将人视频有效转化为可扩展的动作监督,缓解具身数据瓶颈并提升 VLA 策略性能与泛化能力。

Abstract: Scaling generalist robotic policies is limited by the high cost of collecting embodied interaction data. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer a rich alternative, but they lack robot action labels, and existing action annotation methods are often noisy under real-world visual complexity and diverse manipulation dynamics. We introduce LAPT-Scale, a scalable latent action pre-training paradigm with two components: LAPT-Scale-LAM learns continuous latent actions by explaining frame-to-frame visual transitions in human videos and uses them as human-derived supervision, while LAPT-Scale-Policy trains a VLA policy through human-video latent-action pre-training, target-robot embodiment alignment, and task-specific post-training. Unlike prior vector-quantized LAMs, LAPT-Scale-LAM uses a continuous latent space to preserve fine-grained motion and interaction dynamics. We further combine perceptual, semantic, and optical-flow alignment signals to improve transition-level supervision beyond pixel reconstruction. Trained on 23.3K hours of egocentric video, LAPT-Scale-LAM provides implicit action supervision for policy pre-training, yielding consistent scaling gains and improving real-robot success from 63.3% to 85.0% as annotated human video scales from 1K to 5K hours. The learned policy also generalizes to unseen visual conditions.

</details>


### [109] [KVeil: First-Place Solution to ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13733)
*Boheng Li,Yueming Xing,Yiming Li,Jie Zhang,Han Qiu,Tianwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该报告介绍了ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge（Unlearnable Videos赛道）两个阶段的第一名方案，通过参考容量坍缩损失、运动引导EOT机制以及人脸/背景双层保护框架，在有限且不可察觉的扰动预算下实现对面部视频的有效保护，抵抗未授权定制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化视频生成技术快速发展，仅凭少量人脸视频即可在合成视频中复现某人身份，引发严重的身份隐私问题。该研究旨在在有限且不可察觉的扰动预算下，保护面部视频免遭未授权的定制（即防止其被用作参考条件来复现身份）。

Method: Phase 1提出参考容量坍缩（Reference Capacity Collapse），由一对互补损失构成，用于削弱参考条件所携带的信息，同时保持后续视频表示对其的依赖；并引入运动引导EOT（Motion-Guided EOT）机制以提升在未知推理条件下的鲁棒性。Phase 2进一步考虑基于微调（tuning-based）的定制和未见过的生成模型，设计双层框架分别保护人脸和背景区域：前者基于合成目标身份构建结构对齐的扰动，后者强化Phase 1的白盒破坏效果，从而以单一扰动同时应对两类威胁。两方案均基于作者近期工作LETHE。

Result: 在白盒参考定制场景下实现了近乎完美的保护效果，并在其他定制范式、多种模型以及时序攻击（temporal attacks）下依然保持有效。

Conclusion: 两个阶段的方案在有限且不可察觉的扰动预算内有效保护面部视频免遭未授权定制，其中Phase 2的双层框架可同时抵御基于微调的定制与未见生成模型的威胁。作者希望该方案能为面部视频隐私保护领域的后续研究提供启发，代码已开源。

Abstract: The rapid development of personalized video generation has raised serious concerns over identity privacy, as a few facial videos of a person now suffice to reproduce their identity in synthetic videos. This report presents the first-place solutions to both phases of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos, which aims to protect facial videos from unauthorized customization under a limited and imperceptible perturbation budget. For Phase 1, we introduce Reference Capacity Collapse, a pair of complementary losses that degrade the information carried by the reference condition while keeping subsequent video representations dependent on it, together with a Motion-Guided EOT mechanism that improves robustness across unknown inference conditions. Phase 2 further considers tuning-based customization and unseen generative models. To address both threats within a single perturbation, we design a two-layer framework that protects the facial and background regions separately, constructing structure-aligned perturbations from a synthetic target identity in the former and strengthening the white-box disruption of Phase 1 in the latter. Our method achieves nearly perfect protection under white-box reference-based customization, and remains effective under other customization paradigms, various models, and temporal attacks. Both solutions are built upon our recent work LETHE. We hope our solutions can inspire future work on protecting facial videos against unauthorized customization. Our code is available at https://github.com/AntigoneRandy/KVeil.

</details>


### [110] [Gaussian Splatting with Reflections Guided by What is Seen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13757)
*Yiming Liang,Tianyu Xiao,Hiroshi Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于2D Gaussian Splatting的框架，利用输入图像中直接可观测的环境信息，结合混合反射外观表示与视角相关高光建模，提升近场反射场景的新视角合成质量与几何精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NeRF与3DGS在常见场景表现优异，但难以捕捉视角相关高光效果，尤其是近场反射。已有方法中，环境贴图仅能表示来自无穷远的光照，环境高斯基元仅依赖反射的间接监督，均不足以精确建模此类效果。

Method: 基于2D Gaussian Splatting（2DGS）构建框架，利用输入图像中直接可观测的环境信息；并集成混合反射外观表示与视角相关高光建模。同时构建了一个近场反射数据集。

Result: 在公开基准和新建的近场反射数据集上，方法取得更优的渲染质量和几何精度。

Conclusion: 通过引入直接可观测的环境信息并联合混合反射外观与视角相关高光建模，可有效改善近场反射场景的新视角合成与几何重建。

Abstract: While novel view synthesis methods like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have shown impressive performance on common scenes, they often struggle with capturing view-dependent specular effects, particularly near-field reflections. Existing methods utilize environment maps, which only represent lights from infinity, or environment Gaussians, which rely solely on indirect supervision from reflections, are insufficient for accurately modeling such effects. Here, we propose a framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) that leverages directly observable environment information in input images. Our approach also integrates a hybrid reflection appearance representation and view-dependent specular modeling. Experiments on public benchmarks and a newly curated near-field reflection dataset demonstrate that our method achieves superior rendering quality and geometric accuracy.

</details>


### [111] [Neurons++: A Unified Visual-Stream Framework for Image and Video Reconstruction from fMRI with Neural-to-Visual Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13763)
*Haonan Wang,Yuchen Wang,Jingyu Lu,Qixiang Zhang,Lehan Wang,Xuanqi Huang,Xiaomeng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Neurons++ 是一个视觉流 fMRI 重建框架，统一支持静态图像与动态视频重建，采用皮层启发的串行解码设计，在标准基准上取得最优视频重建与有竞争力的图像重建性能，并展现出神经到视觉的可控性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从 fMRI 解码视觉体验对人类感知理解与脑机接口发展很重要。现有生成式解码方法虽能重建出可信图像与视频，但视觉逼真并不保证输出忠实于脑活动，因此需要既逼真又忠实于大脑信号的解码框架。

Method: 提出 Neurons++：相比会议版 Neurons，将范式从仅视频重建扩展为图像与视频的视觉流重建，并用串行、皮层启发的解码替代并行任务条件。模型先用图像-fMRI 预训练获得稳定的空间-语义初始化，再分别针对图像与视频重建进行被试特定微调；串行设计将 fMRI 表征组织为显式的空间、语义、语言层级与时间线索。

Result: 在标准基准上，Neurons++ 实现最优（state-of-the-art）视频重建与有竞争力的图像重建。神经到视觉分析表明：模型在神经扰动下表现出定性方向可控性；其 fMRI 编码器读出对刺激相关的皮层特征敏感；并支持 ROI 引导的语义调制。

Conclusion: Neurons++ 通过串行皮层启发解码与分阶段预训练/微调，统一了图像与视频的 fMRI 视觉重建，兼顾重建保真度与神经可解释性，代码与模型权重已开源。

Abstract: Decoding visual experience from fMRI is important for understanding human perception and developing brain-computer interfaces. Recent generative decoding methods can reconstruct plausible images and videos, but visual plausibility alone does not ensure that the output is faithfully grounded in brain activity. In this work, we propose Neurons++, a visual-stream fMRI reconstruction framework for both static image and dynamic video reconstruction. Compared with our conference version Neurons, Neurons++ extends the paradigm from video-only reconstruction to visual-stream reconstruction for both images and videos, and replaces parallel task conditioning with serial cortex-inspired decoding. The model first uses image-fMRI pretraining to obtain a stable spatial-semantic initialization, and then performs subject-specific fine-tuning for image and video reconstruction separately. The serial design organizes fMRI-derived representations into explicit spatial, semantic, language-level, and temporal cues. Extensive experiments show that Neurons++ achieves state-of-the-art video reconstruction and competitive image reconstruction across standard benchmarks. Beyond reconstruction fidelity, neural-to-visual analyses indicate that Neurons++ exhibits qualitative directional controllability under neural perturbation, that its fMRI encoder read-out is sensitive to stimulus-relevant cortical features, and that it supports ROI-guided semantic modulation. Code and model weights are available at: https://github.com/xmed-lab/NeuronsPlusPlus.

</details>


### [112] [Shortcut Learning in Geospatial Foundation Model Embeddings for Cross-Disaster Damage Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13766)
*Ali Shibli,Andrea Nascetti,Yifang Ban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究揭示地理空间基础模型在灾害评估中存在“捷径学习”，跨灾害域外评估下性能大幅下降，并表明简单特征级变换可提升泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理空间基础模型可用于灾害损失评估，但在熟悉灾害上的高精度可能掩盖捷径学习，即模型依赖事件或场景特征而非可迁移的损伤证据。作者希望探究这种偏差并检验模型在未见过灾害上的鲁棒性。

Method: 在xView2与BRIGHT两个多灾害数据集上，提取TerraMind、Prithvi-EO-2.0、DOFA和DINOv3的嵌入特征，采用留出整个灾害事件的评估方式（相比随机划分图像块）。设计四组测试考察：事件与采集上下文、灾前/灾后输入、建筑数量、图像配对正确性。并测试仅用训练灾害学习到的特征变换（监督对比学习、PCA等）对未见过灾害的泛化效果。

Result: 留出整个灾害使xView2平均平衡准确率从0.807降至0.638，BRIGHT从0.818降至0.568。灾前图像仍具预测性；仅凭标注建筑数量的分类器达到0.629（xView2）和0.653（BRIGHT）。灾前+灾后特征在xView2上平均最佳，但在BRIGHT上未优于仅灾前特征。同一灾害与损伤类别内打乱图像配对仅造成轻微损失。特征变换可提升泛化，xView2上监督对比学习最佳，BRIGHT上PCA最佳。

Conclusion: 在未见过域上评估对衡量模型鲁棒性至关重要；简单特征级变换即可改善跨灾害泛化，说明捷径学习确实存在且可通过特征层面手段缓解。

Abstract: Geospatial foundation models can support disaster damage assessment, but high accuracy on familiar disasters may hide shortcut learning: prediction from event or scene characteristics rather than evidence that transfers to a new disaster. We study embeddings from TerraMind, Prithvi-EO-2.0, DOFA, and DINOv3 on the multi-disaster datasets xView2 and BRIGHT. Holding out an entire disaster, instead of randomly splitting image tiles, reduces mean balanced accuracy from 0.807 to 0.638 on xView2 and from 0.818 to 0.568 on BRIGHT. Four sets of tests examine what information supports prediction: event and acquisition context, before/after image inputs, building count, and correct image pairing. Pre-event images remain predictive, and a classifier given only the annotated number of buildings reaches balanced accuracy of 0.629 and 0.653. Combining before/after features performs best on average on xView2, but does not improve over pre-only features on BRIGHT. Shuffling image pairs within the same disaster and damage class causes modest losses. Motivated by these findings, we test whether feature transformations learned only from training disasters improve generalization to unseen disasters. These transformations improve performance, with supervised contrastive learning performing best on xView2 and PCA on BRIGHT. Our results highlight the importance of evaluation on unseen domains for assessing model robustness and show that simple feature-level transformations can improve generalization. Code and experiments can be found at https://github.com/alishibli97/gfm-shortcut-learning.

</details>


### [113] [READ: Reading the Selective Scan for Faithful Video Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13776)
*Magdalena Trędowicz,Piotr Kubaty,Arkadiusz Lewicki,Jacek Tabor,Łukasz Struski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出READ，一种面向选择性状态空间模型（SSM）的无参数归因方法：在分类器读取位置展开递归，将循环状态中累积的贡献回溯到视频token，单次前向即可生成时空相关性图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选择性状态空间模型适合长序列视频建模，但其递归计算使得难以判断哪些视频token驱动了预测。现有归因方法通常需要额外反向传播或多次模型评估，代价远高于其解释的前向推理，且在相关性分布上存在系统性偏差。

Method: READ为无参数归因方法：在分类器读取（readout）的位置展开递归，将循环状态中累积的贡献追溯到贡献于最终预测的视频token。归因锚定于分类器读取处，输出单一的时空相关性图，可由此直接获得帧级与区域级相关性。

Result: 仅需一次前向传播，READ在忠实性与定位精度上即可与代价高得多的归因方法竞争；实验表明它避免了现有方法的系统性相关性偏差，并在不同数据集与主干网络上恢复出有意义的时间结构与类特定结构。

Conclusion: 选择性状态空间模型的递归机制不仅是高效推理机制，也可直接作为其预测的可解释证据来源。

Abstract: Selective state-space models are an efficient approach to long-sequence video modeling. However, their recurrent computation makes it difficult to determine which video tokens drive a prediction. Existing attribution methods often require additional backward passes or repeated model evaluations, making them substantially more expensive than the forward inference they aim to explain. In this work, we introduce READ, a parameter-free attribution method for selective state-space models that unrolls the recurrence at the position read by the classifier. READ traces the contribution accumulated in the recurrent state back to the video tokens that contribute to the final prediction. By anchoring attribution at the classifier's readout, it produces a single spatiotemporal relevance map from which frame- and region-level relevance can be obtained directly. Despite requiring only one forward pass, READ achieves competitive faithfulness and localisation compared with substantially more expensive attribution methods. Experimental results show that READ avoids the systematic relevance biases of existing methods while recovering meaningful temporal and class-specific structure across datasets and backbones. More broadly, our results show that the recurrence underlying selective state-space models is not only an efficient mechanism for inference, but also a direct source of interpretable evidence for their predictions.

</details>


### [114] [Detection of extremely rare dead cells in fluorescence microscopy images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13780)
*Prateek Verma,Benjamin Butter,Jian Zhang,Xintao Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统比较了启发式方法、分类方法和异常检测方法在荧光显微图像中检测凋亡细胞的效果，发现基于深度图像特征（ResNet-18）和传统数值特征（XGBoost）的分类方法表现最优，但该生物医学问题仍具高度挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 荧光显微图像中死细胞/凋亡细胞的自动检测对表型筛选和药效评估至关重要，但面临信号变异、光学伪影、多通道共定位模糊、核边界标记与凋亡标记在时空上不一致、标记积累动力学因细胞和凋亡阶段而异导致通用阈值不可靠等挑战。

Method: 在258张图像、65,527个细胞/核（含243个人工标注死细胞）的数据集上，系统比较三类方法：(1) 启发式方法（强度阈值、分布、相关性、领域指导）；(2) 分类方法，含数值特征（Logistic Regression、Random Forest、XGBoost、LightGBM）和图像特征（ResNet-18、EfficientNet-B0）；(3) 异常检测，含数值特征（Isolation Forest、one-class SVM、PCA重构）和图像特征（卷积自编码器、Deep SVDD）。

Result: 以PR-AUC、Precision、Recall、F1-score和macro-F1为评价指标，基于图像特征的深度学习分类和基于数值特征的传统分类表现最佳，其中ResNet-18和XGBoost显著优于人工设计的启发式方法和异常检测方法。

Conclusion: 该研究表明此类生物医学问题即使采用最先进的计算与学习技术仍具高度挑战性；研究旨在为科研人员提供有效的决策支持工具，可全自动或以人在回路方式辅助领域科学家解决此类问题。

Abstract: Dead cell detection in fluorescence microscopy is essential for phenotypic screening and drug efficacy assessment. However, automated identification remains challenging due to signal variability, optical artifacts, and colocalization ambiguities across multiple channels. Markers that define nuclear boundaries do not neatly coincide spatially or temporally with apoptotic markers. Furthermore, marker accumulation kinetics vary across individual cells and apoptosis stages, making universal thresholds unreliable. We present a systematic comparison of several computational approaches for detecting apoptotic cells in nucleus-stained specimens: (1) heuristic methods using intensity thresholds, distributions, correlations, and domain guidance; (2) classification using numerical features (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost and LightGBM) and image features (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0); and (3) anomaly detection, also using numerical features (Isolation Forest, one-class SVM and PCA reconstruction) and image features (convolutional autoencoders and Deep SVDD). Using a dataset of 258 images containing 65,527 cells/nuclei across multiple scenes with 243 manually annotated ground truth dead cells, we evaluate each method on metrics such as PR-AUC, Precision, Recall, F1-score, and macro-F1. Our results indicate that classification using image features (deep learning) and numerical features (traditional) achieved the best performance, with ResNet-18 and XGBoost significantly outperforming manually designed heuristics and anomaly detection methods. Our findings demonstrate that such biomedical problems remain highly challenging to solve even with the state-of-the-art computational and learning techniques. We aim to provide an effective decision-support tool to researchers while tackling such problems either fully-automatically or in a human-in-the-loop setting as an aide to domain scientists.

</details>


### [115] [SimVTA: Simulation-Grounded Video-Trajectory Alignment for Driving World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13781)
*Changhui Jing,Haochen Tian,Hongchen Li,Tianyu Li,Caojun Wang,Zihao Zhang,Yanhao Liu,Chengen Xie,Bailin Li,Hao Zhao,Zhenjie Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SimVTA是一种基于仿真的后训练框架，将轨迹优化与视频监督结合：用3DGS重建真实场景并渲染高奖励候选轨迹的未来视频，为GRPO规划优化提供与轨迹匹配的视觉监督，推理时无需调用仿真器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶世界动作模型（WAM）通过轨迹与未来观测配对学习，强化学习后训练可借助驾驶奖励探索替代轨迹，但驾驶日志仅提供记录轨迹对应的未来视频，替代轨迹缺乏视觉监督信号。

Method: 对每个观测采样候选轨迹，用真实世界仿真器（如World Engine）在3DGS重建的场景中为高奖励候选渲染未来视频，从而获得独立于模型自身预测的、与轨迹匹配的监督；在有限渲染预算下，优先为渲染候选中误差较高的未来提供视频监督；随后用GRPO优化轨迹规划，并对匹配视频施加流匹配损失以更新共享表征。

Result: 在NAVSIM v1上，将SimVTA应用于WAM初始化使PDMS从86.2提升至91.3（+5.1）；在NAVSIM v2上达到88.2 EPDMS；在HUGSIM闭环评测中平均HD-Score为38.8。消融实验表明，用视频监督更新共享表征可改善规划，而对高奖励轨迹中误差较大的未来优先监督可进一步提升性能。

Conclusion: 仿真渲染可弥补替代轨迹缺乏视觉监督的缺口，视频监督的共享表征更新与高误差未来优先策略均有效提升驾驶规划性能，且推理阶段保持无仿真器调用的高效部署。

Abstract: Driving world action models (WAMs) learn from paired trajectories and future observations. Post-training with reinforcement learning allows the policy to explore alternative trajectories and improve planning using driving rewards. However, driving logs contain future videos only for the recorded trajectories, leaving these alternatives without corresponding visual supervision. Thus, we introduce SimVTA, a simulation-grounded post-training framework that combines trajectory optimization with video supervision. First, we sample candidate trajectories for each observation and use a real-world simulator (e.g., World Engine) to render future videos for high-reward candidates in real-world scenes reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). This provides trajectory-matched supervision independent of the model's own predictions. Under a limited rendering budget, we prioritize video supervision for higher-error futures among these rendered candidates. Finally, we optimize trajectory planning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and use a flow-matching loss on the matched videos to update shared representations. At inference time, the model predicts trajectories directly, without simulator calls. On NAVSIM v1, applying SimVTA to a WAM initialization improves PDMS from 86.2 to 91.3 (+5.1). It achieves 88.2 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and an average HD-Score of 38.8 in closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show that updating shared representations with video supervision improves planning, while prioritizing higher-error futures among high-reward trajectories further improves performance.

</details>


### [116] [SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13832)
*Yuhong Liu,Shenxi Wu,Junyi Chi,Beichen Zhang,Xuanlang Dai,Jiaqi Wang,Yuhang Zang,Dahua Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"主动空间心智化"(ASM)概念，并设计 SpatialASM 框架，通过训练时的空间模拟将主动空间心智化能力内化到大型视觉语言模型(LVLM)中，在七个空间推理基准上提升四个 LVLM 骨干的性能，同时保持原有通用视觉能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类在解决复杂空间推理任务时会自然地重访场景、从任务相关视角进行心理重构，但当前 LVLM 缺乏这种主动的空间心智化能力。此外，空间思维链(CoT)监督数据稀缺，制约了主动视角探索与心理场景模拟能力的激发。

Method: 提出 SpatialASM 可扩展框架，通过训练时空间模拟将 ASM 内化到 LVLM。框架使用非自我中心(allocentric)的新视角生成器，将假设视角锚定到视觉证据上，并产生两种互补监督：i) 显式 ASM 轨迹，教导 LVLM 在空间推理中何时以及如何自适应地调用视角规划与想象；ii) 自动构建的视角采择任务，进一步强化以视角为条件的场景想象能力。

Result: 在涵盖从偏感知的空间理解到需要多图像、跨视角和视角变换推理的更具挑战性任务的七个基准上，SpatialASM 在四个 LVLM 骨干上均带来空间推理性能提升，同时保留其原有通用视觉能力，并提高了七个空间基准的平均准确率。

Conclusion: 实验表明 SpatialASM 有效提升了 LVLM 的空间推理能力。所合成的 ASM 轨迹为缓解空间 CoT 监督稀缺问题提供了可扩展路径，能够激发主动视角探索与心理场景模拟。该工作揭示了 ASM 作为视觉智能内在组成部分的重要性。

Abstract: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.

</details>


### [117] [Event-based Action Recognition by Pre-Training on Multi-Frame Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13856)
*Emma Norrby,Tomas Wilkinson,Per Nyblom,David Gustafsson*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多帧事件表示与掩码自编码预训练框架，结合稀疏感知掩码、token选择及位置感知注意力的多掩码token解码器，显著提升长时复杂事件序列的动作识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机能捕捉快速运动且隐私性优于传统视觉相机，使事件动作识别受到关注；但基于帧的事件表示在短序列上表现良好，面对更长、更复杂的事件序列时判别能力急剧下降。

Method: 1）引入多帧事件表示以替代单帧表示；2）采用掩码自编码框架预训练Vision Transformer；3）使用稀疏感知掩码算法与token选择机制，以提升下游性能并控制计算复杂度；4）在解码器中引入多个mask token，并设计位置感知注意力机制。

Result: 在长时、复杂事件序列上表现优异，于THU-EACT-50 CHL和DailyDVS-200数据集上取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。

Conclusion: 多帧表示配合稀疏感知掩码预训练与位置感知多mask解码器，可有效应对长时复杂事件序列的动作识别，验证了该框架的有效性与先进性。

Abstract: Action recognition is a crucial task in domains like robotics, patient monitoring, or surveillance. Recently, event-based action recognition has attracted much attention due to the event camera's ability to capture fast motions and its improved privacy over conventional vision cameras. While frame-based event representations work well for short event sequences, their discriminative ability declines sharply with longer and more complex event sequences. In this work, we introduce a multi-frame representation that greatly improves recognition performance over its single-frame counterpart. We adopt a masked auto-encoding framework to pre-train a Vision Transformer using a sparsity-aware masking algorithm and token selection mechanism to improve downstream performance and control computational complexity. We also introduce multiple mask tokens for the decoder with a position-aware attention mechanism, leading to further improved performance. Our proposed method shows impressive performance for challenging long-duration and complex event sequences, yielding state-of-the-art performance on THU-EACT-50 CHL and DailyDVS-200.

</details>


### [118] [Revisiting the Task of Building Damage Assessment by Satellite Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13857)
*Anthony Cioppa,Virgile Blua,Sébastien Piérard,Pietro Ceccato,Marc Van Droogenbroeck*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该章节从第一性原理重构建筑损毁评估（BDA）任务，围绕数据、评估、方法三大支柱，提出传感器无关、基于实例且容忍缺失灾前影像的任务定义，指出单指标聚合评估的理论脆弱性并构建基于排序的多分数协议，综述从专用深度网络到地球观测基础模型的方法并指出泛化难题，最后讨论BDA挑战赛的组织形式与数据共享机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地震、热带风暴与洪水等自然灾害对建筑造成严重破坏，快速可靠的损毁地图对指导应急响应至关重要。卫星影像自动化BDA已成为遥感、计算机视觉与机器学习交叉的活跃课题，监督式深度学习方法显著优于早期手工特征方法。然而经过十余年密集研究与多个大规模数据集的发布，该领域仍缺乏共同基础，任务定义、数据、评估与方法各行其是，亟需系统性重构。

Method: 本文为综述与立场性章节，按三大支柱组织：一是数据，厘清候选任务表述，主张采用传感器无关、基于实例且允许灾前影像缺失的定义，并按传感模态、时序配置与地理覆盖维度梳理现有数据集；二是评估，论证主流单一聚合分数在理论上不稳健，奠定基于排序的多分数评估协议基础；三是方法，从任务专用深度网络到近期地球观测基础模型进行综述，并分析其泛化能力。

Result: 分析表明：主流单一聚合评分在理论层面存在脆弱性，无法充分反映模型性能；基于排序的多分数协议更具信息量。方法层面，尽管任务专用深度网络与地球观测基础模型均有进展，但对未见事件与未见区域的泛化仍是未解难题。数据层面，现有数据集在模态、时序配置与地理覆盖上差异显著，缺乏统一基准。

Conclusion: BDA领域需要统一的任务定义与评估范式。本文提出的传感器无关、实例级、容忍缺失灾前影像的定义，以及基于排序的多分数评估协议，可为该领域提供共同基础。这些要素还可指导BDA挑战赛的组织，包括交叉验证、挑战赛与私有数据共享等设置，以在开发者与用户之间建立信任，推动模型在真实灾害场景中的可靠应用。

Abstract: Natural disasters such as earthquakes, tropical storms, and floods cause extensive damage to buildings, and rapid, reliable damage maps are essential to guide emergency response. Automating this task, referred to as building damage assessment (BDA), from satellite imagery, has become an active research topic at the intersection of remote sensing, computer vision, and machine learning, particularly since supervised deep learning methods were shown to outperform earlier handcrafted approaches. Yet, despite a decade of intense activity and the release of several large-scale datasets, the field lacks a shared foundation. This chapter revisits the task of BDA from first principles, organized around three pillars: data, evaluation, and methods. We first clarify the candidate task for- mulations and argue for a sensor-agnostic, instance-based definition that tolerates missing pre-event imagery. We then review existing datasets along the axes of sensing modality, temporal configuration, and geographic coverage. On the evaluation side, we show that prevailing practices, largely based on a single aggregate score, are theoretically fragile, and we lay the foundations of a more informative, ranking-based, multi-score protocol. We further review methods ranging from task-specific deep networks to recent Earth observation foundation models, noticing that generalization to unseen events and regions remains an open difficulty. Finally, we discuss how these elements can inform the organization of a BDA challenge, including cross-validation, challenge, and private data-sharing setups designed to build trust between developers and users.

</details>


### [119] [LapMerge: Differentiable Exact-Budget Token Merging in Linear Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13858)
*Magdalena Trędowicz,Aleksandra Nowak,Tomasz Steifer,Łukasz Struski,Szymon Płotka,Jacek Tabor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LapMerge：一种可微的等质量分段合并算子，将有序token序列压缩为固定N个输出，前向与反向均为O(M+N)复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉与语言模型的token序列越来越长，压缩token是降低下游成本的主要手段。但现有token压缩面临根本性权衡：选择式压缩会丢弃信息，而现有合并方法要么依赖成对token匹配，要么需要O(MN)的token-输出交互才能保留信息，且难以同时满足精确输出预算、端到端可微与线性开销。

Method: 提出LapMerge，一个面向有序序列的可微合并算子。它用学习到的质量分布，在Laplace核密度下将序列划分为恰好N个等质量段，再通过前缀/后缀扫描对每段进行聚合，从而前向与反向传播均为O(M+N)。预算N可在不改变算子参数的情况下调整，学习到的质量分布同时充当token级预算分配图。

Result: 在视觉与视觉-语言任务上，LapMerge匹配或超越强token压缩基线，且在大序列长度下最高快两个数量级；当token顺序反映空间或时间局部性时效果尤为显著。

Conclusion: LapMerge同时实现精确输出预算、端到端可微与线性复杂度，可作为即插即用压缩模块或可训练架构组件，适用于视觉及视觉-语言任务。

Abstract: Modern vision and language models process ever longer token sequences, and reducing them is the main lever on downstream cost. Token compression, however, faces a fundamental trade-off: selecting tokens discards information, while existing merging methods preserve it only through pairwise token-to-token matching or $MN$ token-to-output interactions. We introduce LapMerge, a differentiable merging operator that resolves this trade-off for ordered sequences: a learned mass distribution partitions the sequence into exactly $N$ equal-mass segments under a Laplace-kernel density, and prefix/suffix scans aggregate each segment, so both the forward and the backward pass run in $\mathcal{O}(M+N)$ time. This combination - an exact output budget, end-to-end differentiability, and linear cost - is precisely what previous reducers trade off against one another. The budget can be changed without changing operator parameters, and the learned mass doubles as a token-level map of where the budget is allocated. Across vision and vision-language tasks, LapMerge matches or improves on strong token reducers while being up to two orders of magnitude faster at large sequence lengths; it is particularly effective when token order reflects spatial or temporal locality, and works both as a drop-in reduction module and as a trainable architectural component.

</details>


### [120] [Make It Flow: Animating Water in 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13860)
*Kjell Keune,Florian Hahlbohm,Jannis Möller,Susana Castillo,Martin Eisemann,Marcus Magnor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种无需动态采集或物理仿真即可为静态3DGS场景添加流水动态效果的方法：从参考图像或渲染图估计2D光流并提升为一致的3D欧拉运动场，结合电影图（cinemagraph）启发的算法变形高斯原语，生成时间无缝循环动画，同时保持实时渲染与自由视点导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS等显式3D表示假设场景静态，限制了真实感；连贯运动（人体、车辆）可被重建，但流水这类高频效果在随意拍摄条件下（缺乏密集多视角、高速采集）难以捕捉。因此需要一种无需动态采集或物理仿真即可动画化静态3DGS场景中水体的方法。

Method: 1) 从参考图像或模型渲染中估计2D光流；2) 将其提升为一致的3D欧拉运动场；3) 提出电影图启发的算法，将该运动场作用于高斯原语的变形，生成时间上无缝的循环动画；4) 保留实时渲染性能与自由视点导航能力。

Result: 在新建的野外瀑布场景数据集上进行评估，在视觉质量和计算效率上均显著优于先前的动态高斯泼溅与3D电影图生成工作，并提升了感知真实感。

Conclusion: 该方法可在静态3DGS场景中实现视觉上合理的流水运动，无需动态捕获或物理仿真，兼顾实时渲染、感知真实感与自由视点导航，在视觉质量和计算效率方面优于现有相关方法。

Abstract: Explicit 3D scene representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently enabled high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis. However, these methods assume static scenes, limiting realism in the presence of dynamic phenomena ubiquitous in real-world environments. While coherent motion (e.g., humans or vehicles) can be captured and reconstructed, high-frequency effects such as flowing water remain intractable under casual capture conditions, where dense multi-view, high-speed acquisition is not feasible. We present a method to animate water in static 3DGS scenes, enabling visually plausible motion without requiring dynamic capture or physical simulation. Our approach estimates 2D optical flow from reference images or model renderings and lifts it into a consistent 3D Eulerian motion field. We propose a cinemagraph-inspired algorithm that applies this motion field to deform Gaussian primitives, producing temporally seamless looping animations. The resulting representation retains real-time rendering performance, significantly enhances perceptual realism, and preserves free-viewpoint navigation within the scene. We evaluate our method on a newly captured dataset of in-the-wild waterfall scenes and demonstrate clear improvements over prior work in dynamic Gaussian splatting and 3D cinemagraph generation in visual quality and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [121] [Tracking the Invisible: Self-Supervised Wheel Track Detection with Thermal-RGB Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13872)
*Yiming Yang,Jeremy P. Bos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种低成本自监督方法，利用同步RGB-I（RGB+长波红外）图像检测雪覆盖道路上的车轮轨迹，通过GNSS轨迹自动生成标签，并发布了ThermalTrack数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可行驶区域检测方法多针对一般通行性估计，在雪覆盖道路上表现不足。雪地行驶时沿既有车辙具有更高抓地力、可预测的车辆动力学和已验证的路径稳定性，因此车辙检测对安全至关重要。

Method: 采用自监督方式，将记录的GNSS未来车轮轨迹投影以自动生成训练标签；设计神经网络，输入4通道RGB-I（RGB+长波红外）图像来识别车轮轨迹，以应对白化、缺乏纹理的雪地路面。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在视觉单调、缺乏特征的不利环境下仍能有效检测车辙，为冬季自动驾驶提供稳健且低成本的替代方案。

Conclusion: 该方法实现了雪地车辙的低成本、自监督检测，并公开了ThermalTrack数据集（https://digitalcommons.mtu.edu/thermaltrack/）。

Abstract: Accurate detection of drivable area is essential for autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. While state-of-the-art methods focus on general traversability estimation, they prove inadequate for snow-covered roads where following existing wheel tracks offers crucial advantages: improved traction, predictable vehicle dynamics, and verified path stability. To address this, we propose a low-cost, self-supervised approach detecting safety-critical wheel tracks using synchronized RGB-I (RGB + Long-Wave Infrared) imagery. Our method automatically generates training labels by projecting future wheel trajectories from recorded GNSS data. A neural network is designed to identify wheel tracks with the 4-channel RGB-I images from challenging, white-out road surfaces. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in visually monotonous and featureless adverse environment, offering a robust and cost-effective alternative for winter autonomy. The newly introduced ThermalTrack dataset is available at: https://digitalcommons.mtu.edu/thermaltrack/.

</details>


### [122] [Beyond the Snowflakes: Disentangling Weather Effects from Confounding Meta-Factors in LiDAR Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13891)
*Yiming Yang,Jeremy P. Bos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在WADS-3D和CADC数据集上发现雪强度增加时检测精度反而提升，归因于降雪噪声被目标点云数量激增（几何增强）所抵消。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献普遍将降雪视为退化感知性能的大气噪声，但缺乏对目标级相关数据的细致评估，可能导致对检测器鲁棒性的误导性结论。

Method: 在WADS-3D与CADC数据集上开展细粒度评估，结合消融实验与元信息分析，将大气噪声效应与表面累积效应解耦；通过物理假设（雪堆积增大车辆表面积、镜面反射转向漫反射）解释目标点云数量提升。

Result: 检测精度随降雪强度增加而持续提升；降雪噪声的负面影响被目标点云数量显著增加这一主导因素所掩盖；该几何增强源于雪堆积与反射特性转变。

Conclusion: 基于宽泛天气严重度分档、未考虑相关目标级数据的评估会得出误导性鲁棒性结论；准确评估需解耦大气噪声与表面累积效应，并需后续研究验证相关物理模型。

Abstract: Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) is critical for autonomous perception, yet its performance is known to degrade in adverse weather. While existing literature models snow as atmospheric noise that degrades performance, our granular evaluation on the WADS-3D and CADC datasets reveals a counter-intuitive phenomenon: detection accuracy consistently improves as snow intensity increases. Through ablation study and meta-information analysis, we reconcile this by confirming that while falling snow acts as noise, its negative impact is outweighed by a dominant, concurrent factor: significantly increased object point count. We hypothesize that this object point count boost acts as a geometric enhancement, driven by snow accumulation increasing vehicle surface area and a shift from specular to diffuse reflectance. Our findings demonstrate that evaluating perception systems using broad weather-severity bins without accounting for correlated object-level data can lead to misleading conclusions about detector robustness. We conclude that accurate evaluation requires decoupling atmospheric noise from surface accumulation effects and outline future research to validate these physical models. The WADS-3D dataset is available at: https://digitalcommons.mtu.edu/wads-3d/.

</details>


### [123] [Where to Look Matters: Rethinking Sub-Volume Sampling in 3D Medical Self-supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13915)
*Junkai Liu,Le Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文指出3D医学自监督预训练中随机子体积采样隐含"所有区域等价"的假设，将子体积采样重构为"看哪里"的问题，提出即插即用的\method框架，用解剖感知、信息量和多样性引导的离线由粗到细探针库替代随机裁剪，并在多骨干、多任务上验证其迁移性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D医学图像自监督学习普遍采用随机子体积采样，但解剖先验与空间冗余使得不同区域对表征学习的价值本就不均等，随机裁剪忽略了这一点。作者通过控制变量的裁剪质量操控实验证明：更优的子体积带来更好的下游迁移，从而揭示"观测策略"是3D医学SSL中被忽视的瓶颈。

Method: 将子体积采样重新表述为"where-to-look"问题，提出即插即用的\method框架，用离线的由粗到细探针库（probe bank）替换随机裁剪，采样准则由解剖感知性、信息量和多样性共同引导。实例化两个变体：轻量的\lite版本使用几何与图像统计线索，诊断性的\feat版本使用冻结视觉特征，以检验轻量体积内在先验是否足够、以及更丰富语义线索能否带来稳定增益。

Result: 在多种3D医学SSL骨干与下游任务上的大量实验表明，\method-\lite相较随机采样一致地提升迁移性能。机制分析进一步将增益归因于：更符合解剖结构且更具信息量的观测、降低的空间冗余、更高效的学习动态以及更结构化的表征。

Conclusion: 子体积采样策略是3D医学SSL中被低估的关键环节；以解剖感知、信息量与多样性为准则的探针库式采样可稳定优于随机裁剪，且仅依赖轻量体积内在先验即可奏效。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning on 3D medical images commonly relies on random sub-volume sampling during pretraining. However, random cropping implicitly treats all spatial regions as equally worth observing, despite anatomical priors and spatial redundancy that make regions inherently unequal in their value for representation learning. To this end, we first show through controlled crop-quality manipulations that better sub-volumes lead to better downstream transfer, revealing the observation policy as an overlooked bottleneck in 3D medical SSL. Motivated by this finding, we revisit sub-volume sampling as a \emph{where-to-look} problem.
