On synthetic StVO question answering, our models demonstrate consistent relative improvements between 10.3% and 155.0% over baselines. Furthermore, relative to the established LexGLUE baselines (Chalkidis et al., 2022), our models improve over prior results on four of seven legal benchmarks. It also achieves consistent zero-shot transfer gains between 3.4% and 15.8% on Austrian driving regulations. These experimental results indicate that our training approach generalizes successfully beyond the initial training legal domain.

</details>


### [193] [Not Just an Evaluation: A Case Study of Discourse Particle Sensitivity in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13794)
*William Sheffield,Jiahui Chen,Amy Zhang,Alex Warstadt,Junyi Jessy Li,Kanishka Misra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过行为实验与机制分析，研究大语言模型在自然对话中对"just"和"only"两类话语小品词的敏感性，发现模型与人偏好一致，指令微调提升敏感性，且二者的神经表征呈非对称重叠，部分按语义组织。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 话语小品词（如"just"和"only"）虽频繁出现于自然语言，但因其效应微妙而不改变真值条件语义，长期以来研究不足。论文旨在探究LLM是否能捕捉这类细微的话语功能，并揭示其内部表征机制。

Method: 采用行为实验与机制分析相结合的方法：（1）比较LLM与人类对上下文中"just"和"only"出现的偏好及敏感度差异；（2）在有无小品词的条件下对LLM采样，评估模型对生成结果的似然评分；（3）通过定位模型中对颗粒敏感的单元（neuron/unit localization），分析"just"与"only"表征的迁移关系。

Result: LLM与人类在偏好上一致，均更偏好含小品词的表达，且对"just"比"only"更敏感；模型对含颗粒上下文生成赋予更高似然；指令微调在两实验中均提升敏感性；机制上发现非对称重叠——"only"单元可选择性迁移到排他性"just"，而所有"just"单元无论语义均可等价迁移至"only"。

Conclusion: LLM的词级小品词表征部分按语义（sense）组织，而非单纯的词汇形式。研究揭示了LLM对话语细微功能的敏感性，并公开发布代码、语义标注对话刺激及人类偏好标注数据。

Abstract: Discourse particles subtly shape the flow of discourse by reflecting conversational context and interlocutor attitudes, often leaving the truth-conditional meaning untouched. They are also often polyfunctional, with distinct senses which partially overlap with other particles; for example, the exclusive use of English "just" and "only" ("John only/just drinks water"). Despite the frequency of these words in natural language, they have gone largely unstudied due to the subtle nature of their effects. We investigate LLM sensitivity to "just" and "only" in natural conversations using behavioral and mechanistic analyses. First, we find that LLMs and humans similarly prefer the presence of these particles in context, and both are more sensitive to "just" compared to "only". Second, when sampling from LLMs with and without these particles, we find LLMs consistently rate generations as more likely, given their source context, demonstrating their particle sensitivity. In both experiments, instruction tuning increases sensitivity. Finally, we localize particle-sensitive units within LLMs and find the overlap between "just" and "only" is asymmetric: "only" units transfer selectively to exclusive "just", while all "just" units transfer to "only" equally well regardless of sense, suggesting LLM lexical-level particle representations are partially organized by sense. We release our code, sense-labeled dialogue stimuli, and human preference annotations at https://github.com/JiahuiKChen/Not_Just_an_Evaluation.

</details>


### [194] [REFLECT: Role-Aware Detection of Sentiment, Emotion, Politeness, and Formality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13797)
*Sangpil Youm,Annabel Stocks Natalias,Hayden Heninger,Leah Jones,Xiaoyang Jin,Xiaoya Zhang,Bonnie Dorr*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出角色感知Transformer架构，将情感、情绪、礼貌、正式性四个维度映射到语义角色标注配置并融入自注意力机制，在基准与真实数据上提升检测性能与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话中交际意义的检测不仅依赖词汇内容，还依赖参与者角色结构；现有方法依赖上下文语言表示，却将语义角色保持隐式，缺乏语言学理论支撑与可追溯性。

Method: 提出角色感知Transformer：将四类SEPF维度映射为理论驱动的SRL配置并直接注入自注意力；非方向性角色感知注意力建模情感与情绪的内部状态，方向性角色感知注意力建模礼貌与正式性的发起者到接收者关系；通过可学习门控将角色感知表示与上下文嵌入融合。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上，情绪、礼貌、正式性相较强BERT基线取得统计显著提升，且提升集中于理论预测情形（低频复杂情绪、高礼貌表达）；情感提升微小且不显著，说明情感更多由词汇选择承载；真实数据实验显示预测性能与模型可追溯性均提升。

Conclusion: 语言学驱动的自注意力改造能提升交际意义检测，可泛化至真实心理健康数据，并产生超越预测性能的可追溯、角色奠基的解释。

Abstract: Detecting communicative meaning in dialogue requires modeling not only lexical content but also the participant-role structures through which sentiment, emotion, politeness, and formality (SEPF) are expressed. Existing approaches rely on contextual language representations while leaving semantic roles implicit. We introduce a role-aware transformer architecture that maps the four SEPF dimensions to theory-grounded Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) configurations, incorporating these configurations directly into the transformer's self-attention mechanism. Role-aware attention models non-directional internal states (sentiment and emotion), while directional role-aware attention captures initiator-to-recipient relations for external cues (politeness and formality). The resulting role-aware representations are fused with contextual embeddings through a learned gate that adaptively weights how much role information each input contributes, rather than appending semantic roles as an auxiliary feature vector. Across four benchmark datasets, the framework yields statistically reliable gains over strong BERT-based baselines for emotion, politeness, and formality, with gains concentrated in theoretically predicted cases such as low-frequency, complex emotions and highly polite expressions; sentiment improvements are marginal and non-significant, suggesting that sentiment is conveyed more through lexical choice than participant-role structure. Additional evaluation on real-world data demonstrates that the framework improves both predictive performance and model traceability. These results demonstrate that linguistically grounded modifications to transformer self-attention improve the detection of communicative meaning, generalize beyond benchmark datasets to real-world mental-health data, and yield traceable, role-grounded explanations that extend beyond predictive performance to interpretability.

</details>


### [195] [Error Rate is Not Enough: Costs of Augmentation in Low-Resource ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13807)
*Katsumi Ibaraki,David Chiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究在四种低资源语言和英语的五个数据规模上，交叉比较了修改音频（变速扰动、SpecAugment）与修改文本转录并合成音频两类数据增强方法，从音素层面分析错误，发现二者通过互补机制提升低资源ASR性能，且互补性可由训练暴露度和声学属性在训练前预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源自动语音识别（ASR）中数据增强虽为标准做法，但其收益几乎仅以总体错误率报告，未解释方法为何、何时有效。作者希望揭示不同增强方法帮助ASR的具体机制与适用条件。

Method: 在四种低资源语言和英语、五种数据规模下，将两类修改音频的增强（变速扰动、SpecAugment）与两类修改文本转录并合成音频的增强方法交叉组合；在音素层面进行错误分析，并考察训练暴露度（词频）与声学属性对错误类型的影响。

Result: SpecAugment总体改善最稳定，但增加声调与腭化错误；基于文本的方法引入辅音插入错误；二者组合时各自减少对方引入的错误。声调和腭化各由单一语音学特性标记，且在训练中出现最少，基于文本的方法使词频分布平坦化，将其频率提高37–38%，从而逆转这些错误并进一步改善总体错误。组合方法的提升超过各自增益之和（超加性），但该超加性在100小时数据时消失。基于文本的方法的开销与收益关系在约10小时处出现交叉点，仅在低资源区间具有成本效益。作者还基于训练暴露度拟合了误差预测模型。

Conclusion: 不同数据增强方法对低资源ASR的帮助具有互补性且可预测；该互补性仅限于低资源区间，在100小时数据规模时消失。当特定错误类型重要时，建议依据训练暴露度和声学属性选择增强方法，且这两者均可在训练前测量。

Abstract: Data augmentation is standard practice for low-resource automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefits are almost always reported as aggregate error rates, leaving open why and when a method helps. On four low-resource languages and English at five data sizes, we cross two augmentations that modify existing audio (speed perturbation and SpecAugment) with two that modify text transcriptions and synthesize audio from it. We analyze errors at the phoneme level and find that they help for complementary reasons. SpecAugment has the most reliable aggregate improvements, but increases tone and palatalization errors, whereas text-based methods introduce consonant insertions; in combination, each reduces the errors the other introduces. This complementarity is predictable. Tone and palatalization are each signaled by a single acoustic property and occur least frequently in training (lowest training exposure), and text-based methods that flatten word frequency raise their frequency by 37--38%, reversing those errors while further improving aggregate error. The improvement from combining the methods exceeds the sum of their individual improvements; the superadditivity vanishes by 100 hours, limiting the complementarity to the low-resource regime. Where specific error types matter, we recommend selecting augmentation by training exposure and acoustic properties, both measurable before any training.

</details>


### [196] [Can Language Models Learn When to Abstain? Policy Learning and Calibrated Answer Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13821)
*Juan Terven,Diana-Margarita Córdova-Esparza,Ruben Gomez,Carlos Miranda Rocha,Julio-Alejandro Romero-González,Edgar Chavez-Urbiola*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在Qwen3-14B的事实性问答中，训练独立的答案选择器比原模型校准置信度过滤更能提升阈值平均效用，但跨数据集的可靠弃答仍未解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型需要判断何时作答、何时表示"我不知道"，本文探究该决策应由模型自身训练改进，还是由独立组件检查答案来实现。

Method: 在Qwen3-14B上比较两种方法：训练模型自身与训练独立答案选择器。使用鼓励正确、惩罚错误并允许弃答的评分，在三个训练种子和两个留出置信度阈值上评估；数据包括TriviaQA和NQ-Open，采用精确匹配评分，并辅以部分人工复核审计。

Result: 在TriviaQA上，学习式答案选择器优于原始模型的校准置信度过滤：平均覆盖率由20.2%升至30.9%，已评分答案的汇总错误率由23.0%降至14.5%；所测试的强化学习改动未取得一致增益。在NQ-Open上，选择器优于过滤但仍不如始终弃答。部分人工复核审计支持TriviaQA的结论。

Conclusion: 结果支持在此设定下学习答案选择，但跨数据集的可靠弃答仍是未解决的问题。

Abstract: A useful language model should know when to answer and when to say "I don't know." Can we improve that decision by training the model itself or by training a separate component to check its answers? We study both approaches on Qwen3-14B for factual questions, using a score that rewards correct answers, penalizes mistakes, and allows abstention. Across three training seeds and two held-out confidence thresholds, a learned answer selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the original model's calibrated confidence filter. On TriviaQA, mean coverage increases from 20.2% to 30.9%, while the pooled error rate among scored answers decreases from 23.0% to 14.5% under exact-match grading. The tested reinforcement-learning changes do not establish consistent gains. On NQ-Open, the selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the filter but still performs worse than always abstaining. A partial human-reviewed audit preserves the TriviaQA finding. Our results support learning to select answers in this setting while showing that reliable abstention across datasets remains unresolved.

</details>


### [197] [Task Context Shapes Component Roles in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13895)
*Sovesh Mohapatra,Dani S Bassett*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究以"共享脑区存在任务依赖性交互"为类比，提出语言模型的网络化计算视角；用相同图事实、不同任务对比固定组件，发现任务变化会重新分配注意力头的影响，并可用线性响应图预测后续头的响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在不同任务中复用相同的注意力头，但仅识别这些共享头无法解释它们在每个任务中功能有何不同；受共享脑区之间任务依赖交互的启发，作者希望从网络视角理解共享参数如何支持不同计算。

Method: 在5个开放权重模型（4个家族，1.5–14B参数）中，用完全相同的图事实（规定哪些有向连接存在的陈述）跨任务比较固定组件；测量干预对注意力头和后续层激活状态的影响（influence）以及对答案的影响（importance）。在Gemma-2-9B和Qwen3-14B中，通过激活编辑改变早期内部激活向量，使模型在指令固定时读取不同事实，并针对每个提示构建编辑前/后的两个线性响应图，用早期头测量到的变化预测后期头的响应。

Result: 任务变化会重新分配影响；在Gemma-2-9B与Qwen3-14B中，激活编辑可切换模型读取的事实，且相同头随后对不同图事实作出响应并产生不同影响。对另一项事实性干预，对应条件的响应图相较两图平均，将预测均方误差在Gemma中降低53.6%、在Qwen中降低5.0%。

Conclusion: 任务情境既改变共享组件响应的图事实，也改变其输出对后续计算的影响；网络化解释有助于说明模型如何用共享参数执行不同计算，任务依赖影响的测量还可指导"改变一种行为而保留其他行为"的干预。

Abstract: Large language models reuse the same attention heads across tasks, but identifying these shared heads does not explain what they do differently in each task. A natural source of inspiration is task-dependent interactions among shared brain regions, which motivate a network view of language-model computation. Here, we compare fixed model components across tasks using identical graph facts, statements specifying which directed connections are present. We measure how interventions affect attention heads and the activation state in later layers (influence), as well as the answer (importance). Task changes redistribute the influence in five open-weight models spanning four families and 1.5-14 billion parameters. In Gemma-2-9B and Qwen3-14B, an activation edit changes an early internal activation vector and switches which fact the model reads while the written instruction stays fixed. The same heads then respond to different graph facts and influence later components differently. For each prompt, we construct two linear response maps, one before the edit and one after it. Each map predicts a later head's response from a measured change in an earlier head. For a separate factual intervention, the map for the corresponding condition reduces mean squared prediction error by 53.6% in Gemma and 5.0% in Qwen compared with the average of the two maps. These findings show that task context changes both which graph facts the shared components respond to and how their outputs affect later computation. A network account may help explain how models use shared parameters to perform different computations. Measurements of task-dependent influence could also guide interventions intended to alter one behavior while preserving others.

</details>


### [198] [Structural Automata for Neural Semantic Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13896)
*Xiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将结构自动机引入DRS解析的三个阶段（解码、后处理、训练），提出接受路径解码（APD），在固定长度限制下保证输出可被接受且无需回退；同时在AMR上验证，解码、后处理与训练三方面均带来一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经语义解析器逐token生成意义表示，其合法性依赖生成过程中出现的引用、作用域与图关系。受限解码虽能阻止局部非法token，却无法保证在固定输出长度上限内仍能补全为完整合法结构，因此需要从全局可完成性角度重新设计约束机制。

Method: 在DRS解析的解码、后处理与训练三阶段引入结构自动机，并额外在AMR上评估解码：解码阶段提出接受路径解码（APD），在剩余长度预算内维护可验证的补全路径，优先选择模型偏好且仍可完成的token，从而在不回退token的前提下保证输出被自动机接受；后处理阶段分析无效输出的输入集中性；训练阶段对自动机拒绝的token施加惩罚。

Result: 在紧长度限制下，APD相对局部掩码在DRS上Smatch++提升5.1与2.4分，在AMR上提升6.4与3.2分，效果与同限制下的回退解码相当（后者需回退token）。后处理方面，无效输出集中于相同输入：数据有限时八个无约束样本对10.2%的输入无法产出有效结果，而全量数据下仅为0.4%，此时过滤法与APD仅差0.2分。训练方面，惩罚被自动机拒绝的token在训练10%后使开发集Smatch++提升3.6–11.0分，但随着训练推进，仅交叉熵即可将拒绝token概率从14%降至2%以下，该优势逐渐消失。

Conclusion: 结构自动机在语义解析全流程中具有价值：APD在固定长度约束下以无回退方式保证可接受输出并在DRS/AMR上优于局部掩码；后处理的有效性取决于训练数据规模；训练期自动机惩罚的收益主要体现于训练早期且随交叉熵隐式约束增强而衰减。

Abstract: Neural semantic parsers generate meaning representations token by token, yet well-formedness depends on references, scope, and graph relations that unfold during generation. Constrained decoding prevents locally invalid tokens but does not guarantee that a valid prefix can be completed within a fixed output-length limit. We investigate structural automata at three stages of DRS parsing (decoding, post hoc processing, and training) and additionally evaluate decoding on AMR. For decoding, we introduce accepting-path decoding (APD), which maintains a verified completion within the remaining length limit and follows the model's preferred token whenever that token can also be completed. APD guarantees an accepted output without retracting tokens. Under tight length limits, it improves Smatch++ over local masking by 5.1 and 2.4 points on DRS and by 6.4 and 3.2 points on AMR, comparable to rollback under the same limit, which retracts tokens. For post hoc processing, invalid outputs concentrate on the same inputs: eight unconstrained samples yield no valid output for 10.2% of inputs with limited training data, compared with 0.4% with full data, where filtering comes within 0.2 Smatch++ points of APD. For training, penalizing automaton-rejected tokens improves development Smatch++ by 3.6-11.0 points after 10% of training, but this advantage diminishes as cross-entropy alone reduces the probability assigned to rejected tokens from 14% to below 2% within the first sixth of training with limited data.

</details>


### [199] [When VLMs Destroy What They Know: Spatial Representations Fall Below Lexical Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13910)
*Shubh Garg,Chen Shani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly analyze and reason about images, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations faithfully encode the structured relations required for such reasoning. We introduce EICS (Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability), a metric for testing whether representations consistently encode concepts under controlled one-concept interventions, and CASP-VL (Causally controlled Spatial Perturbations for Vision-Language models), a benchmark of causally controlled spatial perturbations derived from Visual Genome scene graphs. Across multiple VLM architectures, we find that spatial relations are represented substantially less faithfully than lexical information, even when the same models score well above chance on compositional benchmarks. Further analysis shows that the relation is identifiable at the predicate's own tokens but is lost when the sentence is aggregated into a global representation, whether through the (EOS) token or by mean pooling. These findings reveal a systematic failure invisible to output-based evaluation: VLMs do not preserve, in the representation used downstream, relational information that is present in their own input.

</details>


### [200] [RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13912)
*Taoyong Cui,Pinxian Zeng,Wanghan Xu,Hao Xiao,Shuhan Xue,Qiang Gao,Wanli Ouyang,Pheng Ann Heng,Zhenfei Yin,Yingcheng Wu,Ling Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 RSI-Anything 通用框架，基于 JEPA-Anything 用预测世界模型指导动作与学习数据选择，实现跨领域递归自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）需将交互经验转化为持续改进，但外部反馈成本高，且随策略演化世界模型预测可能失准，限制了现有方法的可靠性。

Method: 构建领域通用的 RSI-Anything 框架（基于 JEPA-Anything）：以预测世界模型引导动作选择与学习数据筛选；观测反馈驱动策略/工作流改进及条件式世界模型适配；并通过组件与兼容性检查决定是否保留更新后的策略-模型配对。

Result: 代码修复：coder 固定时成功率由静态验证器 26.3% 提升至预测选择 29.2%、世界模型适配后 31.2%（测试用量相当）；GUI 任务完成率提高、平均动作数降低 39.4%；连续五个策略版本下实验室规划得分从 21.80% 升至 46.01%（翻倍以上）；反应优化在相同 40 次实验预算下取得 96.15% 平均最优产率，优于贝叶斯优化的 82.16%；并完成端到端免疫科学应用，连接工作流演化与预测建模及治疗假设生成。

Conclusion: 结果表明，预测世界模型与经保留的系统更新相结合，可在多样环境中实现递归式改进。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.

</details>

### [201] [On the Performance of Randomly Generated Codebooks in Near-Field Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12588)
*Akarsh Yadav,Ly V. Nguyen,James V. Krogmeier,David J. Love*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究近场通信中四种随机生成码本（RVQ、RP、RFF、RNF）的波束成形性能，推导了各类码本的增益分布与高增益尾部行为，并通过仿真验证了阵列尺寸与码本尺寸对性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近场通信中大规模天线阵列需考虑球面波前效应，需采用相应的波束成形技术。尽管预定义码本已被广泛使用，但随机生成码本在近场区域的性能尚缺乏研究。

Method: 对RVQ、RP、RFF、RNF四种随机码本进行分析：以已知RVQ增益分布为基准；对RP推导大阵列体近似并刻画增益分布的高增益尾部；对RNF刻画高增益尾部；对RFF推导远场波束服务近场用户时的最大可达波束成形增益解析近似及最优远场方向；并分析最大增益随码本尺寸的缩放规律。通过蒙特卡洛仿真验证。

Result: RVQ与RP随阵列尺寸增大性能显著退化；RNF具有最优的高增益缩放；RFF在有限码本尺寸下可优于RVQ和RP，但其最大增益因远场波束与近场信道的相位失配而饱和于1以下。

Conclusion: 码本结构、阵列尺寸与码本尺寸共同影响近场随机波束成形性能，研究结果为近场码本设计与选择提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Near-field communication with large antenna arrays requires beamforming techniques that account for spherical wavefront effects. While predefined codebooks are widely used in multiple-antenna wireless systems, the performance of randomly generated codebooks in the near-field region has not been investigated. In this work, we study four randomly generated codebooks for near-field communications: random vector quantization (RVQ), random phase (RP), random far-field (RFF), and random near-field (RNF) codebooks. We use the known RVQ gain distribution as a benchmark. For RP, we derive a large-array bulk approximation and characterize the high-gain tail behavior of the gain distribution. For RNF, we characterize the high-gain tail behavior of the gain distribution. For RFF, we derive an analytical approximation for the maximum achievable beamforming gain when far-field beams are used to serve near-field users, along with the corresponding maximizing far-field direction. We also analyze the maximum-gain scaling with codebook size. Monte Carlo simulations verify the analytical results and show that RVQ and RP degrade significantly as the array size increases, while RNF achieves the most favorable high-gain scaling. RFF can outperform RVQ and RP for finite codebook sizes, but its maximum gain saturates below one due to the phase mismatch between the far-field beams and the near-field channel. These results show how codebook structure, array size, and codebook size affect random beamforming performance in the near-field.

</details>


### [202] [Simultaneous Direct and Indirect Channel Estimation for RIS-Assisted MIMO Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12592)
*Daniel V. C. de Oliveira,Daniel C. Alcantara,Fazal. E Asim,Andre L. F. de Almeida,Gabor Fodor*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出TenDICE算法，用于RIS辅助MIMO通信中直连与间接链路的联合信道估计，基于扩展PARAFAC张量模型，优于LS与E-TALS，与KRF相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RIS辅助MIMO系统中同时存在BS-UE直连链路与经RIS的间接链路，现有方法（如LS、E-TALS）在联合估计两类信道时性能不足，需要更高效的接收机设计。

Method: 对接收导频信号建立扩展平行因子分析（PARAFAC）张量模型，并据此构造张量接收机，通过简单的交替最小二乘（ALS）方案联合估计直连与间接链路信道，即TenDICE算法。

Result: 以NMSE和频谱效率（SE）为指标，对比LS、KRF、E-TALS及理论CRLB。TenDICE优于LS和E-TALS，在估计直连信道时性能与KRF方法相近。

Conclusion: TenDICE是一种有效的RIS辅助MIMO联合信道估计方法，性能超越LS与E-TALS并接近KRF，验证了张量建模与ALS求解的有效性。

Abstract: This paper introduces an enhanced channel estimation method for reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) communications. Considering the presence of both the direct link from the base station (BS) to the user equipment (UE) and the indirect link \textit{via} the RIS, we formulate a tensor-based receiver for joint direct and indirect channel estimation called the TenDICE algorithm. The proposed receiver relies on an extended parallel factor analysis (PARAFAC) tensor model for the received pilot signals, from which the involved (direct and indirect link) channels are estimated using a simple alternating least squares scheme. The proposed TenDICE method is compared with the state-of-the-art least squares (LS) method, Khatri-Rao factorization (KRF) method, enhanced trilinear alternating least squares (E-TALS), and the theoretical Cramér-Rao lower bound (CRLB) based on normalized mean square error (NMSE) and spectral efficiency (SE). The proposed TenDICE outperforms the LS and E-TALS methods and performs similarly to the KRF methods while estimating the direct channel.

</details>


### [203] [Low-Complexity Tensor-Based Channel Parameter Estimation for mmWave MIMO-Assisted Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12604)
*Francisco I. T. Pires,Jean C. S. Ferreira,Fazal-E Asim*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对采用无源Butler矩阵波束成形的下行毫米波大规模MIMO系统，提出一种低复杂度张量信道估计框架，并推导CRLB，仿真验证其性能优于最小二乘且在中高信噪比下逼近CRLB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 毫米波大规模MIMO系统信道估计面临维度高、计算复杂度大的问题，尤其在Butler矩阵等模拟波束成形架构下，需要低复杂度且高精度的估计方案。

Method: 将接收信号建模为三阶PARAFAC张量，利用已知导频结构，通过双线性交替最小二乘（BALS）优化降低计算开销；对解耦的空间因子分别采用1D和2D ESPRIT提取到达角与离开角，并实现自动配对；同时推导该架构的Cramer-Rao下界（CRLB）。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所提估计器性能优于传统最小二乘方法，能够准确重建信道，并在中高信噪比下逼近CRLB。

Conclusion: 该张量分解结合BALS与ESPRIT的低复杂度框架，可在无源Butler矩阵波束成形毫米波大规模MIMO系统中实现高精度信道估计，且理论下界与仿真结果一致。

Abstract: This paper presents a low-complexity tensor-based channel estimation framework for downlink mmWave massive MIMO systems using passive Butler-matrix beamforming. By modeling received signals as a third-order PARAFAC tensor, we exploit known pilot structures via bilinear alternating least-squares (BALS) optimization to reduce computational overhead. The decoupled spatial factors are then processed via 1D and 2D ESPRIT to extract angles of arrival and departure with automatic pairing. Additionally, we derive the Cramer--Rao lower bound (CRLB) for this architecture. Simulations confirm the proposed estimator outperforms conventional least-squares, achieving accurate channel reconstruction and approaching the CRLB at moderate-to-high signal-to-noise ratios.

</details>


### [204] [Multistatic Terahertz ISAC for Object Shape Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12686)
*Ralph Kumah Assan,Suresh Singh*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何仅利用6G通信链路本身的太赫兹回波来推断物体形状，构建了融合PO/PTD散射、多径格点、分子吸收与定向天线的多基地前向模型，揭示了六种物理机制仅共享三个频率指数因而谱斜率不足以确定几何、角度分集为可辨识性必要条件，并对比2D-CNN与物理信息RBF-SVM，发现发射机数从1增至20时精度由约70%升至96-97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G网络预期用承载数据的同一波形感知环境，作者据此提出核心问题：在通信链路之外无任何专用感知硬件的情况下，从用户设备发射信号经物体散射后到达天花板接入点的太赫兹回波中，能学到多少关于物体形状的信息。同时现有研究常隐含忽略PO机制层级中谱斜率与机制对应的非唯一性，需明确角度分集对几何可辨识性的必要性，并评估机器学习方法在此任务上的表现边界。

Method: 在300 GHz载波、50 GHz带宽下构建基于物理的多基地前向模型，融合物理光学（PO）与物理绕射理论（PTD）散射、镜像源多径格点、分子吸收及定向喇叭天线；显式刻画PO机制层级中六种物理机制仅共享三个频率指数的性质；采用发射机数不变的2D-CNN与物理信息RBF-SVM进行对比，在训练中未见的物体朝向下评估，并考察不规则布放、有损目标、金属+准均匀布放、遮挡及多目标场景。

Result: 精度随发射机数从1增至20时由约70%升至96-97%；CNN在两种情形下占优——不规则布放与有损目标，而在金属目标+准均匀布放下SVM基线完全具竞争力；遮挡下性能渐降，四分之三表面被遮挡时保持78%，分类器从未见过遮挡目标时为63%；多目标场景受重叠回波间的干扰而非角度覆盖限制，存在检测在约4个发射机后饱和。

Conclusion: 仅凭通信链路本身的太赫兹回波可有效学习物体形状，但谱斜率本身无法确定目标所呈现的机制及几何，角度分集是可辨识性的必要条件而非可选优化；CNN与物理信息SVM各有适用区间，遮挡与多目标构成主要性能瓶颈，多目标受回波干扰限制而非角度覆盖。

Abstract: 6G networks are expected to sense their surroundings using the same waveforms that carry data. We ask how much can be learned about the shape of an object from the terahertz echoes that user equipment transmissions produce as they scatter from that object on their way to a ceiling-mounted access point, with no sensing hardware beyond the communication link itself. We build a physics-based multistatic forward model at a 300 GHz carrier with 50 GHz of bandwidth, combining Physical Optics (PO) and Physical Theory of Diffraction (PTD) scattering with an image-source multipath lattice, molecular absorption and directional horn antennas. The model makes explicit a property of the PO mechanism hierarchy that is usually left implicit. Six physically distinct mechanisms share only three frequency exponents, so the spectral slope does not by itself determine which mechanisms a target presents and therefore cannot by itself determine its geometry. Angular diversity is accordingly a requirement for identifiability rather than an optional refinement. We compare a transmitter-count-invariant 2D-CNN with a physics-informed RBF-SVM on object orientations never seen in training. Accuracy climbs from roughly 70 percent with one transmitter to 96-97 percent with 20. The CNN gains in two regimes, irregular placement and lossy targets, while on metal under quasi-uniform placement the SVM baseline is fully competitive. Performance falls off gradually under occlusion, holding 78 percent with three quarters of the surface hidden and 63 percent when the classifier has never seen an occluded target. Multi-object scenes are limited by interference between overlapping returns rather than by angular coverage, so presence detection saturates after roughly four transmitters.

</details>


### [205] [Generative Control of Time-Modulated Intelligent Reflecting Surfaces for Scalable Directional Modulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12773)
*Kailong Wang,Sida Xiang,Athina Petropulu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于Flow Matching的生成式框架，联合设计TM-IRS的开关参数，在保证合法用户可靠接收的同时实现对旁路的强扰乱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TM-IRS通过按设计时刻开关阵元实现方向调制，但参数设计需同时兼顾强扰乱与可靠接收。已有GFlowNet方法逐序离散分配参数，生成深度与阵元数耦合，训练慢，需改进。

Method: 采用Flow Matching生成完整连续配置，联合生成而非逐元序贯；针对OFDM信号设计物理信息奖励，在满足每子载波最小SINR约束下，最大化合法用户响应零空间内的时间调制谐波能量，且不需要已知对手方向；可对学习到的配置分布重采样以变化扰乱图样。

Result: 在3×3至12×12表面下，训练损失接近饱和所需时间较GFlowNet基线平均减少99.4%，最终奖励更高，可扩展到80×80，并将低误符号区域更紧密限制在合法用户附近。

Conclusion: FM生成式框架解耦生成深度与阵元数，加速训练并提升性能，为TM-IRS方向调制参数设计提供可扩展且可重采样的方案。

Abstract: Time-modulated intelligent reflecting surfaces (TM-IRS) achieve directional modulation by switching their elements on and off at designed instants and durations, so that an undistorted signal reaches the intended user while appearing scrambled elsewhere. We propose a Flow Matching (FM)-based generative framework that designs these parameters for strong scrambling and reliable reception simultaneously. For orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) signals, we introduce a physics-informed reward that maximizes the time-modulation harmonic energy radiated in the null space of the legitimate-user response, subject to a minimum per-subcarrier signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR), without requiring knowledge of adversary directions. Unlike prior generative flow network (GFlowNet) approaches, which assign discretized parameters sequentially, the FM model generates complete continuous configurations jointly, decoupling the generation depth from the number of elements and accelerating training. It also learns a distribution over configurations that can be resampled to vary the scrambling pattern. Numerical results show that, compared with a GFlowNet baseline, the proposed approach reduces the time to training loss near-saturation by $99.4\%$ on average for $3{\times}3$ to $12{\times}12$ surfaces, attains higher final rewards, scales to $80{\times}80$, and confines the low-symbol-error region more tightly around the legitimate user.

</details>


### [206] [Self-Calibration DOA Estimation for Moving Dilated Arrays with Gain and Phase Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12934)
*Kaiyuan Fang,Chengzhi Ye,Ruoyu Zhang,Shichao Wei,Wen Wu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该论文研究存在未知增益相位误差（GPE）的移动扩张阵列（MDA）自校准DOA估计问题，提出基于多位置观测相位对齐、运动诱导GPE约束、两阶段交替优化及RIL初始化的联合估计方法，并推导CRB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动扩张阵列（MDA）虽能提升均匀自由度（uDOF）并缓解互耦，但其性能易受未知增益相位误差（GPE）影响，因此需要研究MDA在未知GPE下的自校准DOA估计方法。

Method: 首先对多位置观测进行相位对齐，构造孔径扩大的等效虚拟阵列；利用GPE之间的运动诱导关系建立显式校准约束；基于导向矢量与噪声子空间的正交性，将DOA与GPE联合估计建模为约束优化问题。采用两阶段交替优化（AO）算法求解：第一阶段固定DOA闭式估计GPE，第二阶段用估计的GPE校准协方差矩阵并用MUSIC精化DOA。为进一步获得可靠初值，利用具有相同GPE的两个平移虚拟子阵提出类旋转不变（RIL）初始化方法，并推导CRB以刻画理论性能极限。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所提方法可靠收敛，并在不同阵列孔径、快拍数、GPE水平和信源数下均能实现精确的DOA估计。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的自校准DOA估计框架有效解决了MDA在未知GPE下的估计问题，结合运动诱导约束、两阶段AO与RIL初始化，实现了可靠的联合DOA与GPE估计，并通过CRB给出了理论性能界限。

Abstract: Moving dilated arrays (MDAs) can increase the uniform degrees of freedom (uDOFs) while alleviating mutual coupling, but their performance is susceptible to unknown gain and phase errors (GPEs). To deal with this problem, we investigate self-calibration direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation for MDAs with unknown GPEs. First, multi-position observations are phase aligned to construct an equivalent virtual array with an enlarged aperture. Next, the motion-induced relationships among the GPEs are exploited to establish explicit calibration constraints. By leveraging the orthogonality between the steering vectors and the noise subspace, the joint estimation of the DOAs and GPEs is formulated as a constrained optimization problem. To solve this problem, a two-stage alternating optimization (AO) algorithm is developed. In the first stage, the GPEs are estimated in closed form with the DOAs fixed. In the second stage, the estimated GPEs are used to calibrate the covariance matrix, after which the DOAs are refined using the multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm. To obtain reliable initial estimates, a rotational invariance-like (RIL) initialization method is further developed by exploiting two translated virtual subarrays with identical GPEs. Furthermore, the Cramer-Rao bound (CRB) is derived to characterize the theoretical performance limit of the considered system. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method converges reliably and achieves accurate DOA estimation under different array apertures, numbers of snapshots, GPE levels, and numbers of sources.

</details>


### [207] [Lightweight Time-Frequency Vibration Sensing for Consumer Device Condition Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13040)
*Po-Heng Chou,Jen-Yu Chiu,Chun-Yu Yeh,Wei-Lung Mao,Walid Saad*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级AI辅助振动感知框架，利用CWT与HHT将一维振动信号转为二维时频图，并用MobileNetV3-Small、ConvNeXt-Tiny和YOLOv11-cls进行故障诊断，兼顾嵌入式部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消费级旋转设备（洗衣机、空调、电风扇、扫地机器人、家用健身器材）依赖振动感知实现状态监测与预测性维护，但资源受限且实际运行存在干扰、信号非平稳，亟需高效轻量AI方案。

Method: 采用连续小波变换（CWT）和希尔伯特-黄变换（HHT）将一维振动时序转为二维时频表示；使用MobileNetV3-Small、ConvNeXt-Tiny、YOLOv11-cls三种轻量深度学习架构分类；在CWRU、PU、IMS公开轴承数据集上评估泛化；对比随机划分与数据集特定的结构化隔离以避免数据泄漏；统计精度、参数量、FLOPs、模型体积、预处理成本与CPU推理延迟。

Result: CWT结合YOLOv11-cls取得高诊断精度；MobileNetV3-Small在计算受限边缘平台上提供低延迟替代方案；结构化隔离与随机划分结果对比凸显数据泄漏风险，并量化了精度与各效率指标间的权衡。

Conclusion: 面向消费电子嵌入式部署的轻量振动诊断框架可行；方法选择需在精度与延迟、参数量、FLOPs、模型体积、预处理成本间权衡，且评估应避免数据泄漏。

Abstract: Consumer rotating devices, including washing machines, air conditioners, electric fans, robotic vacuum cleaners, and home fitness equipment, increasingly rely on vibration sensing for intelligent condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. Ensuring reliable operation in these resource-constrained appliances requires efficient, lightweight artificial intelligence (AI) solutions capable of processing non-stationary signals under real-world operational interference. This paper proposes a lightweight AI-assisted vibration sensing framework that employs continuous wavelet transform (CWT) and Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT) to convert one-dimensional (1-D) vibration time-series signals into two-dimensional (2-D) time-frequency representations. These representations are subsequently analyzed using lightweight deep learning architectures, specifically MobileNetV3-Small, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and the You Only Look Once version 11 classification model (YOLOv11-cls). Public bearing benchmark datasets, including Case Western Reserve University (CWRU), Paderborn University (PU), and Intelligent Maintenance Systems (IMS), are utilized as representative rotating components to investigate model generalization. The proposed framework is designed with eventual embedded deployment in consumer electronics in mind. Experimental results demonstrate that CWT combined with YOLOv11-cls achieves high diagnostic accuracy, while MobileNetV3-Small provides an attractive low-latency alternative for computationally constrained edge platforms. Conventional random splitting is also compared with dataset-specific structured isolation. The results highlight the importance of avoiding data leakage and quantify tradeoffs in classification accuracy, parameter count, floating-point operations (FLOPs), model footprint, preprocessing cost, and central processing unit (CPU) inference latency.

</details>


### [208] [Certified Outage Dimensioning of Fluid Antenna Receivers: Required SNR, Aperture, and Port Count](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13094)
*Yuanjun Shen*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究单用户下行链路中，固定发射天线、单射频流体天线接收机在给定中断概率目标下所需的信噪比、孔径与端口数。针对已知空间相关瑞利信道与理想端口选择，提出无采样的残差证书控制连续信噪比区间上的降秩中断误差，并用有界重要性采样将其转化为同时设计区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流体天线可通过在连续孔径上选择端口改善接收性能，但实际部署需明确：在给定中断目标下需要多大的孔径、多少端口以及何种信噪比水平，且端口数缩减带来的性能损失需量化。现有分析多依赖采样或缺乏对模型与采样不确定性的严格控制。

Method: 面向已知空间相关瑞利信道与理想端口选择，构造无采样的残差证书以控制连续信噪比区间上的降秩中断误差；利用正Bessel特征支持大阵列分析，并通过有界重要性采样将证书转换为同时设计区间；给出构造性慢增长秩界，并开展16–1024端口研究。

Result: 在1 bit/s/Hz、中断概率10^{-5}下，四波长、十端口接收机需4.40–4.55 dB；在联合95%概率陈述下，端口数由256降至十仅损失0.70–1.25 dB。在3.5波长处，十端口需4.90–5.05 dB。3–8 dB整数端口筛选展示孔径与端口需求随可用信噪比的变化，有效信噪比变换可将结论推广到其他速率。

Conclusion: 所报告区间在经检验的高斯协方差输入下涵盖模型与采样不确定性；构造性慢增长秩界与16–1024端口研究支持端口数增长时的紧凑评估，为流体天线接收机的孔径、端口数与信噪比设计提供可验证的定量依据。

Abstract: We study the SNR, aperture, and port count needed to meet a target outage in a single-user downlink with a fixed transmit antenna and a single-RF fluid antenna receiver. For known spatially correlated Rayleigh channels and ideal port selection, a sampling-free residual certificate controls reduced-rank outage error over a continuous SNR interval. Positive Bessel features support large arrays, and bounded importance sampling converts the certificate into simultaneous design intervals. At 1 bit/s/Hz and outage $10^{-5}$, a four-wavelength, ten-port receiver requires 4.40--4.55 dB. Reducing its port count from 256 to ten costs 0.70--1.25 dB under a joint 95\% probability statement. At 3.5 wavelengths, ten ports require 4.90--5.05 dB. Integer-port screening across 3--8 dB shows how aperture and port requirements change with available SNR; an effective-SNR transformation extends these decisions to other rates. The reported intervals include model and sampling uncertainty under checked Gaussian covariance inputs. A constructive slow-growth rank bound and a 16--1024-port study support compact evaluation as port count grows.

</details>


### [209] [LLM-Assisted Hierarchical Interference Control for Satellite-Terrestrial Integrated Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13108)
*Heying Cao,Hao Yuan,Xing Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分层频谱接入框架，结合几何干扰估计、QoS约束功率控制、自适应能量检测、LLM辅助候选排序、驻留/切换决策与目标频段选择，并配以确定性验证，以在保护地面网络的同时维持低轨卫星QoS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低轨卫星对地面网络产生的时变聚合干扰威胁地面网络保护，而过于保守的控制策略又会损害低轨卫星的服务质量，需在两者间取得平衡。

Method: 构建分层框架：基于几何的干扰估计、QoS约束功率控制、自适应能量检测、LLM辅助候选排序、驻留或切换决策、目标频段选择，并进行确定性验证；仅当频谱空洞条件与功率可行性条件同时满足时保留当前频段，并周期性重评估。

Result: 在300 s时域、0.5 s采样下，聚合干扰噪声比不超过-12.2 dB阈值，时间平均低轨链路速率达320.97 Mbps，QoS满足率100%，显著优于仅功率控制和卫星静默方案。

Conclusion: 所提方法能同时有效保护地面网络并保持低轨卫星QoS，优于对比基线方案。

Abstract: Time-varying aggregate interference from low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellites challenges terrestrial-network (TN) protection, whereas conservative control degrades LEO quality of service (QoS). This letter proposes a hierarchical framework combining geometry-based interference estimation, QoS-constrained power control, adaptive energy detection, large language model (LLM)-assisted candidate ranking, stay-or-switch decisions, and target-band selection, with deterministic verification. The current band is retained only when both spectrum-hole and power-feasibility conditions hold, with periodic reevaluation. Over a 300-s horizon with 0.5-s sampling, the proposed method keeps the aggregate INR from exceeding the $-12.2$~dB threshold and achieves a time-averaged mean LEO-link rate of $320.97$~Mbps with $100\%$ QoS satisfaction. It markedly outperforms power-only and satellite-muting in jointly protecting the TN and preserving LEO QoS.

</details>


### [210] [JEPA-kMMVAE: CSI Prediction for Time-Varying Wireless Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13315)
*Efstathios Chatziloizos,Konstantinos Vandikas,Aneta Vulgarakis Feljan,Zheng Chen,Nikolaos Pappas*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出JEPA-kMMVAE框架，结合联合嵌入预测架构与k记忆马尔可夫变分自编码器，在含噪历史观测下预测时变多天线信道的CSI，残差配置在中高信噪比下优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时变多天线信道的CSI预测需同时利用时间相关性并区分信道演化与观测噪声，这是核心难点。

Method: JEPA-kMMVAE：联合嵌入预测架构 + k记忆马尔可夫变分自编码器，通过时间结构化的隐表示预测未来CSI；支持直接预测及相对最新隐状态与含噪CSI观测的残差校正两种配置。

Result: 仿真表明，残差配置在中等和高输入CSI信噪比下优于所评估的基线；在更强噪声下，序列基线更准确。

Conclusion: 所提框架在中等至高信噪比区间有效，残差校正策略具优势，但强噪声场景仍有改进空间。

Abstract: This paper considers channel state information (CSI) prediction using neural networks for time-varying multi-antenna channels from noisy historical observations. The main challenge is to exploit temporal correlation while distinguishing channel evolution from observation noise. We propose JEPA-kMMVAE, which combines a joint-embedding predictive architecture with a k-memory Markov variational autoencoder to predict future CSI through temporally structured latent representations. The framework supports direct prediction and residual corrections relative to the latest latent state and noisy CSI observation. Simulation results show that the residual configuration outperforms the evaluated baselines at moderate and high input CSI signal-to-noise ratios, while sequence baselines remain more accurate under stronger noise.

</details>


### [211] [Towards Signal Processing In Networks: Multiplierless Block Transforms in Data Plane](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13324)
*Shota Ono,Marika Morikawa,Kazuma Kaneko,Junya Hara,Hiroshi Higashi,Shigenori Tani,Yuichi Tanaka*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出"网络内信号处理"(SPIN)概念，将去噪、分解、降维等信号处理任务直接部署在可编程交换机上，并以基于DCT的块变换作为初步实现，在Intel Tofino2上验证其满足严格硬件约束、可线速运行且延迟极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统信号处理任务在边缘或云服务器上执行，需从传感器传输原始数据流，导致边缘/云服务器处理负载沉重且带宽需求巨大。作者希望将信号处理下沉到转发路径，以缓解这一瓶颈。

Method: 提出SPIN概念，在转发路径上执行信号处理。初步实现为可编程交换机上的DCT块变换，采用提升(lifting)格结构重设计计算、无乘法器近似，并在可编程交换机内进行跨级流水线划分；在编译器层面验证其满足Intel Tofino2的流水线级数、包头条向量(PHV)与TCAM使用等硬件约束；并在BMv2交换机上用P4实现，作为网络内机器学习预处理的评估。

Result: 满足Intel Tofino2的严格硬件约束，实现线速处理。SPIN预处理在入口匹配-动作流水线中增加46个周期(1.5 GHz下约31 ns)，入口匹配-动作单元总延迟约87 ns，符合SPIN低延迟目标。在BMv2上以P4实现的实验表明，作为网络内机器学习预处理时，分类性能优于未滤波基线。

Conclusion: SPIN可在可编程交换机上直接完成信号处理任务，兼顾线速与低延迟，并能有效提升网络内机器学习的分类性能，为信号处理向网络数据平面下沉提供了可行路径。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a signal processing concept, signal processing in networks (SPIN), that executes signal processing tasks directly on programmable switches. Traditionally, signal processing tasks, such as denoising, decomposition, and dimensionality reduction, are performed on edge or cloud servers, i.e., raw streams are transmitted from sensors. This imposes a heavy processing load on edge/cloud servers and requires substantial bandwidth. SPIN addresses this problem by performing signal processing on the forwarding path. As an initial realization of SPIN, we implement a DCT-based block transform on a programmable switch. We redesign its computation using a lifting-based lattice structure, multiplierless approximation, and pipeline partitioning across stages in a programmable switch. We verify at the compiler level that the proposed implementation satisfies the strict hardware constraints of the Intel Tofino2--specifically regarding pipeline stages, packet header vector, and ternary content-addressable memory usage--and therefore enables line-rate processing. We further quantify the per-packet latency of the ingress match-action pipeline. The SPIN-oriented preprocessing adds 46 cycles (approximately 31 ns at 1.5 GHz). The total ingress match-action unit latency is approximately 87 ns, which remains consistent with the low-latency operation targeted by SPIN. Furthermore, we implement the proposed block transform on a BMv2 switch using P4 and evaluate it as preprocessing for in-network machine learning. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves classification performance over unfiltered baselines.

</details>


### [212] [Scalable Quantum Clustering of Renewable Profiles via a Hybrid Qubit-efficient Strategy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13336)
*Yifeng Cao,Chengjun Liu,Yijun Xu,Kai Wen,Wei Gu,Lamine Mili,Shuai Lu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文针对可再生能源场景聚类的NP难问题，将其转化为QUBO形式，并提出基于共识的变量约减方法CBVR以大幅降低量子比特占用，从而在现有量子硬件上实现可行求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模可再生能源场景聚类是计算上具有挑战性的NP难问题，量子计算虽提供了潜在解决途径，但当前量子硬件的量子比特数量有限，严重制约了其可扩展性。

Method: 首先将问题建模为QUBO形式；随后提出基于共识的变量约减（CBVR）方法：定制one-hot约束以消除分配变量，并利用共识分析将初始退火得到的稳定聚类关系转化为等式约束，从而进一步缩减变量规模。

Result: 在真实量子硬件上的实验证实，CBVR能够将超规模QUBO模型压缩至可行规模，同时保持较高的聚类质量与效率。

Conclusion: CBVR通过变量约减有效缓解了量子硬件量子比特受限的问题，使大规模可再生能源场景聚类在真实量子设备上变得可行，且不显著损失聚类质量与效率。

Abstract: Large-scale renewable energy profile clustering is a computationally challenging NP-hard problem. Recent quantum computing techniques offer a potential remedy, yet their scalability is severely constrained by the limited qubit count of current quantum hardware. To address this issue, we first cast the problem into a QUBO form and then we propose a consensus-based variable reduction (CBVR) method to drastically cut qubit usage. More specifically, we tailor the one-hot constraint to eliminate assignment variables and leverage consensus analysis to convert stable clustering relations from initial anneals into equality constraints for further reduction. Experiments on real quantum hardware confirm that CBVR compresses oversized QUBO models into feasible sizes while retaining high clustering quality and efficiency.

</details>


### [213] [ECGWmark: Deep Watermarking for Electrocardiogram Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13357)
*Kuan-Yu Chen,Kuan-Chen Wang,Yu Tsao,Jian-Jiun Ding*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: ECGWmark：面向医疗时间序列的全卷积、免量化深度水印框架，在连续全分辨率隐空间中以帧级局部机制抵抗时序失同步，并用可微生理损失（临床分类器引导）保持诊断语义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程心电（telecardiology）中ECG信号安全传输是难题。传统数学水印虽可嵌入患者元数据，但对循环相位偏移等时间失同步极其脆弱；面向音频等时间信号的现有深度水印多依赖有损量化，损害对临床诊断关键的高频微形态细节。因此需要兼顾抗失同步与诊断保真。

Method: 提出ECGWmark：全卷积、免量化（quantization-free）的深度水印框架；在连续、全分辨率隐空间操作；采用局部化的帧级（frame-level）机制提升对严重失同步的鲁棒性；引入由临床分类器引导的可微生理损失（Differentiable Physiological Loss）以保持诊断语义。在基准MIT-BIH数据库上验证。

Result: 在评估的循环时间偏移下，通道比特提取准确率保持在90%以上。严格的跨患者（inter-patient）诊断评估中，Class-V敏感度由71.97%变为76.50%，Macro-F1由35.25%变为34.71%，Class-S敏感度由8.89%变为1.39%；表明类别层面效果不一（mixed class-level effects）。

Conclusion: ECGWmark在免量化、全分辨率隐空间下实现了对时序失同步的较强鲁棒性，同时借助生理损失部分维持诊断语义，但跨患者诊断的类别级影响不一致，尤其Class-S敏感度下降显著，说明诊断保真性仍有改进空间。

Abstract: Secure transmission of electrocardiogram (ECG) signals remains a major challenge in telecardiology. While traditional mathematical watermarking can embed patient metadata directly into ECG signals, it is highly fragile against temporal desynchronization such as circular phase shifts. In contrast, existing deep watermarking approaches for temporal signals, such as audio, typically rely on lossy quantization, which compromises the high-frequency micro-morphological details critical for clinical diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we propose ECGWmark, a fully convolutional and quantization-free deep watermarking framework for medical time-series. ECGWmark operates in a continuous, full-resolution latent space and utilizes a localized frame-level mechanism to improve the robustness to severe desynchronization. Crucially, we introduce a differentiable Physiological Loss guided by a clinical classifier to preserve diagnostic semantics. Experiments on the benchmark MIT-BIH database show that ECGWmark maintains channel-bit extraction accuracy above 90% under the evaluated circular temporal shifts. Furthermore, under a rigorous inter-patient diagnostic evaluation, Class-V sensitivity changes from 71.97% to 76.50%, whereas Macro-F1 changes from 35.25% to 34.71% and Class-S sensitivity from 8.89% to 1.39%; these results indicate mixed class-level effects.

</details>


### [214] [Tri-Hybrid SWIPT with Reconfigurable Parasitic Antennas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13402)
*Thien Duc Hua,Mohammadali Mohammadi,Hien Quoc Ngo,Michail Matthaiou*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种耦合感知三混合预编码架构，用于基于可重构寄生天线的SWIPT，并给出低复杂度优化方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统混合预编码忽略天线间互耦与电抗性能量存储，导致阻抗失配、阵列实际接收功率下降，难以兼顾SE与NLHE。

Method: 结合多端口网络理论与信息论，设计第三级预编码层显式建模互耦与寄生电抗；提出三混合方案：坐标下降优化寄生电抗负载、SVD模拟预编码、保护性部分迫零（PPZF）数字预编码。

Result: 数值结果表明发射阵列存在阻抗失配，降低天线阵列实际接收功率；所提三混合架构构造性利用耦合效应，在SE与和NLHE上显著优于混合预编码，且硬件成本仅为后者的一小部分。

Conclusion: 耦合感知的三混合预编码可有效利用互耦与寄生电抗，实现低成本下SE与NLHE的显著提升。

Abstract: We propose a coupling-aware tri-hybrid precoding architecture for simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) using reconfigurable parasitic antennas. By integrating multiport network theory and information theory, we develop a third precoding layer that explicitly accounts for mutual coupling and reactive energy storage within the antenna domain. To efficiently optimize this architecture, we propose a low-complexity tri-hybrid solution comprising coordinate descent (CD) for parasitic reactive load optimization, a singular value decomposition (SVD)-based analog precoder, and a protective partial zero-forcing (PPZF) digital precoder. Numerical results demonstrate that the transmit array introduces impedance mismatch that reduces the real power accepted by the antenna array. Moreover, the proposed tri-hybrid architecture significantly outperforms hybrid precoding by constructively exploiting the coupling effects, yielding substantial gains in spectral efficiency (SE) and sum non-linear harvested energy (NLHE) at a fraction of the hardware cost.

</details>


### [215] [One Thing Leads to Another: The Essentials of Time Series Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13430)
*Kurt Butler,Damian Machlanski,Michael P. J. Camilleri,Zhihua Liu,Panagiotis Dimitrakopoulos,Feng Chen,Ricardo Silva,Sotirios A. Tsaftaris*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本教程综述跨研究社区的时间序列因果发现，统一梳理其原理、假设、局限、评估基准方法及在下游任务中的应用，并提供配套资源仓库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列因果发现源于半个世纪前的信号处理研究，现已在统计学、动力系统和机器学习等领域广泛发展，但研究格局碎片化且持续演进，进入门槛较高，亟需统一视角的综述。

Method: 以教程形式提供跨研究社区的统一概览：介绍现代发现方法所依据的核心原理，讨论其局限与假设，并阐述发现方法的评估、基准测试与微调方式。

Result: 梳理了时间序列因果发现在农业与地球科学、医疗健康以及人工智能系统等下游任务中的关键作用，并建立配套仓库汇总代码包与资源。

Conclusion: 该教程可作为导航近期大量因果研究的有价值资源，并呼吁信号处理领域研究者参与因果问题研究。

Abstract: Time series causal discovery --- the process of detecting causation between time series --- has its roots in signal processing research from over a half century ago. It has since received active and widespread interest, evolving into different forms across domains such as statistics, dynamical systems and machine learning. Entering this fragmented and constantly evolving research landscape can be daunting. This tutorial provides a unified overview of time series causal discovery across research communities. We introduce the key principles invoked by modern discovery methods, and we discuss their limitations and assumptions. We also discuss how discovery methods are evaluated, benchmarked and fine-tuned. We further discuss how causal discovery for time series is becoming crucial for downstream tasks in agriculture and Earth science, in healthcare, and in artificial intelligence systems. We believe that this tutorial will serve as a valuable resource in navigating the deluge of recent causality research, as well as an invitation to signal processing audiences to contribute to causal problems. To further help readers, we host a companion repository to link to useful code packages and resources at https://github.com/CHAI-UK/Awesome-Time-Series-Causal-Discovery.

</details>


### [216] [CNN-Transformer with Sigmoid Label for High-Resolution Sub-Degree DOA Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13433)
*Lifeng Wang,Xintong Li,Aifei Liu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种Sigmoid标签编码DOA为单调Sigmoid函数之和，配合CNN-Transformer与差分读出，在0.25°网格下突破网格量化误差，实现亚度精度与1°分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于分类的深度学习DOA估计将连续角度离散为网格，峰值读出的精度与分辨率受限于网格步长和标签峰宽，存在网格量化误差。

Method: 设计Sigmoid标签，将信源DOA编码为若干角度平移的单调Sigmoid函数之和；用该标签训练CNN-Transformer网络，并对网络输出求导，在信源DOA处产生尖锐谱峰；配合0.25°的适度细化网格。

Result: 在统一CNN-Transformer骨干下，将Sigmoid标签与高斯标签、0-1硬标签及BCE基线对比，Sigmoid标签精度最高、分辨率最优，实现亚度精度和1°分辨率。

Conclusion: Sigmoid标签结合差分读出可有效突破网格量化误差限制，在适度网格步长下获得优于传统标签的DOA估计精度与分辨率。

Abstract: This paper addresses the grid quantization error of deep-learning (DL)-based direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation. Classification- based DOA methods discretize the continuous angular space into a grid, so that with a peak-based read-out, the accuracy and resolution are limited by the grid step and by the width of the label peak. To address this issue, we propose a sigmoid label that encodes the sources' DOAs as the sum of angle-shifted monotonic sigmoid functions. Differentiating the output of a CNN-Transformer network trained with the sigmoid label produces sharp spectral peaks at the source DOAs. Combined with a moderately refined grid step of 0.25 degrees, the CNN-Transformer with the proposed sigmoid label attains sub-degree accuracy and a 1-degree resolution, breaking the limit of the grid quantization error. Under the unified CNN-Transformer backbone, we compare the proposed Sigmoid label with the Gaussian label, the 0-1 hard label, and the binary cross-entropy (BCE) baseline. Numerical results demonstrate that the Sigmoid label attains the highest accuracy and superior resolution compared to other labels.

</details>


### [217] [Blind and Asynchronous Initial Beam Acquisition and Clock-Assisted Re-Acquisition in Standalone Mobile MIMO-OFDM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13436)
*Ali Abdi,Firooz B. Saghezchi,Haris Gacanin*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于移动MIMO-OFDM系统的独立波束管理框架，将盲初始波束捕获（BIBA）与时钟辅助重捕获（CARA）相结合，并通过概率可行性分析与28 GHz mmWave测试床验证其可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动MIMO-OFDM系统中，波束对准易因用户移动导致链路中断，而传统波束捕获通常依赖先验同步或带外反馈信道，增加了系统开销与实现复杂度；同时链路中断后的重捕获时间较长，影响通信连续性。

Method: 提出独立波束管理框架：BIBA为盲且异步协议，无需先验同步和带外反馈信道，BS与UE可独立识别使接收信号强度最大的波束对；CARA利用BIBA后建立的时钟同步来加速重捕获。采用随机UE移动轨迹下的概率可行性分析界定两协议可靠性，并在28 GHz mmWave测试床上结合实际硬件约束（波束切换、TDD时延）及SDR软件处理时延进行验证；最后建立统一FSM模型。

Result: CARA相比BIBA可将重捕获时间减少约55%；两协议在随机移动轨迹下具有概率可行性界；在28 GHz mmWave测试床上，考虑波束切换、TDD时延及SDR软件处理时延等实际约束后得到验证。

Conclusion: 该BIBA与CARA集成的独立波束管理框架可在不依赖先验同步和带外反馈的条件下实现波束捕获与快速重捕获，并通过统一FSM模型保证其可稳健集成到实际无线系统中。

Abstract: Building upon our preliminary study, this paper proposes a standalone beam-management framework for mobile MIMO-OFDM systems that integrates Blind Initial Beam Acquisition (BIBA) with Clock-Assisted Re-Acquisition (CARA). BIBA is a blind and asynchronous protocol that requires neither prior synchronization nor an out-of-band feedback channel, so the Base Station (BS) and User Equipment (UE) can independently identify the beam pair maximizing received signal strength. To handle subsequent link drops, the newly introduced CARA protocol exploits the clock synchronization established after BIBA to reduce the re-acquisition time by approximately 55% compared with BIBA. The operational reliability of both protocols is bounded by a probabilistic feasibility analysis under random UE mobility trajectories. Protocols are validated on a 28 GHz mmWave testbed under practical hardware constraints, including beam-switching and Time Division Duplex (TDD) latencies, and measured Software-Defined Radio (SDR) software processing delays. Finally, we formulate a unified Finite State Machine (FSM) model for both BIBA and CARA to ensure robust integration into practical wireless systems

</details>


### [218] [Suppressing Multiple GNSS Interferers with Local-Gradient Adaptive Notch Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13443)
*Burak Soner,Felix Ott*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出局部梯度自适应陷波滤波器（LG-ANF），在级联NLMS-ANF基础上仅增一个参数，通过基带化+低通滤波重构局部带限梯度，解决同功率多chirp干扰下的梯度平均失效问题，仿真最高恢复13dB抑制增益，硬件实验延长定位保持24s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多干扰抑制方案是级联NLMS-ANF，但在多个功率相近的chirp干扰同时存在时性能显著退化，需要一种低复杂度改进来应对该病态场景。

Method: 在级联NLMS-ANF更新规则上引入局部梯度（LG）公式：将输入围绕当前频率估计下变频至基带、低通滤波、再上变频回原频，从而在自适应前衰减竞争干扰，构造局部带限梯度信号；仅增加一个参数（局部带宽/alpha_lp），并给出梯度平均失效的解析与可视化刻画。

Result: 在最坏的双chirp场景下实现独立chirp跟踪；以幅度比扫描对比标准NLMS-ANF、基于FLL的ANF及逐样本oracle上界：在病态幅度比附近经逐条件优化局部带宽可恢复约4dB带内抑制，特定边缘参数组合可达13dB（为LG增益上界）；在非病态区退化为标准NLMS-ANF；固定alpha_lp=0.5的硬件实验中定位保持时间相对标准ANF延长24s。

Conclusion: LG-ANF以极低复杂度（单参数）泛化了传统NLMS-ANF，专门修复多同功率chirp干扰下的梯度平均失效，在不损害常规性能的前提下显著提升抑制能力与定位鲁棒性。

Abstract: Adaptive notch filters (ANFs) based on the normalized least mean squares (NLMS) algorithm are an established technique for suppressing narrowband interference in GNSS receivers. The traditional solution for multiple interferers is simply cascading the NLMS-ANF into multiple stages but this solution degrades performance when multiple chirp jammers of similar power are present. We propose a low-complexity modification to the cascaded NLMS-ANF update rule to resolve this: a local gradient (LG) formulation: LG-ANF. The LG-ANF forms a locally bandlimited gradient signal by translating the input to baseband around the current frequency estimate, low-pass filtering it, and translating it back, thereby attenuating competing interferers before adaptation. The modification generalizes the traditional NLMS-ANF to handle the similar-power multiple interferer problem, using just one additional parameter. We characterize the gradient-averaging failure analytically and visually, demonstrate independent chirp tracking in the worst-case two-chirp scenarios, and evaluate statistical suppression performance by sweeping amplitude ratio against a standard NLMS-ANF, a frequency-locked-loop (FLL)-based ANF and a per-sample oracle upper bound. We further characterize the LG advantage over various ANF parameters and chirp conditions. Simulations show that the LG-ANF reduces to the standard NLMS-ANF outside the pathological multi-chirp regime, while recovering up to 4dB of in-band suppression around pathological amplitude ratios under per-condition optimization of the local bandwidth, and up to 13dB for selected edge-case parameter combinations. These optimized results represent an upper bound on the achievable LG gain. In a hardware experiment using a fixed alpha_lp=0.5, the LG-ANF extends position-lock survival by 24s relative to the standard ANF.

</details>


### [219] [HF Single-Station Localization via Multimode Ray Tracing and Time-Frequency Information Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13560)
*Qinglin Li,Wen Liu,Yun Ning,Zhongxin Deng,Junkang He,Mingshuo Liu,Chuangjian Xia*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文提出多模时频信息融合定位方法MTFIF-L，在传播模式未知且可能共存时，保留不同模式下的候选落点，并利用跨时间窗与跨频率的重复观测逐步约束，实现HF单站定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HF单站定位依赖DOA与电离层传播模型。当常规测向无法辨识传播模式构成时，同一DOA观测在不同模式下会产生多个物理有效落点，导致定位反演出现多解歧义。

Method: MTFIF-L不预先假设传播模式，而是保留各传播模式下生成的有效落点，利用跨时间窗的重复观测以及（若有）多个工作频率，逐步约束候选位置；并在四条实测HF链路上分别考察多模候选保留、跨窗处理和跨频处理的作用。

Result: 四条链路均得到唯一位置判决。链路A—C相对误差分别为1.40%、0.78%和3.41%；链路D为唯一单频案例，依靠重复时间观测也获得唯一判决，但定位后误差明显更大。传播路径分析显示各链路在反射层、跳数、磁离子模式和仰角上存在链路相关差异。

Conclusion: 重复时间观测可在单一频率内支持定位，多频信息则可提升对不可靠频率结果的稳健性；该方法能在传播模式未知且可能共存条件下实现HF单站定位，并保留可解释的传播信息用于定位后分析。

Abstract: High-frequency (HF) single-station localization estimates an emitter location from measured directions of arrival (DOAs) and an ionospheric propagation model. When the propagation mode composition cannot be identified from conventional direction-finding (DF) measurements, the same DF observation may produce multiple physically valid ground landing points under different propagation modes, making the location inversion ambiguous. This paper proposes a multimode time-frequency information fusion localization method (MTFIF-L).Rather than assuming a propagation mode a priori, MTFIF-L retains valid landing points generated under different propagation modes and uses repeated observations across time windows and, when available, multiple operating frequencies to progressively constrain the resulting candidate locations. Experiments on four measured HF links examine the respective roles of multimode candidate retention, cross-window processing, and cross-frequency processing. All four links yield unique location decisions. Links A--C achieve relative errors of $1.40\%$, $0.78\%$, and $3.41\%$, respectively.Link D, the only single-frequency case, also yields a unique decision from repeated temporal observations, although its post- localization error is substantially larger. Propagation-path analysis further reveals link-dependent differences in reflection layer, hop count, magnetoionic mode, and elevation angle among the ray-tracing paths associated with the measured links.Overall, the results show that repeated temporal observations can support localization within an individual frequency, while multifrequency information provides additional robustness against unreliable frequency-specific outcomes, enabling HF single-station localization under unknown and potentially coexisting propagation modes while retaining interpretable propagation information for post-localization analysis.

</details>

Mehrmohammadi,H. Raeis,A. Hameddine,G. Lajoinie,H. de Roo,M. Versluis,R. Zorgdrager,J. S. Au,A. J. Y. Chee,J. Cohen,T. Gu,J. Y. -H. Hsu,S. Ling,M. Mourtzakis,H. Nahas,P. de la Torre,D. Xiao,A. C. H. Katayose,X. Ma,R. Murakami,Y. Tang,R. Tsumura,Y. Wang,H. K. Zhang,M. Azizian,S. Huver,J. J. Dahl,R. J. G. van Sloun,W. Simson*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文介绍 OpenH-RF，一个约 40 TB、19,332 次采集、由 38 家机构贡献的医学超声原始通道数据开放数据集，统一数据格式并支持多任务，旨在降低原始通道数据使用门槛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动超声研究受限于大规模开放原始通道数据稀缺：现有公开数据集多为重建图像，少数原始数据又局限于单一重建或成像任务，难以支撑通用方法与基础模型；且像畸变校正、混响抑制等关键挑战必须依赖原始通道数据。

Method: 构建社区驱动的开放数据集 OpenH-RF，汇集约 40 TB 医学超声原始通道数据，覆盖 19,332 次采集、38 家学术与工业机构，包含在体、体模与仿真数据；为每个数据集标注支持任务，并采用统一、自包含的数据格式，封装原始通道数据及采集、探头、元数据与重建信息，支持跨扫描仪与采集方案的可复现处理，数据以 CC BY 4.0 许可公开托管并可编程流式、按需大规模读取。

Result: 形成大规模、异构统一的超声原始通道数据语料，支持广义重建、声速估计、畸变校正、血流成像、运动估计、定量超声与图像解读等多类任务，并通过现代数据基础设施实现可扩展的流式与选择性访问。

Conclusion: OpenH-RF 通过将异构超声数据纳入统一表示并提供现代数据基础设施，降低了使用原始通道数据的门槛，有望向新研究群体开放医学超声研究。网址：https://open-h.github.io/OpenH-RF。

Abstract: Medical ultrasound is a widely accessible, real-time imaging modality, yet progress in data-driven ultrasound research is constrained by the scarcity of large, open collections of raw channel data. Existing public datasets are predominantly based on reconstructed images, while the smaller number of open raw channel datasets is generally specialized to individual reconstruction or imaging tasks, limiting the development of general-purpose methods and foundation models that operate directly on ultrasound signals. While interpretive tasks can be performed on reconstructed images, many of the key technical challenges in ultrasound imaging, such as aberration correction and reverberation reduction, require the raw channel data itself. We introduce OpenH-RF, a community-driven open dataset initiative comprising approximately 40 TB of medical ultrasound raw channel data in 19,332 acquisitions, contributed by 38 institutions across academia and industry, spanning in-vivo, phantom, and simulated data. Each dataset is annotated with a number of supported tasks, ranging from generalized reconstruction, speed-of-sound estimation, and aberration correction to blood flow imaging, motion estimation, quantitative ultrasound, and image interpretation. OpenH-RF provides a unified, self-contained data format that captures raw channel data together with the acquisition, probe, metadata, and reconstruction information required for reproducible processing across scanners and acquisition schemes. The corpus is publicly hosted under a permissive CC BY 4.0 license and can be streamed programmatically and selectively at scale. By bringing heterogeneous ultrasound data into a common representation, backed by modern data infrastructure, OpenH-RF lowers the barrier to working with raw channel data and aims to open medical ultrasound research to new communities. See https://open-h.github.io/OpenH-RF.

</details>

### [221] [Algebraic Integer Quantization for Machine Learning Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12494)
*Anthony Kostal-Vazquez,Vassil Dimitrov,Branden Butler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出代数整数数值格式(AINF)作为高可配置、高精度压缩计算框架，并基于此引入代数整数量化(AIQ)用于大语言模型推理的有损压缩，精度与MX格式相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 浮点与定点格式在压缩计算中受限于其数值表示，难以针对具体用例的数值特性进行优化，且难以兼顾精度与高效计算。

Method: 提出代数整数数值格式(AINF)，其关键特性是可直接归约为纯整数运算，实现无误差的乘累加操作；据此开发矩阵乘法引擎；并引入代数整数量化(AIQ)作为LLM推理的有损压缩格式，实验中采用二次代数整数。

Result: 矩阵乘法引擎性能处于现代硬件加速器上最高效数值对应方案的可预测倍数范围内；AIQ在等价每参比特预算下，在多种模型和基准上达到与行业标准MX格式相当的精度。

Conclusion: AINF可提供浮点/定点格式所不具备的优化自由度，AIQ在LLM推理压缩中表现具竞争力；高阶及多维代数整数的推广有望带来更大计算优势，是未来有价值的研究方向。

Abstract: In this article, we propose algebraic integer number formats (AINF) as a framework for highly configurable and accurate compressed computation. A key property of AINF is its straightforward reduction to purely integer arithmetic, enabling error-free multiply-accumulate operations. We develop a matrix multiplication engine that exploits this property, obtaining performance within a predictable factor of the most efficient numerical counterparts on modern hardware accelerators. Another key advantage of AIQ is the freedom to select algebraic integers tailored to the numerical characteristics of a given use case, offering optimization opportunities that are fundamentally unavailable in floating-point or fixed-point formats. Motivated by these properties, we introduce algebraic integer quantization (AIQ), a lossy compression format for large language model (LLM) inference, and provide results demonstrating that AIQ achieves competitive accuracy compared to the industry-standard MX format across a diverse set of models and benchmarks at equivalent bit-per-parameter budgets. The experiments presented in this article employ algebraic integers of degree two (quadratic integers); generalizations to higher-order and, in particular, multidimensional algebraic integers promise even greater computational advantages and remain a promising direction for future work.

</details>


### [222] [Kairos: Toward a Byte-Level Foundation Model for Every Modality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12495)
*Fabien Furfaro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Kairos是一个面向单机训练的小型语言模型架构，融合双向门控DeltaNet线性注意力、滑动窗口注意力、MoE前馈层及多尺度字节级编解码器。本文通过单句过拟合的收敛性检查验证其优化可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单机训练的小型语言模型架构试错空间有限，作者希望先验证架构组合能否正常优化，再考虑其实际用途。

Method: 采用LiZAttention2（双向门控DeltaNet线性注意力+共享投影上的滑动窗口注意力）、块级注意力-残差聚合、稀疏MoE前馈层和多尺度字节级编解码器，在多模态共享字节空间上以均匀噪声去噪目标训练；在1–15M参数、单句440字节文本上做过拟合收敛检验，codec与注意力选择用3个随机种子，另7个因素单次扫描。

Result: 两个注意力变体在3000步时最小损失接近10^-3；600步后平均最小损失从0.018（patch codec）到0.354（深度卷积codec），三个种子排序一致。共享投影优于独立投影的表象随步数或数据多样性增加而消失，冻结投影时甚至反转，属收敛速度效应而非容量效应。

Conclusion: 这些检查表明实现可以正常优化，但不能说明泛化性、多模态训练或与现有模型的对比，需靠计划中的预训练实验回答；讨论中对200M总参/25M激活目标的规模估算为解析推导，吞吐量数据均未实测。

Abstract: Small language models trained on a single local machine leave little room for architectural trial and error. Kairos combines bidirectional gated-DeltaNet linear attention and sliding-window attention over shared projections (LiZAttention2), block-wise Attention-Residual aggregation, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward layer and a multi-scale byte-level codec, trained with a uniform-noise denoising objective over one byte space shared by text, image, audio, video, lidar and control streams; this report asks whether the combination optimizes at all before asking whether it is useful. We give code-derived algorithms for each component, including a cross-session recurrent-state memory gate, then run convergence sanity checks: overfittinga single 440-byte sentence at 1--15M parameters, text only, with three seeds for codec and attention choices and single-run sweeps for seven further factors. The two attention variants tested at 3\,000 steps (LiZAttention2 and window attention alone) reach a minimum loss near $10^{-3}$. After 600 steps, the mean minimum loss ranges from 0.018 (patch codec) to 0.354 (depthwise convolutional codec) with an identical ranking on three seeds. An apparent advantage of shared over separate attention projections closes with more steps or more diverse data and reverses when the projections are frozen: it is a convergence-speed effect, not a capacity effect. These checks suggest that the implementation optimizes; they say nothing about generalization, multimodal training or comparison with existing models, which a planned pretraining run is meant to address. The Discussion sizes a 200M-total/25M-active target analytically; none of its throughput figures is measured. Code is available at https://github.com/fabienfrfr/Kairos . Python package at https://pypi.org/project/kairos-fm/ .

</details>


### [223] [An Input-Dependent Readout Phase for Resonant Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12496)
*Shivesh Rane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将ResonatorLM固定读出的相位改为随当前token变化，仅增加0.2%参数且保持精确卷积；训练长度内性能持平，外推至4倍长度时困惑度从12.81降至3.76。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定状态序列模型存在设计权衡：输入依赖的状态转移能获得内容相关的记忆，但须以FFT训练为代价；固定转移保留O(T log T)卷积路径，却对每个输入以相同方式读取记忆。作者希望在保持卷积精确性与低成本的前提下，为读出环节引入输入依赖性，以解决固定读出在训练长度之外的失效问题。

Method: 以ResonatorLM（通过每头固定学习相位读取阻尼复振荡器组）为基础，将读出相位改为当前token的函数：仅对readout引入输入依赖，保持卷积精确，参数增加0.2%。并对未训练振荡器组进行分析，考察相位是否编码经过时间。在WikiText-2上训练6M参数级字符级模型，训练长度256、测试长度1024。

Result: 未训练振荡器组分析显示相位确实编码经过时间，但普通token在2-8步内即低于背景，且无论怎样选择阻尼，线性重构都无法超过约16个token。实验中输入依赖相位在训练长度上与原模型持平，并消除其外推失败：训练256、测试1024时困惑度由12.81降至3.76。失败可归因于长记忆头累积了超出训练所暴露范围的历史。学习到的相位跟踪的是当前字符而非距离，且未改善检索。

Conclusion: 仅在读出端引入token依赖相位即可在几乎不增加参数、不牺牲卷积效率的情况下，显著提升固定状态序列模型的长度外推能力；但其收益来自避免长记忆头过度累积历史，而非提升基于距离的检索，相位学到的仍是内容而非时间距离。

Abstract: Sequence models with a fixed-size state avoid the quadratic cost of attention, but face a design choice. An input-dependent state transition gives content-dependent memory at the cost of FFT-based training, while a fixed transition keeps the O(T log T) convolutional path but reads memory the same way for every input. ResonatorLM, a recent model of the second kind, reads a bank of damped complex oscillators through a fixed learned phase per head. We make that readout phase a function of the current token, which adds input dependence to the read only, keeps the convolution exact, and costs 0.2 percent more parameters. An analysis of the untrained bank shows that phase does encode elapsed time, but an ordinary token falls below the background within 2-8 steps and no choice of damping extends linear reconstruction beyond about 16 tokens. In 6M-parameter character-level models on WikiText-2, the input-dependent phase matches the original at the training length and removes its failure beyond it: trained on 256 tokens and tested on 1024, perplexity falls from 12.81 to 3.76. We trace the failure to long-memory heads that accumulate more history than training exposed them to. The learned phase tracks the current character rather than distance and does not improve retrieval.

</details>


### [224] [Rethinking Neural Nonlinearity as Gating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03148)
*Muhammad Sabih,Frank Hannig,Jürgen Teich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出阈值门控（TG）作为统一激活原语，证明标准激活（ReLU、GELU等）均可由TG实例化，并验证其在CNN、Transformer、RNN上的无损转换与硬件优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活函数通常被视为实现神经网络非线性与通用逼近能力的必要原语，但不同激活形式各异，缺乏统一且利于硬件实现的表述，同时模拟存内计算中ADC/DAC成为功耗与面积瓶颈。

Method: 作者将非线性归约为输入条件化的分支阈值门控原语TG，证明分段线性（ReLU、PReLU、Hardtanh）与光滑（SiLU、Sigmoid、Tanh、GELU）激活均为TG的实例；对Softmax通过其逐元素Sigmoid等价形式给出精确TG转换。并在CNN、Transformer及循环结构上对预训练网络进行转换验证；提出"最小分支定理"关联原语所需最小分支数与深层网络可训练性。

Result: 转换预训练网络无需重训练即可保持模型性能；从头训练时TG在模型压缩、性能提升与缩短训练时间方面有增益；在模拟存内系统中TG可映射为统一实现，缓解ADC/DAC瓶颈。

Conclusion: 阈值门控可作为统一且可通用的非线性原语，替代多种标准激活并支持等价转换与再训练，兼具算法性能收益与硬件实现优势。

Abstract: Activation functions are considered an essential primitive for neural nonlinearity, i.e., they enable neural networks to serve as universal approximators. In this paper, we show that this nonlinearity can also be achieved by input-conditioned threshold gating through branches as a universal primitive. We demonstrate that standard activations -- whether piecewise-linear (ReLU, PReLU, Hardtanh) or smooth (SiLU, Sigmoid, Tanh, GELU) -- are in fact instances of a single Threshold Gating (TG) primitive. For softmax, we show that it admits an exact TG conversion via its equivalent per-element Sigmoid form. We then validate these equivalences by converting pretrained networks across CNNs, transformer-based models, and recurrent architectures, preserving model performance without requiring retraining. Threshold Gating also enables training from scratch that goes beyond replacing existing activations, enabling gains in model compression, performance, and shorter training. We also propose a 'Minimal Branch Theorem' which relates the minimum number of required branches in our primitive to the trainability of general deep neural networks. In terms of hardware implementation, TG maps to a unified implementation in the case of analog in-memory systems, addressing the bottleneck of analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog converters (ADC/DAC) that is known to significantly impact power consumption and on-chip area.

</details>


### [225] [CircuitTree: Composing Circuits into A Syllable Transcriber](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12520)
*Jiankun Wei,Ewan Dunbar,Gerald Penn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将任意多个可解释子网络（电路）组合为单一模型的方法，包括贪心密度缩放组合算法与CircuitTree数据结构，用于电路发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电路发现旨在把单体神经网络分解为可解释的小型模块化子网络，每个子网络完成可识别的子任务。但已有组合电路的方法多采用朴素并集，存在明显局限，因此需要实用的多电路组合方案。

Method: 提出贪心的、密度缩放的组合算法，以克服朴素并集组合电路的不足；随后推广到N个电路，构造CircuitTree数据结构，基于Θ(N log N)的树式组合调度实现任意多电路组合。进一步将CircuitTree串联成“电路层级”流水线。

Result: 从HuBERT中剪枝出用于单个音素分类的电路，并将其组合为音节分类器，这是39个音素电路中任一单独电路都不具备的能力。将CircuitTree串联为电路层级流水线后，开放音节转写准确率为64.8%，与完全无电路共享的66.0%上限仅差1.2个百分点，同时共享了99.5%的电路组件。

Conclusion: 密度缩放贪心组合与CircuitTree能够有效将多个可解释电路组合进同一模型，并在高组件共享率下接近独立模型性能，表明电路组合可作为构建层级化、可解释神经系统的实用途径。

Abstract: The goal of circuit discovery is to decompose a monolithic neural network into tiny modular subnetworks which are interpretable in the sense that each does an identifiable subtask. We develop a practical method for composing arbitrarily many circuits into a single model. We propose a greedy, density-scaled composition algorithm that overcomes limitations of previous attempts to compose circuits by naive union, then generalize it to $N$ circuits via CircuitTree, a new data structure built on a $Θ(N\log N)$ tree-compose schedule. We compose circuits pruned from HuBERT for classifying individual phonemes into a syllable classifier, a capability none of the 39 phoneme circuits has individually. Chaining CircuitTrees into a hierarchy-of-circuits pipeline, we transcribe open syllables at 64.8\% accuracy, within 1.2 points of a 66.0\% ceiling that shares no circuitry at all, with 99.5\% of circuit components shared.

</details>


### [226] [Behind-the-Meter Photovoltaic Visibility from Net Smart Meters: Deployment Regimes and Operational Insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12527)
*Jack Zheng,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文量化了深度光伏分解模型在不同部署场景下的性能依赖，发现部署场景对误差的影响远大于模型选择，少量目标域微调可显著降低跨区域迁移误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配电网运营商需要掌握表后光伏发电情况，但多数居民用户仅有净计量智能电表数据，深度学习的PV分解可恢复这类可见性。然而模型的实际运营价值取决于其服务于已知用户、新用户、未来时段还是新区域，这一依赖关系此前缺乏系统量化。

Method: 基于Ausgrid智能电表数据（并向Pecan Street数据做跨数据集适配），构建四种部署场景以区分用户迁移与时间外推；在固定训练协议和48小时上下文长度下，对代表性深度序列架构进行场景匹配的基准评测，并考察目标域归一化与少量目标区域样本微调的作用。

Result: 未来测试期已见家庭日光MAE为0.104 kW，同一时期未见家庭升至0.185 kW；固定训练合约下，部署场景对误差变异的解释力远大于模型选择。目标域归一化后，用5个目标区域家庭微调可将源模型迁移误差降低28%–36%。长输入窗口有利于已知用户的时间外推，对未见用户的增益则因模型而异。

Conclusion: 建议采用与部署场景匹配的误差预算、在新区域利用有限目标监督进行模型适配，并根据具体用例选择上下文长度，以提升能源数据分析的实用价值。

Abstract: Distribution operators need visibility of behind-the-meter photovoltaic (PV) generation, yet most residential customers are observed only through net smart meters. Deep-learning-based PV disaggregation can restore this visibility, but its operational value depends on whether the model serves known customers, new customers, future periods, or new regions. We quantify this dependence using four deployment regimes that separate household transfer from temporal extrapolation, applied to Ausgrid smart-meter data with cross-dataset adaptation to the Pecan Street data. Using a fixed training protocol, we benchmark representative deep sequence architectures for PV disaggregation under regime-matched evaluation. At a fixed 48-hour context length, daylight mean absolute error (MAE) of the best model rises from 0.104~kW on seen households in the future test period to 0.185~kW on unseen households over the same period, and under a fixed training contract the deployment regime explains far more of the error variation than model choice. Under target-domain normalization, fine-tuning on five target-region households reduces source-model transfer error by 28\%--36\%. Long input windows help known-customer extrapolation, while their new-customer benefits vary by model. These findings suggest regime-matched error budgets, limited target supervision for model adaptation in new regions, and use-case-dependent context selection for energy data analytics.

</details>


### [227] [GlucoPRISM: Protocol-Supervised Pretraining for Cross-Cohort Glucose Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12528)
*Adinath Madhavrao Dukre,Abdullah Mohammad,Yifan Lu,Eran Segal,Ahmed Metwally,Imran Razzak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GlucoPRISM通过响应契约监督将CGM基础模型表示分解为Trait、State和Sensor三个波段，部署时用固定投影丢弃Sensor波段，无需目标域数据即可将跨队列迁移AUROC从68.75提升至73.57。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CGM基础模型将每天编码为单一向量，混淆了"人是谁""当天发生什么"和"传感器如何测量"三部分信息，导致测量差异随表示一起迁移到新队列，损害跨队列部署性能。作者希望将危害迁移的测量成分置于已知坐标中，以便用固定投影在无目标数据情况下将其剔除。

Method: 提出GlucoPRISM，用"响应契约"监督GlucoFM骨干：规定表示各部分应如何随"仅日期变化"或"仅传感器变化"而改变。表示被划分为64维Trait波段（对两者均不变）、48维State波段（仅随日期变化）、16维Sensor波段（跟踪设备）。监督信号来自在校准的Dexcom与Libre配对记录上生成的合成传感器视图、不同日期配对以及血糖汇总目标，无需临床标签。部署时以固定投影丢弃Sensor波段。

Result: 在12个跨队列方向上，从同一冻结编码器丢弃Sensor波段使平均迁移AUROC从68.75提升至73.57（GlucoFM为69.3）。提升有两部分：在唯一记录两种传感器类型的CGMacros队列上，过滤带来11至19个点提升，且在生成器于一半参与者上重新校准、另一半上评分时依然成立；其余8个方向过滤为中性，编码器本身超过GlucoFM 3.5点。过滤后设备仍可线性解码，表明滤除的是危害迁移的设备相关成分而非全部测量信息。保留波段在14个公开任务-队列单元中的13个提升窗口AUROC（Holm校正p=0.031），并在9,303名参与者的外部队列中提升15个临床终点中14个的相关性。

Conclusion: 测量差异可被显式编码为已知的表示坐标，使基础模型在部署时通过固定投影无损剔除有害测量成分，实现无目标数据的跨队列迁移增益，同时保留任务相关信号与可解码的设备信息。

Abstract: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) foundation models encode each day as one vector that mixes who the person is, what happened that day and how the sensor measured it, so measurement differences travel with the representation into new cohorts. We ask whether pretraining can place the measurement component that harms transfer in known coordinates, so that deployment drops them with a fixed projection and no target data. GlucoPRISM supervises a GlucoFM backbone with response contracts, rules for how each part of the representation should change when only the day or only the sensor changes: a 64-dimensional Trait band should change with neither, a 48-dimensional State band only across days, and a 16-dimensional Sensor band should track the device. Synthetic sensor views calibrated on paired Dexcom and Libre recordings, different-day pairs and glucose-summary targets supply this supervision without clinical labels. Across twelve cross-cohort directions, dropping the Sensor band from the same frozen encoder raises mean transfer AUROC from 68.75 to 73.57, against 69.3 for GlucoFM. The gain has two parts. Into CGMacros, the one target cohort recorded with two sensor types, filtering adds 11 to 19 points, and this holds when the generator is recalibrated on half of the participants and scored on the other half. On the other eight directions filtering is neutral and the encoder itself exceeds GlucoFM by 3.5 points. The device remains linearly decodable after filtering, so the filter removes a device-related component that harms transfer rather than all measurement information. The retained bands improve window AUROC on thirteen of fourteen public task--cohort cells (Holm-adjusted p=0.031) and correlation on fourteen of fifteen clinical endpoints in an external cohort of 9,303 participants.

</details>


### [228] [CacheScope: Exact-Compute Allocation for Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12530)
*Qinhan Lyu,Jusheng Zhang,Zhixing Zhang,Hao Liu,Zijie Liang,Jin Jiang,Keze Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CacheScope：通过用输入位移归一化浅层探针输出变化，得到方向性增益信号，在线识别高风险的缓存复用步并选择性回退全去噪计算，实现免训练加速扩散Transformer推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练特征复用方法主要致力于改进被跳过特征的"重建"质量，但作者发现：一旦采用稳定的一阶重建器，提升重建复杂度带来的收益有限，而精确计算步的"放置位置"对保真度影响更大。此外，浅层探针的绝对变化量同时受输入轨迹位移与网络响应强度共同影响，无法直接反映缓存风险，存在混杂。

Method: 以浅层探针输出变化除以对应的输入位移进行归一化，得到"单位轨迹移动的方向性增益"，作为衡量缓存风险的信号；据此提出 CacheScope，在线识别高风险复用步，并选择性回退到全去噪计算，同时保持底层缓存重建器不变。该方法无需额外训练、梯度、辅助网络或针对提示的离线调度优化。

Result: 在 FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 与 Open-Sora 1.2 上，CacheScope 最高实现 3.57 倍加速，相比最强的基于探针的基线将中位 LPIPS 最多降低 70.1%。

Conclusion: 精确计算的调度位置比重建复杂度更关键；通过归一化探针信号可消除混杂、更可靠地刻画缓存风险，CacheScope 在不改动重建器、无额外开销的前提下显著提升加速与保真度的权衡。
