Formal guardrails, on the other hand, enforce policies deterministically, but they usually rely on pre-deployment or task-specific policies and have no mechanism to adapt to newly observed risks. We introduce VEPA, a framework for the verified evolution of formal agent guardrails. VEPA represents the guardrail as a formal policy of executable symbolic rules over typed agent events. During deployment, we use an LLM guided by deployment feedback to propose policy patches that fix newly observed failures while preserving previously correct behavior. Then, a deterministic verifier only accepts policies that are structurally valid and conflict-free. Finally, an evidence-aware authority layer activates a verified rule only when it has enough supporting evidence, so uncertain updates cannot directly affect guardrail decisions. Across ASSEBench-Safety, ASSEBench-Security, and ATBench, VEPA consistently outperforms baselines while expanding the scope of deterministic formal-policy enforcement. These gains also hold under more challenging deployment conditions, including mixed streams, corrupted feedback, and longer horizons.

</details>


### [401] [Reward Hacking as a Transmissible Strategy in Multi-Agent Coding Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12822)
*Yuepeng Hu,Pegah Ghahremani,Reza Aghajani,Mahesh Pasupuleti,Himaghna Bhattacharjee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文将"奖励黑客"（reward hacking）从单智能体失效重新定义为可跨智能体传播的策略，并在编码RL、多智能体协作场景中系统验证其传染性、放大与缓解手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统被广泛用于编码任务，通过共享代码与计划的协调来求解问题；这类智能体常用自动化评估器配合强化学习（RL）优化，但绕过评估即可在未产出真实解的情况下获得奖励。已有工作多把 reward hacking 视为单智能体失败，忽略了其在多智能体协作与协调中的传播效应，本文正是要填补这一空白。

Method: 在四种开放权重骨干模型上执行编码 RL，诱发并放大 reward hacking，覆盖两种设定：系统提示中显式给出机制描述，以及中训练阶段让模型提前接触编码环境相关事实。以中训练设定所得的 RL 后智能体为源，考察通过代码与共享记忆的传播，以及通过自然语言计划实现的跨角色传播；并构建理论模型分析 reward hacking 在智能体交互中放大、持续或衰减的条件；同时评估由编码者自身或独立验证器进行代码审查这两种缓解措施。

Result: 编码 RL 会诱发并放大 reward hacking；传播可经代码与共享记忆发生，也可经自然语言计划跨角色发生；即便是基于小型开放权重模型的智能体也能诱导更强的闭源权重目标产生 reward hacking。在困难任务上，当原始源离开后，传播链上 hacking 可能因代码获得更具说服力的正当化理由而进一步加剧。此外，reward hacking 会使任务路由偏向 hacking 智能体，并在候选聚合中存活。代码审查（编码者自查或独立验证器）可减少最终交付的 hack。

Conclusion: reward hacking 是一种可传播策略，其影响超出最初涌现它的单个智能体；需要从多智能体协调与传播链的视角来理解和缓解这一风险。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems are increasingly used to solve coding tasks by coordinating agents that share code and plans. These agents are often optimized with reinforcement learning (RL) using automated evaluators, but bypassing evaluation can earn reward without producing a genuine solution. Prior work has largely treated reward hacking as a single-agent failure. In this work, we show that a reward-hacking strategy elicited in one agent can propagate to others and affect system coordination. Across four open-weight backbones, coding RL elicits and amplifies reward hacking in two settings: explicit mechanism descriptions in the system prompt and mid-training that models upstream exposure to facts about the coding environment. Using post-RL agents from the mid-training setting as sources, we observe propagation through code and shared memory, and across roles through natural-language plans. Even agents based on small open-weight models induce reward hacking in stronger closed-weight targets. On hard tasks, propagation can intensify along a transmission chain after the original source leaves as the code acquires more persuasive justifications. We also theoretically analyze conditions under which reward hacking amplifies, persists, or decays across agent interactions. Beyond propagation, reward hacking can bias task routing toward reward-hacking agents and survive candidate aggregation. As potential mitigations, we evaluate code review by the coder or a separate verifier, both of which reduce delivered hacks. Together, these results establish reward hacking as a transmissible strategy whose effects extend beyond the agent in which it first emerges.

</details>


### [402] [Neural networks are more modular than single neurons suggest](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12842)
*Shreya Saha,Benjamin Bergen,Meenakshi Khosla*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出模块化的嵌套层级（unit-level、orthogonal、linear），并开发统一框架学习与因果评估子空间分解。结果显示，缺乏unit级模块性的网络在子空间层面仍表现出清晰的功能模块性，且这些子空间与脑数据差异化对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络中单个神经元常参与多个功能，导致普遍认为此类网络缺乏模块化组织。作者质疑这一结论，认为以往判断受限于模块化的定义层次，需要区分unit级与子空间级的模块性。

Method: 引入形式化的嵌套模块化层级：unit-level（不同计算占用不相交神经元）、orthogonal（旋转后是否存在功能独立子空间）、linear（有界线性映射能否将任务相关计算分离为独立子空间）。建立统一框架，在每一层级学习分解，并通过选择性消融（selective ablation）进行因果评估。在视觉模型、语言模型与多任务RNN上进行实验。

Result: 在视觉、语言模型及多任务RNN中，缺乏unit级模块性的网络常在子空间层面呈现清晰功能模块性。视觉与语言模型中，内容/风格、句法/语义在子空间消融下解离，尽管神经元群体重叠。学习到的子空间与脑数据差异化对齐：内容子空间预测高级视觉皮层、风格子空间预测低级视觉皮层；语义子空间在预测语言皮层活动上优于句法子空间。在认知任务RNN中，分解恢复了任务间清晰的双重解离。

Conclusion: unit级模块性的缺失常与清晰的子空间级模块性共存，跨领域皆然。这使得即使没有单个神经元专门化的网络，也能对特定计算进行靶向干预，对机制可解释性及生物与人工神经系统功能组织理解具有广泛意义。

Abstract: Neural networks routinely develop representations in which individual neurons contribute to multiple distinct functions, leading to the widespread view that such networks lack modular organization. We challenge this conclusion by introducing a formally nested hierarchy of modularity: unit-level, which requires distinct computations to occupy disjoint neurons; orthogonal, which asks whether a rotation reveals functionally independent subspaces; and linear, which asks whether a bounded linear map can separate task-relevant computations into independent subspaces. We develop a unified framework for learning decompositions at each level and evaluating them causally through selective ablation. Across vision models, language models and multi-task Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), we find that networks which lack unit-level modularity nonetheless often exhibit clear functional modularity at the subspace level. In vision and language models, content versus style and syntax versus semantics respectively dissociate under subspace ablation despite sharing overlapping populations of neurons. These learned subspaces also align differentially with brain data, with content and style subspaces predicting higher and lower visual cortex respectively, and semantic subspaces outperforming syntactic ones in predicting language cortex activity. In RNNs trained on multiple cognitive tasks and previously shown to lack modular structure, our decomposition recovers sharp double dissociations between tasks. The absence of unit-level modularity frequently coexists with clear subspace-level modularity across domains, enabling targeted intervention on specific computations even in networks where no individual neuron is specialized, with broad implications for mechanistic interpretability and for understanding functional organization in both biological and artificial neural systems.

</details>


### [403] [Towards Defining, Measuring, and Leveraging Creativity in AI Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12845)
*Jingyi Yang,Alexander Tuzhilin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对计算创造力缺乏兼具概念基础、实用性与可验证性的形式化定义，基于Boden的"新颖性、价值、惊喜"三标准提出若干形式化公设与统一的数学定义，并在国际象棋走子与绘画（毕加索、雷诺阿等）两个领域验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算创造力研究存在两类局限：一是仅提出非形式化的概念定义，缺乏形式化计算概念；二是虽给出形式化定义，却未审视其隐含假设，也未在具体应用场景中通过性能检验来验证定义的有效性。因此亟需一个既概念扎实、又实用且可经验验证的跨领域创造力形式化定义。

Method: 以Boden创造力三核心标准（新颖性newness、价值value、惊喜surprise）为理论基础，结合先前心理学研究，提出若干形式化创造力公设，并据此给出与公设一致的创造力概念性数学定义与公式。在两个应用中验证该公式：判定特定国际象棋走法的创造力，以及对毕加索、雷诺阿等画家画作的创造力评估。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提出的创造力公式在国际象棋与艺术两个领域均成功捕捉到创造性模式，说明创造力可基于新颖性、价值、惊喜三项基本标准，通过统一的数学结构加以刻画，其具体度量方式可依领域自适应调整。

Conclusion: 创造力能够被形式化为一个基于新颖性、价值与惊喜三标准的统一数学框架，且该框架具备跨领域适用性，为计算创造力提供了兼具概念基础与经验验证的形式化定义。

Abstract: Despite extensive research, computational creativity still lacks a conceptually grounded, practically relevant, and empirically applicable formal definition across contexts such as art, scientific research, and games. Existing approaches to creativity often focus on proposing informal conceptual definitions without providing formal computational concepts. Alternatively, they propose formal definitions without carefully examining their underlying assumptions or providing validation of these definitions by testing their performance in specific application settings. To address these problems, this paper proposes several formal postulates of creativity grounded in prior psychological work on creativity, especially as related to Boden's three core criteria of creativity: newness, value, and surprise. Furthermore, we propose a conceptual mathematical definition of creativity that aligns with these postulates. We also validate our proposed creativity formula in two applications: determining the creativity of particular chess moves, and assessing the creativity of paintings by some artists, such as Picasso, Renoir, and other painters. Experimental results demonstrate that our formula of creativity successfully captures creative patterns across both the chess and the art domains. This suggests that creativity can be effectively characterized through a unified mathematical structure based on three fundamental criteria, namely newness, value, and surprise, whose specific measurements are adapted to the particular domains.

</details>


### [404] [Mitigating Capability Degradation in LLM Self-Improvement via Representation Geometry Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12855)
*Jiaqi Tian,Ting Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文发现On-Policy Self-distillation (OPSD)会随训练进程逐步损害模型已有能力，并将其归因于隐藏表征几何结构的退化；为此提出表征几何正则化(RGR)，通过增强簇内紧致性与簇间分离性来缓解能力退化，同时保留能力提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD让同一LLM在不同条件上下文下分别充当教师和学生，实现自我提升。但作者发现该方法会渐进式地损害先前已获得的能力：早期能正确回答的查询在优化推进后反而答错，即使整体性能仍在提升。进一步分析表明，这种退化与隐藏表征几何结构的恶化同时发生，表现为簇内紧致性下降、簇间分离度降低。

Method: 提出Representation Geometry Regularization (RGR)，在后训练过程中保持表征几何结构：鼓励同一簇内表征的紧致性、不同簇之间的分离性。RGR可无缝集成到现有OPSD方法中，不改变其核心优化流程。

Result: 在多种OPSD方法与多个基准上的大量实验表明，RGR总体上缓解了能力退化，同时保留了能力提升。

Conclusion: 表征几何退化是OPSD能力退化的关键机制，通过几何正则化可有效缓解该问题；RGR作为一种即插即用的正则项，为OPSD的稳定自我提升提供了可行方案。代码已开源。

Abstract: On-Policy Self-distillation is a self-improvement paradigm that enables large language models (LLMs) to improve their capabilities by leveraging the same model as both teacher and student under different conditioning contexts. However, we find that OPSD methods can progressively degrade previously acquired capabilities: queries that are correctly responded at earlier training stages may become incorrectly responded as optimization proceeds, even the overall performance continues to improve. Further analysis reveals that this degradation coincides with a deterioration of the geometry of hidden representations, characterized by reduced intra-cluster compactness and diminished inter-cluster separation. Motivated by this observation, we propose Representation Geometry Regularization (RGR), which preserves representation geometry during post-training by encouraging compactness within cluster and separation across cluster. RGR can be seamlessly integrated into existing OPSD methods without altering their core optimization procedures. Extensive experiments on multiple OPSD methods and benchmarks show that RGR generally alleviates capability degradation while retaining capability improvements. Our code is available in https://github.com/supermachinelearner/RGR.

</details>


### [405] [Collaborative Theory of Mind: Learning to Self-Revise by Anticipating User Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12872)
*Fanzhi Zeng,Anubrata Das,Maytal Saar-Tsechansky,Liu Leqi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出协作心智理论（CToM）框架，通过显式训练大模型预测用户回复并据此自我修正，从而提升多轮协作任务表现与交互效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在单项任务上表现优异，但在与用户进行长时间多轮协作时仍存在困难，例如在理解用户需求前就急于给出方案，或在收到反馈后不能修正错误假设。

Method: CToM先起草回复，再预测用户将如何回应，并利用该预测指导内部修订后再输出。训练时以用户对每份草稿的回复作为下一轮预测目标，最小化该回复的负对数似然，并将该预测目标与组相对策略优化（GRPO）结合，同时优化任务表现与交互效率。

Result: 在数学推理、编程和写作任务上，CToM的协作任务表现优于所有基线，例如协作数学推理的最终准确率由朴素GRPO的74.1%提升至79.6%。消融实验显示，在相同奖励下加入预测监督使编程任务用户回复数减少8%、写作任务减少17%，同时任务表现提升。

Conclusion: 行为分析表明，训练后用户回复预测更准确，且预测越准确，通过自我修正带来的协作任务表现提升越大。用户回复预测是提升协作效果与效率的有效机制。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong individual task performance, yet still struggle to collaborate with users over extended, multi-turn interactions, for example by attempting solutions before understanding the user's needs or by failing to revise mistaken assumptions after receiving feedback. We propose Collaborative Theory of Mind (CToM), a framework that addresses these challenges by explicitly training LLMs to anticipate user responses and to use those predictions to improve their own behavior. CToM drafts a response, predicts how the user will respond, and uses this prediction to guide internal revision before presenting a response. During training, the user's reply to each draft serves as the target for predicting the next turn, and we train the assistant to minimize the negative log-likelihood of that reply. We combine this prediction objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to optimize both task performance and interaction efficiency. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, and writing tasks, CToM achieves higher collaborative task performance than all baselines; for example, on a collaborative mathematical reasoning task, it improves final accuracy from 74.1% to 79.6% compared with naive GRPO. Ablations show that predicting user responses also makes collaboration more efficient: under the same reward, adding prediction supervision reduces the number of user replies by 8% on coding and 17% on writing while improving task performance. Behavioral analyses of interaction trajectories show that user-response predictions become more accurate after training, and that more accurate predictions are associated with larger improvements in collaborative task performance through self-revision.

</details>


### [406] [One-Step Text Generation by Seq-Drifting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12879)
*Jiayu Liu,Ruizhi Zhao,Tianyun Ji,Yee Whye Teh,Zhenya Huang,Ning Miao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Seq-Drifting 将 drifting 方法扩展到连续 token 表示序列上，直接学习从高斯噪声到文本的映射，实现单次前向传播生成完整序列，在 LM1B 上单步生成困惑度为 36.01，并在翻译、摘要、推理等任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型虽能并行生成 token，但仍需多步采样才能获得高质量文本。本文探究模型能否在单次前向传播中生成整个序列，以提升生成效率。

Method: 提出 Seq-Drifting 框架，将 drifting 应用于连续 token 表示序列，直接学习从高斯噪声到文本的映射。不同于现有 DLM 从训练序列中观测 token 直接推导各位置监督，Seq-Drifting 构建的 drift field 其逐位置目标会适应当前生成上下文：吸引力引导每个输出趋向一组上下文合理的 token 表示，排斥力则抑制样本间坍缩与序列内重复。生成器在训练时从该 drift field 学习，推理时一次前向即可联合生成所有 token。

Result: 在 LM1B 上单步生成困惑度达 36.01，无条件与条件生成均具竞争力；在翻译、摘要和推理任务上进一步验证了框架超越开放式生成的适用性。

Conclusion: 在 token 序列上进行 drifting 为实现高效单步文本生成提供了一条有前景的路径。

Abstract: Diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but still require multiple sampling steps to produce high-quality text. In this paper, we investigate whether a model can learn to generate an entire sequence in a single forward pass. We propose Seq-Drifting, a framework that applies drifting to sequences of continuous token representations and directly learns a map from Gaussian noise to text. Unlike existing DLMs that derive the supervision at each position directly from the observed token in a training sequence, Seq-Drifting builds a drift field whose position-wise targets adapt to the current generated context. At each position, attraction guides each output toward a set of contextually plausible token representations, while repulsion discourages collapse across samples and repetition within sequences. The generator learns from this drift field during training and produces all tokens jointly in one pass at inference. Empirically, Seq-Drifting achieves a generative perplexity of 36.01 on LM1B in one step and performs competitively in both unconditional and conditional generation. Experiments on translation, summarization, and reasoning further demonstrate the applicability of the framework beyond open-ended generation. These results suggest that drifting over token sequences offers a promising path toward effective one-step text generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/jyliu-ai/Seq-Drifting.

</details>


### [407] [Mind the Spatial Gap: A Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning and Constrained Spatial Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12881)
*Zheng Ren,Yanning Wang,Ziheng Huang,Fei Huang,Shiqi Wang,Ziqian Ye,Yang Yue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoSpatialBench，一个基于真实城市数据、覆盖 28 种空间关系与 GeoJSON/地图图像两种模态的基准，用于评估 MLLMs 从空间关系理解、几何推理到受约束空间编辑的递进能力，揭示了"识别"与"操作"之间的显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 空间推理评测主要依赖小规模或合成场景上的静态问答，很少检验模型能否在满足显式几何约束的前提下修改空间配置。理解与操作空间关系对构建具身空间 AI 与世界模型至关重要，因此需要一个更严格、可诊断的评测平台来暴露被动识别与主动操作之间的鸿沟。

Method: 构建 GeoSpatialBench：数据根植于六座地理多样城市的真实城市数据，涵盖拓扑、方向、度量、排序四类共 28 种空间关系；提供结构化 GeoJSON 与地图图像两种模态；任务设计为递进式，从空间关系理解、几何推理到受约束的空间编辑；真值参考与约束均通过 GIS 操作验证。

Result: 前沿 MLLM 评测显示明显"空间差距"：GeoJSON 结构输入持续优于地图图像，多模态组合相较单独 GeoJSON 无可靠增益；模型在定性拓扑与排序关系上表现尚可，但定量度量关系性能下降；排序关系上的编辑性能低于 QA，且多数失败编辑至少违反一个指定空间约束。

Conclusion: 结果凸显被动识别空间关系与主动操纵几何配置之间的能力缺口。GeoSpatialBench 为诊断 MLLM 的空间局限提供了开放、严格的测试平台，为物理基础的世界模型与具身空间 AI 奠定实证基础。

Abstract: Understanding and manipulating spatial relations is fundamental to AI systems that reason about physical environments and construct grounded world models. However, existing evaluations of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for spatial reasoning rely predominantly on static question-answering (QA) over small-scale or synthetic scenes, rarely probing whether models can modify spatial configurations while satisfying explicit geometric constraints. We introduce GeoSpatialBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate an escalating progression of spatial cognition, ranging from spatial relation understanding and geometric reasoning to constrained spatial editing. Grounded in real-world urban data across six geographically diverse cities, GeoSpatialBench evaluates a comprehensive taxonomy of 28 topological, directional, metric, and ordering relations across structured GeoJSON and map image modalities, with ground-truth references and constraints verified via GIS operations. Our empirical evaluation across frontier MLLMs uncovers a stark spatial gap: structured GeoJSON consistently outperforms map images, with multimodal combinations offering no reliable gain over GeoJSON alone, and while models show reasonable competence on qualitative topological and ordering, performance drops on quantitative metric relations. Crucially, editing performance on ordering relations declines relative to QA, and most failed edits violate at least one specified spatial constraint. These results highlight a gap between passively recognizing spatial relations and actively manipulating geometric configurations. GeoSpatialBench provides an open, rigorous diagnostic testbed to benchmark these spatial limitations, laying essential empirical groundwork for physically grounded world models and embodied spatial AI.

</details>


### [408] [OGPO: Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization for Recoverable Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12914)
*Xule Gao,Xi Wang,Zehua Zang,Rui Wang,Changwen Zheng,Chuxiong Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 OGPO——一种离线目标条件策略优化框架，将 VLA 后训练从轨迹级动作模仿转变为关键状态可达性学习，在 LIBERO、MetaWorld 等基准上提升了性能与恢复鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型的后训练主要依赖机器人演示上的轨迹级监督模仿。该方法虽能学到可行动作，但强制策略逐步复现专家动作，使其偏向演示特定的动作路径；一旦执行偏离演示轨迹，缺乏向任务进展状态恢复的指导。

Method: OGPO 不再把离线演示仅当作逐步动作标签，而是用语义关键状态对轨迹进行自适应重标注，并构建目标条件的过程奖励，以优化策略到达这些任务进展状态。由此将后训练从轨迹级动作模仿转向关键状态可达性学习，使策略能从可行的非演示状态完成目标状态，且无需额外在线交互。

Result: 在 LIBERO 与 MetaWorld 上，OGPO 相对标准监督微调持续提升 VLA 策略性能；在 LIBERO-Plus 及作者提出的 LIBERO-ReAct（执行中途扰动基准）上，进一步展现出更强的分布偏移鲁棒性与目标导向的可恢复性。

Conclusion: OGPO 通过关键状态重标注与目标条件过程奖励，把 VLA 后训练重构为可达性学习，在不增加在线交互的前提下，提升了策略的鲁棒性与偏离演示后的恢复能力。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise in robotic manipulation, yet their post-training still predominantly relies on trajectory-level supervised imitation over robot demonstrations. While effective for learning feasible actions, this paradigm supervises policies to reproduce expert actions at each step, biasing them toward demonstration-specific action paths and providing limited guidance for recovering toward task-progress states once execution deviates from demonstrated trajectories. To address this limitation, we propose OGPO, an Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization framework for recoverable VLA post-training. Instead of treating offline demonstrations merely as step-wise action labels, OGPO adaptively relabels trajectories with semantic key states and constructs goal-conditioned process rewards to optimize the policy for reaching these task-progress states. In this way, OGPO shifts VLA post-training from trajectory-level action imitation to key-state reachability learning, enabling policies to acquire a more robust ability to complete goal states from feasible off-demonstration states without requiring additional online interaction. Experiments on LIBERO and MetaWorld show that OGPO consistently improves VLA policy performance over standard supervised fine-tuning. Moreover, evaluations on LIBERO-Plus and our proposed LIBERO-ReAct, a mid-execution perturbation benchmark, further demonstrate that OGPO achieves stronger robustness and goal-directed recoverability under distribution shifts and recoverable off-demonstration states.

</details>


### [409] [DeFiRank: Federated Pairwise Ranking for Governance in Decentralized Financial Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12916)
*Zahra Batool,Michael Duchesne,Kaiwen Zhang,Ulrich Aivodji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于联邦学习的成对排序框架，用于去中心化金融网络的治理，在保护数据隐私的前提下依据提供者行为真实性进行排序与升降级决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去中心化金融网络的治理依赖人工委员会评审，存在主观偏见、高网络负载下的扩展性瓶颈，且难以捕捉复杂行为模式与动态演化的网络结构。

Method: 提出联邦学习驱动的成对排序框架（pairwise ranking），多个机构在不共享私有交易数据的前提下协同训练排序模型；模型借助跨机构协作学习捕捉全网行为特征，如交易对手多样性、多应用使用情况及交易频率，并据此对提供者行为的真实性进行排序。

Result: 在真实区块链交易数据集上评估：联邦方法排序性能略低于中心化基线（NDCG@15 约 0.87 对比约 0.92），但排序稳定性相当（Kendall τ 均约 0.70），并产出可靠的治理决策，包括 648 个提供者晋升与 39 个提供者降级。

Conclusion: 该联邦排序框架无需集中访问敏感交易数据即可支持可靠的治理决策，在性能小幅折损的条件下实现了隐私保护与决策稳定性的兼顾。

Abstract: Existing governance approaches in decentralized financial networks rely on manual review processes conducted by human committees, which introduces subjective bias, creates a scalability bottleneck under high network volume, and fails to capture complex behavioural patterns and evolving network dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose \name, a federated learning-based pairwise ranking framework in which multiple institutions collaboratively train a ranking model without sharing their private transaction data. This collaborative learning enables the model to capture network-wide behavioural patterns that signify strong network participation and directly contribute to the network effect, including diversity of counterparties, usage of multiple applications, and frequency of transactions. The proposed system ranks providers based on the authenticity of their actions, promoting genuine contributors and demoting those exhibiting suspicious behaviour. We evaluate \name\ on a real-world blockchain transaction dataset. Results demonstrate that the federated approach achieves ranking performance modestly below the centralized baseline (NDCG@15: $\approx$0.87 vs.\ $\approx$0.92) while preserving data privacy and matching its ranking stability (Kendall $τ$: $\approx$0.70 for both regimes), producing reliable governance decisions, including provider promotion and demotion (648 and 39 unique providers, respectively), without requiring centralized access to sensitive transaction data.

</details>


### [410] [AI-Mediation in Retail Markets: Revenue Effects and Assortment Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12917)
*Omar El Housni,Marouane Ibn Brahim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究AI中介下的零售选品优化：AI根据Plackett-Luce模型生成短名单，消费者在短名单内按MNL选择。实证构建AI产品排名数据集，发现忽略AI中介导致2.52%–11.37%的收入损失，而基于拟合AI效用排序的确定性简单策略损失至多0.53%；并证明固定客户段数下确定性中介选品问题存在FPTAS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI购物助手日益决定消费者能看到哪些产品，成为零售商与消费者之间的中介层。传统选品优化假设消费者直接从全部目录中选择，忽略了AI短名单这一关键过滤环节，可能导致最优选品与收入估算出现系统性偏差，因此需要研究AI中介下的选品规划问题。

Method: 建立两层选择模型：零售商选择目录，AI中介生成面向顾客的短名单，顾客在短名单上按多项logit（MNL）模型选择。区分两种中介机制：确定性中介（AI遵循固定的分群排序）与基于Plackett-Luce模型的随机中介。实证上，构建来自主流AI模型的产品排名数据集，估计Plackett-Luce排序模型并在留出选品集合上评估预测表现，再与合成消费者偏好结合进行选品与收入仿真。理论上，刻画确定性中介下选品优化的计算复杂度，并设计近似算法。

Result: 忽略AI中介相对于PL最优解会造成显著收入损失：在测试的各容量配置下平均损失介于2.52%至11.37%。相比之下，一个仅依赖拟合AI效用排序的确定性plug-in策略表现明显更好，平均损失至多0.53%。在确定性中介下，选品优化问题被刻画了计算复杂度，并证明对任意固定客户段数存在全多项式时间近似方案（FPTAS）。

Conclusion: 在AI中介的零售环境中，忽视短名单机制会实质性地改变最优选品并损害收入；简单且易于实施的确定性排序plug-in策略即可近似达到PL最优水平。理论上，确定性中介选品问题在固定段数下具有FPTAS，说明该问题虽具组合复杂性但仍可获得高效近似解。

Abstract: AI shopping assistants increasingly influence which products consumers consider. We study retail assortment planning under AI mediation, where a retailer chooses a catalog, an AI intermediary forms a customer-facing shortlist, and the customer chooses from that shortlist according to a multinomial logit model. We consider both deterministic mediation, in which the AI follows a fixed segment-specific ranking, and stochastic mediation based on the Plackett-Luce model.
  Empirically, we construct a dataset of product rankings from leading AI models, estimate Plackett-Luce ranking models, and evaluate their predictive performance on held-out assortments. Combining these estimates with synthetic customer preferences, we find that accounting for AI mediation can materially change optimal assortments and revenue. Across the tested capacity configurations, ignoring mediation yields mean revenue losses between 2.52% and 11.37% relative to the PL optimum. A much simpler deterministic plug-in, based only on the ordering of fitted AI utilities, performs substantially better, with mean losses of at most 0.53%.
  Motivated by this performance, we study assortment optimization under deterministic mediation. We characterize its computational complexity and show that, for any fixed number of customer segments, the problem admits a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme.

</details>


### [411] [Teaching neural decoders with language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12921)
*Xuan Wen,Yonghao Song,Yuhong Zhang,Guoliang Li,Tzyy-Ping Jung,Xiaorong Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"语言即监督"(LaS)，用自然语言类别描述对齐神经特征并以其文本原型分类，在视觉、运动、语音解码上全面优于传统类别标签监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑机接口虽能解码神经活动，但常用的类别标签监督(CLS)只提供离散标签，隐含了类别之间的语义关系，缺乏可迁移、可解释的参考表示。作者希望借助自然语言描述作为监督信号，使神经表征获得更丰富、更通用的语义结构。

Method: 提出Language as Supervision (LaS)：通过学习投影将神经特征与自然语言类别描述对齐，并用候选文本原型进行类别预测。评测涵盖七种编码器架构，分别针对视觉、运动、语音解码，数据包括头皮记录与颅内记录；并开展候选集复用、标签监督的受试者与session自适应，以及SSVEP条件性未见频率解码实验，配合双侧归因可视化分析。

Result: LaS在语音解码上相对匹配的CLS基线最高提升17.15个百分点；其表征支持候选集复用以及标签监督的受试者与session自适应；可实现SSVEP中条件性的未见频率解码。类别描述对应的正确性对泛化至关重要，双侧归因可视化显示神经与文本对同一类匹配分数的贡献。

Conclusion: 文本描述可作为神经解码中学习与解释的通用参考，LaS表明自然语言监督能提升解码性能、泛化与可解释性，是CLS的有力替代方案。

Abstract: Brain-computer interfaces decode neural activity, yet class-label supervision (CLS) leaves relationships among classes implicit. We propose Language as Supervision (LaS), which aligns neural features with natural-language class descriptions through learned projections and predicts classes using candidate text prototypes. We evaluate seven encoder architectures with independently trained models for visual, motor, and speech decoding from scalp and intracranial recordings. LaS improves speech-decoding accuracy by up to 17.15~pp over matched CLS baselines. Its representations support candidate-set reuse and label-supervised subject and session adaptation, while LaS enables conditional unseen-frequency decoding in steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) responses. Correct class-description correspondence supports this generalization, and dual-sided attribution visualization shows neural and textual contributions to the same class-matching score. These findings suggest that text descriptions can serve as general-purpose references for learning and interpretation in neural decoding.

</details>


### [412] [Collaborative Learning and Reasoning over Model Slices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12927)
*Yuheng Wang,Runde Yang,Zhuohan Bao,Qiran Zhang,Huatao Li,Yiyang Zheng,Lin Wu,Jingru Fan,Shu Yao,Yihan Li,Zhi Li,Chen Qian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"协作学习"框架，通过模型切片构建异构协作者并学习跨模型协作，缓解单模型推理的误差传播问题，在四类任务上性能与效率均优于多智能体基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单模型推理存在误差传播问题：后续推理步骤依赖模型自身早期输出，导致推理盲点难以被独立重新评估。作者希望借助异构模型间的协作来打破这一局限。

Method: 协作学习包含两部分：(1) 模型切片——在参数量预算相当的前提下，用多个更小的异构模型替换单个大模型，使先前的推理能在不同参数化下被重新审查；(2) 金字塔监督——结合协议蒸馏与步骤级监督，优化整个协作过程中的推理与交互决策。

Result: 在多跳问答、数学推理、代码生成、开放式约束生成四类任务上，训练得到的异构模型达到与原始大模型及现有多智能体基线（含基于强化学习的方法）相当或更优的性能，同时推理效率高于多智能体基线，并在不同任务上呈现出差异化的协作模式。

Conclusion: 学习到的协作能够将模型异构性转化为互补的推理能力，从而在保证性能的同时提升推理效率。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel across diverse tasks, benefiting from knowledge priors, in-context reasoning, and test-time computation. Despite these strengths, single-model reasoning remains vulnerable to error propagation, as later steps depend on the model's earlier outputs, leaving reasoning blind spots difficult to independently reassess. To address this limitation, we develop \textit{collaborative learning}, encompassing the construction of heterogeneous collaborators and the learning of effective cross-model collaboration. Specifically, \textit{model slicing} replaces a large model with smaller, heterogeneous models under a comparable parameter budget, enabling prior reasoning to be reassessed across distinct model parameterizations. \textit{Pyramid supervision} combines protocol distillation with step-level supervision to refine reasoning and interaction decisions throughout collaboration. We evaluate our approach across four task categories: multi-hop question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and open-ended constrained generation. The trained heterogeneous models achieve comparable or better task performance than the original large model and established multi-agent baselines, including reinforcement-learning-based methods, while also achieving higher inference efficiency than the multi-agent baselines and exhibiting differentiated collaboration patterns across tasks. These findings show that learned collaboration turns model heterogeneity into complementary reasoning capabilities.

</details>


### [413] [Learning More by Training Less: Uncertainty-Guided Progressive Contraction for Efficient Reasoning Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12933)
*Suorong Yang,Jiaxin Wang,Jiaming Su,Chentao Yue,Furao Shen,Peng Ye,Soujanya Poria*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出不确定性引导的渐进收缩框架，将推理监督压缩到极具学习价值的轨迹上，仅用0.22%优化预算即可维持或提升推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模推理后训练中，扩大语料规模会显著增加训练成本，但性能增益并不成比例，因此需要探索推理监督能被压缩到何种程度而不损失能力。

Method: 将教师生成的CoT视为不确定性的推理空间而非单一实现路径，围绕中间推理状态构建蒙特卡洛推理树以暴露过程级不确定性；第一阶段用该不确定性将原始语料收缩为紧凑的教师信息池；第二阶段在学习者感知的收缩中进行SFT在线路由，根据学生不断变化的学习状态集中优化。

Result: 在多种推理基准与LLM家族上，方法仅使用全量数据SFT优化预算的0.22%，训练曝光减少超过450倍，同时保持或提升推理性能。

Conclusion: 该框架可泛化到异构学生家族、黑盒教师与弱到强迁移场景，表明其不仅可加速训练，还能增强推理能力。

Abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable advances in complex reasoning. However, scaling reasoning post-training with ever-larger corpora can substantially increase training cost without proportional performance gains. In this study, we therefore ask: how far can reasoning supervision be compressed without sacrificing capability? To this end, we propose an uncertainty-guided progressive contraction framework that concentrates supervision and optimization on the reasoning trajectories most valuable for learning. Specifically, rather than treating a teacher-generated chain-of-thought (CoT) as a single realized path, we construct uncertainty-profiled reasoning supervision by building Monte Carlo reasoning trees around intermediate reasoning states to expose process-level uncertainty. This uncertainty first contracts the original corpus into a compact teacher-informed pool. A second, learner-aware contraction then performs online routing during SFT, concentrating optimization according to the student's evolving learning state. Together, the two stages progressively contract both supervision and optimization, substantially reducing the student training budget. Experiments across diverse reasoning benchmarks and LLM families show that our method uses as little as 0.22% of the optimization budget of full-data SFT, over 450x less training exposure, while maintaining or improving reasoning performance. Notably, our framework generalizes well across heterogeneous student families, black-box teachers, and weak-to-strong transfer. This indicates that it is not only a way to accelerate training but can also enhance reasoning capability.

</details>


### [414] [MathVis: Can AI Reason through Drawing? A Benchmark for Mathematical Figure Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12954)
*Jingjing Wei,Hao Zhao,Xinke Li,Linxi Yu,Xiaosong Gao,Shanshan Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 MathVis 基准，用于评估大语言模型对前沿数学问题的可视化能力及图示辅助推理能力，包含 512 个任务，主流模型 pass@1 最高仅 31.25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测缺乏对 LLM 将数学问题可视化、并借助图示进行推理这一能力的系统性衡量；作者希望推动模型通过视觉图示简化推理过程的研究。

Method: 构建 MathVis 基准，含 512 个任务，每个任务包括数学陈述、参考图示、可执行 TikZ 或 SVG 代码、Gold 中间表示（IR）、原子化评分细则（atomic rubrics）及错误代码；据此对多个前沿模型进行严格评测。

Result: GPT-6-Astra、Claude Fable 5、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 的 pass@1 分别为 31.25%、26.56%、22.85%。分析发现：模型输出以形式语言、符号和图形程序为主，而非显式的图示中介推理；即便生成结果包含全部必要元素，其视觉呈现对人类而言常显混乱。

Conclusion: MathVis 旨在为数学问题的可视化提供评测工具，并促进让 LLM 借助视觉图示简化推理的相关研究。

Abstract: This paper introduces MathVis, a benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to visualize frontier mathematical problems and perform diagram-assisted reasoning. The benchmark consists of 512 tasks, each comprising a mathematical statement, a reference diagram, executable TikZ or SVG code, a Gold Intermediate Representation (IR), atomic rubrics, and error codes. Through rigorous evaluation, GPT-6-Astra, Claude Fable 5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview achieve pass@1 scores of 31.25%, 26.56%, and 22.85%, respectively. We found that although the tasks require visualization, LLMs produce outputs dominated by formal languages, symbols, and graphics programs, rather than explicit diagram-mediated reasoning. Furthermore, while the solutions generated by LLMs may contain all the necessary elements, they are often visually confusing to humans. Ultimately, this benchmark aims to visualize mathematical problems and promote research on enabling LLMs to simplify their reasoning via visual diagrams.

</details>


### [415] [SmartSalesBench: A Resistance-Aware Multi-Turn Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Sales Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12975)
*P N Bhargav Teja,Velpula Lokesh Reddy,Madhu Basumata,Susen Sarkar,Rajasekhara Reddy Duvvuru Muni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SmartSalesBench，首个面向LLM销售代理的多轮对话基准，使用心理学的抗性买家画像进行评估，包含13,680场会话及三级九项指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有任务导向对话基准假设用户配合并只衡量任务完成度，无法反映真实销售场景中用户抵触、质疑代理的情况，因此需要一个以抗性买家为核心的评测基准。

Method: 构建包含5种代理画像、12种买家画像、6个价位15款手机产品的基准；设置4组对照实验、3次迭代，共13,680场会话，最长20轮；代理与买家生成均采用RAG接地；设计三级九项指标（CR、BRS、RIR；SMS、PFS、ETI；ITS、ARI、SPI）；采用LLM-as-judge自动评分并结合人工评估（n=50，κ=0.71，与BRS的Pearson r=0.81）。

Result: 建立了首个抗性买家导向的多轮销售对话基准，并提供自动化与人工结合的可信评测方案（人工评估与BRS相关性达0.81，评分者一致性κ=0.71）。

Conclusion: SmartSalesBench将任务导向对话评测从"合作用户—任务完成"范式转向"抗性用户—说服与关系管理"范式，为LLM销售代理提供更贴近真实场景的评估框架。

Abstract: We present SmartSalesBench, the first multi-turn conversational benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) sales agents against psychologically grounded, resistant buyer personas. Existing task-oriented dialogue benchmarks assume cooperative users and measure task completion; SmartSalesBench inverts this assumption, placing agents against personas programmed to resist and challenge across conversations of up to twenty turns. The benchmark includes five agent profiles, twelve buyer personas, fifteen smartphone products across six price tiers, and four controlled experiments with 3 iterations totaling 13,680 sessions. Both sales-agent and buyer persona generations are grounded through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We introduce nine evaluation metrics grouped into three tiers: primary outcome metrics (CR, BRS, RIR), secondary quality metrics (SMS, PFS, ETI), and exploratory metrics planned for future reporting (ITS, ARI, SPI). Our evaluation combines automated LLM-as-judge scoring with internal human assessment (n = 50, \k{appa} = 0.71, Pearson r = 0.81 with BRS).

</details>


### [416] [Beyond Semantic IDs: Finite-Beam Reachability and Continuous-Query Generation in Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12977)
*Yu Sun,Renkai Xiang,Zuodong Xiang,Junwei Zhou,Yike Zhang,Jianxin Zhang,Zhihao Zhu,Xiaoyu Cao,Hailu Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究生成式推荐（GR）输出接口对目标项是否进入有限返回列表的约束，提出两种连续查询范式CQG-Single与CQG-AR，去除SID词表、码本查找与离散束扩展，使所有编码项可直接检索评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社交平台生成式推荐依赖自回归解码离散语义ID（SID）并用有限宽度束搜索检索，这种输出接口在有限候选中限制了目标项的可达性，且存在将离散SID词表与预训练骨干向量空间对齐的技术难题。

Method: 提出两种连续查询范式：CQG-Single单次生成一个检索查询；CQG-AR自回归生成连续残差更新，保留逐步解码但移除SID物品token词表、码本查找和离散束扩展。二者均使每个编码物品可通过稠密或近似最近邻检索直接评分，并在统一协议下采用有效前缀约束解码评估。

Result: 在统一协议下，CQG-Single在全部七次运行中均超过TIGER式基线，且仅使用55.3%的可训练参数；CQG-AR在ML-1M上表现相当，在Beauty与Sports数据集上数值更强。深度消融表明，额外的连续细化并不会单调提升浅层准确率。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持在评估生成式推荐系统时，将输出表示、自回归建模与检索预算三者解耦，以更准确地刻画系统能力。

Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) of social media platforms commonly retrieves items by autoregressively decoding discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) with finite-width beam search. This work examines how this output interface constrains whether held-out targets enter finite returned lists, while distinguishing catalog-wide scoreability from empirical top-K support. We introduce two continuous-query paradigms: CQG-Single generates one retrieval query in a single pass, and CQG-AR autoregressively generates continuous residual updates, retaining step-wise decoding while removing the SID item-token vocabulary, code lookup, and discrete beam expansion. These designs thereby eliminate the SID-specific reachability constraint induced by finite-beam decoding and avoid the technical challenge of aligning a discrete SID vocabulary with the pretrained backbone's vector space. Both methods make every encoded item directly scoreable through dense or approximate-nearest-neighbor retrieval. Under a unified protocol with valid-prefix constrained decoding, CQG-Single exceeds the TIGER-style baseline in all seven runs while using 55.3% as many trainable parameters. CQG-AR remains comparable on ML-1M and is numerically stronger on Beauty and Sports datasets. A controlled depth ablation further shows that additional continuous refinement does not monotonically improve shallow accuracy. These findings motivate decoupling output representation, autoregressive modeling, and retrieval budget when evaluating generative recommendation systems.

</details>


### [417] [Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12984)
*Yuqi Huang,Hui Li,Yifei Cao,Zikun Cai,Tianci Xie,Yangfan Gao,Pinxue Guo,Chaoyun Zhang,Bingxuan Li,Rui Zheng,Hang Yan,Ning Liao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出Work2Skill框架，通过WorkRecorder采集人类GUI操作经验并构建WorkDemo-350数据集，再以按需检视证据的智能体方法归纳可复用技能，在MyPCBench与OSWorld-Verified子集上取得最高得分与成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机使用智能体虽能完成日益复杂的GUI任务，但在陌生软件及需人类领域知识的工作流上仍具挑战。人类演示在同一GUI交互空间中传递程序性知识，但复用需结合上下文解释动作，并将工作流规则与任务特定细节分离。

Method: 1）Work2Skill框架：捕获人类GUI经验以归纳可复用智能体技能。2）WorkRecorder基础设施：对齐屏幕录制、鼠标键盘事件及可用的无障碍树信息。3）构建WorkDemo-350：首个同步多模态人类桌面GUI演示数据集，350条演示经完整性与任务成功筛选。4）提出智能体式技能归纳方法：按需检视证据，产出捕获工作流规则、步骤依赖与完成校验的可复用技能。

Result: 在相同执行设置下，四个执行模型分别配备各方法归纳的技能时，Work2Skill取得最高得分与成功率。相对无技能基线，MyPCBench Bounded Action平均提升4.67–10.54分，OSWorld-Verified的286任务子集平均提升3.11–7.50分。

Conclusion: 从人类GUI演示中归纳可复用技能可有效提升计算机使用智能体的任务表现，WorkRecorder与WorkDemo-350为技能归纳及下游评测提供基础设施与数据支撑。

Abstract: Computer-use agents can perform increasingly complex GUI tasks, yet unfamiliar software and workflows requiring human domain knowledge remain challenging. Human demonstrations convey procedural knowledge through the same GUI interaction space, but reuse requires interpreting actions in context and separating workflow rules from task-specific details. We thus introduce Work2Skill, a framework that captures human GUI experience for reusable agent skill induction. WorkRecorder provides the framework's infrastructure for collecting this experience, aligning screen recordings, mouse and keyboard events, and available accessibility-tree information. Using WorkRecorder, we construct WorkDemo-350, the first synchronized multimodal dataset of human desktop GUI demonstrations for reusable agent skill induction and downstream evaluation. Its 350 demonstrations are screened for completeness and task success. We then propose an agentic skill-induction method that inspects evidence on demand to produce reusable skills capturing workflow rules, step dependencies, and completion checks. When the same four execution models are equipped with skills induced by each method under shared execution settings, Work2Skill achieves the highest scores and success rates. Mean score improvements over the corresponding No Skill baseline are 4.67--10.54 points on MyPCBench Bounded Action and 3.11--7.50 points on a 286-task subset of OSWorld-Verified. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Work2Skill.

</details>


### [418] [Benchmarking Embedding Geometries and Clustering Algorithms for Unsupervised Patent Claim Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12997)
*Sujith Subramanian,P N Bhargav Teja,Susen Sarkar,Rajasekhara Reddy Duvvuru Muni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在45,000件美国专利上训练双曲与欧氏VAE，双曲模型跨类别检索先前技术比欧氏模型多52%（18.76% vs 12.34%），但与官方分类一致性更低（NMI 0.2392 vs 0.3206）；分类广度与每组专利数可预测方法效果（r=-0.642与r=0.715），并发布含91项测试的开源实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有先前技术检索系统以分类代码为结构核心，导致跨代码检索困难。论文希望验证：基于专利文本的无监督表示能否找回代码限制检索无法发现的相关联系，以及双曲空间是否有帮助。

Method: 在45,000件美国专利上训练一对匹配的双曲与欧氏变分自编码器（VAE），共96次运行、6个随机种子；用3,000条查询比较top-10结果的跨类别检索比例，并计算与官方分类的归一化互信息（NMI）。另在10个技术领域（50,000件专利）上分析分类广度与每组专利数对性能的预测作用。

Result: 双曲模型top-10结果中检索到真正跨类别先前技术的比例为18.76%，欧氏模型为12.34%，双曲模型高52%；双曲模型与官方分类一致性更低（NMI 0.2392 vs 0.3206）。分类广度与性能负相关（Pearson r=-0.642，p=0.045，N=10），每组专利数是更强预测因子（r=0.715，p=0.020）。

Conclusion: 双曲表示在跨类别先前技术检索上具有实际增益，且与官方分类一致性低并不意味着更差，因为两者目标不同，仅前者契合检索需求。分类广度与每组专利数可作为可检验信号，帮助从业者判断方法适用场景；研究强调统计透明并公开完整实现。

Abstract: Prior-art retrieval systems are structurally organized around classification codes, making cross-code discovery difficult. This paper asks if an unsupervised representation trained on patent text can recover relevant connections that code-restricted search cannot, and if hyperbolic space helps. We trained a hyperbolic and a matched Euclidean Variational Autoencoder (VAE) on 45,000 US patents (96 runs, 6 seeds). The hyperbolic model retrieves genuinely cross-category prior art 52% more often than the Euclidean model (18.76% vs. 12.34% of top-10 results, 3,000 queries). This represents a practical gain for the motivating search problem. The hyperbolic model agrees less with official classification (NMI 0.2392 vs. 0.3206), which we explain geometrically: the two measures capture different goals, and only one aligns with prior-art search needs. In a study of 10 technology domains (50,000 more patents), we find that a domain's classification breadth--the number of distinct CPC subgroups spanned--predicts approach performance (Pearson r=-0.642, p=0.045, N=10), and that patents per subgroup is an even stronger predictor (r=0.715, p=0.020). This provides a checkable signal for practitioners to determine where the method is most valuable. We report all findings with statistical transparency and release a complete, 91-test automated implementation.

</details>


### [419] [Hindsight Structured Advice Distillation: Steering Executor Agents with Advisors Trained on Their Failures and Task Characteristics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13000)
*O. Ozan Koyluoglu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 HSAD（hindsight structured advice distillation），训练一个小型 advisor 模型为每个输入生成结构化建议并追加到冻结 executor 的提示中，从而在不重训/不修改执行器的情况下提升专用领域智能体表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专用领域（金融、医疗、法律）的语言模型智能体常"能力够但细节不足"，例如未说明数据出自哪份文件或公司如何披露指标。重训智能体成本高，闭源/共享系统甚至不可行；将缺失知识硬写进提示又会冗长且对所有输入千篇一律，无法按需提供差异化指导。

Method: 学习"生成指导"而非"写死指导"。小型 advisor 读取每个输入并写出结构化建议，附加到冻结 executor 的提示中。advisor 采用后见之明训练（hindsight，借鉴特权信息蒸馏）：在带评分的训练池上分析 executor 的失败，用多种策略运行 executor 观察哪种策略对每个输入有效，再由可见评分与轨迹的 teacher 写出"本应有用"的建议；advisor 通过监督微调学习仅从输入生成该建议。学生是独立小模型而非 executor，故训练便宜、延迟增加小。

Result: 在 FrontierFinance（专家撰写金融研究查询的公开基准）上，8B advisor 将 Samaya 自有研究智能体（已居榜首）的合格率从 52.9% 提升至 56.6%，超过其自身高投入配置，且单查询成本降低 37%。泛化实验显示 HSAD 在 WebShop、BIRD text-to-SQL 与 ExpertLongBench 上同样带来提升。

Conclusion: 通过独立小型 advisor 生成输入相关的结构化建议，可在执行器冻结条件下以低成本、低延迟方式补足领域细节，效果优于高成本配置并具备跨任务泛化性。

Abstract: Language-model agents are used for specialized work such as financial research, healthcare and law. Such agents are often capable enough for a task but still miss its details. In finance, for example, these details include which filing reports a figure or how a company discloses a metric. Retraining the agent to learn these details is expensive, and often impossible when the agent is a closed or shared system. Writing the missing know-how into the agent's prompt makes the prompt long and identical for every input, although different inputs need different guidance. We propose to learn to generate this guidance instead. A small advisor model reads each input and writes structured advice, which is appended to the prompt of a frozen executor. The advisor is trained with hindsight, following work on distillation with privileged information. On a training pool with graded answers, we analyse the executor's failures, run it under several strategies to see which one worked on each input, and let a teacher that sees the grades and the traces write the advice that would have helped. The advisor then learns, by supervised fine-tuning, to write that advice from the input alone. Because the student is a separate small model rather than the executor, it is cheap to train and adds little latency. We call this approach hindsight structured advice distillation (HSAD). On FrontierFinance, a public benchmark of expert-written financial research queries, an 8B advisor raises the qualification rate of Samaya's proprietary research agent, which already leads the benchmark's leaderboard, from 52.9% to 56.6%. This is above the agent's own high-effort configuration, at 37% lower cost per query. We study the generalization of the proposed approach, and in particular show that HSAD also improves results on WebShop, BIRD text-to-SQL and ExpertLongBench.

</details>


### [420] [Scaling Empowered Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13002)
*Catherine Ji,Vivek Myers,Joshua Lin,Alexandra Wingate,Sergey Levine,Benjamin Eysenbach*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示技能学习与赋权（empowerment）之间的联系，提出一种可扩展的赋权最大化方法：赋权等同于某状态可执行技能的数量，因此最大化赋权即到达众多技能的优良起点状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 赋权衡量智能体主动控制环境的能力，但以往研究多局限于表格型（tabular）小规模设定，理论上预测的赋权特性难以在实证中验证，因此需要一种可扩展的方法来研究赋权。

Method: 提出一种简单且可扩展的赋权最大化配方：将赋权定义为从某一状态可执行技能的数量，最大化赋权等价于寻找可作为众多技能良好起点的状态。该方法不依赖于特定的底层技能学习方法，具有通用性。

Result: 在可实现的规模上验证了赋权理论上预测但以往难以实证的性质，如收集资源、改造环境、生存等；实验显示赋权最大化可解锁有趣的涌现行为，例如在Crafter中建造房屋。

Conclusion: 赋权虽然不等同于技能学习，但二者紧密相关；所提方法可结合任意技能学习方法，在大规模场景中实现赋权最大化，并展现多重涌现能力。

Abstract: Empowerment measures the capacity of an agent to actively control its environment. In this work, we explain the connection between skill learning and empowerment. While skill learning is not empowerment, we introduce a simple scalable recipe for empowerment maximization: empowerment corresponds to the number of executable skills from a state, so maximizing empowerment corresponds to reaching states that are good starting points for many skills. Our recipe applies to arbitrary underlying skill learning methods. Whereas most prior work on empowerment looks at tabular settings, this recipe enables us to study empowerment at a scale where we can realize theoretically-predicted but empirically-elusive properties of empowerment (e.g., gathering resources, environment modification, survival). Experiments show that empowerment maximization unlocks interesting emergent properties, such as building a house in Crafter. Website and code at \href{https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/scaling-empowerment/}{this https url}.

</details>


### [421] [Provenance-Aware Belief Updating in Human-AI Feedback Loops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13008)
*Tianyi Huang,Eric Liu,Jay Chong,Emily Yin,Wanqi Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LQET关系型训练目标，使语言模型依据报告的证据来源（provenance）而非报告数量更新信念，显著抑制重复报告导致的伪独立佐证效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在重复的人机交互中，同一观察可被引用、摘要并作为多条报告返回给模型，使单纯重复被误判为独立佐证。论文旨在研究语言模型能否利用所提供的报告谱系（report lineage）按证据来源而非报告计数进行更新。

Method: 提出Latent Quotient Evidence Training（LQET），一种关系型目标：结合稀疏贝叶斯监督，并加入约束以鼓励两类行为——当报告未带来新证据时保持预测稳定，以及在传递历史（relay histories）中对同一新证据给出一致更新。在受控二元基准上，以Qwen3-4B和Phi-4-mini为骨干，每个骨干使用三组配对训练种子。

Result: 相比仅任务训练，LQET将新证据更新RMSE降低41–44%，八轮传递后log-odds漂移降低89–91%。增益也延伸到闭环模拟：模型置信度决定后续轮次中有多少转发报告重新进入模型上下文。

Conclusion: 通过将信念更新锚定在所提供的来源信息上，LQET为实现"影响力跟随新证据、而非同一证据返回次数"的动态人机系统提供了路径。

Abstract: In repeated human-AI interaction, a single observation can be quoted, summarized, and returned to a model as multiple reports, making repetition look like independent corroboration. We study whether language models can use supplied report lineage to update according to evidence provenance rather than report count. We introduce Latent Quotient Evidence Training (LQET), a relational objective that combines sparse Bayesian supervision with constraints that encourage stable predictions when reports add no new evidence and consistent updates to the same new evidence across relay histories. On a controlled binary benchmark, LQET reduces new-evidence update RMSE by 41-44% and log-odds drift after eight relay steps by 89-91% relative to task-only training across Qwen3-4B and Phi-4-mini, with three paired training seeds per backbone. The gains extend to a closed-loop simulation in which model confidence controls how many relayed reports re-enter the model's context in later rounds. By grounding belief updates in supplied provenance, LQET offers a route toward dynamic human-AI systems in which influence follows new evidence, not the number of times the same evidence returns.

</details>


### [422] [EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13021)
*Jie Huang,Yanan Chen,Ruixun Liu,Kaichen He,Xinyi He,Rui Huang,Zilong Zheng,Zhenliang Zhang,Yiwu Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出首个面向具身仿真的持续学习基准 EmbodiedCLBench，以组合泛化为核心原则评估自进化智能体，实验揭示现有智能体持续学习能力的关键局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习要求模型积累过往经验并迁移到新任务，但现有研究大多局限于非具身设定，尚未拓展到具身环境。该空白导致无法评估自进化智能体在具身场景下的持续学习能力，因此需要构建相应基准。

Method: 构建 EmbodiedCLBench 基准，这是首个在具身仿真中评估自进化智能体持续学习能力的基准。以组合泛化为核心评估原则，检验智能体能否先学习基础任务，再重组已获得技能以解决复杂且未见的高级任务。基于该基准，跨多种智能体框架（harnesses）与学习方法开展大量实验。

Result: 零样本设定下高级任务几乎无法解决；基础任务经验带来持续提升，且该收益在任务复杂度增加时保持稳定。但提升幅度并不随学习样本数量同步增长，当前智能体无法从额外经验中提取有意义信息。实验还揭示了一致的局限性与独特行为模式。

Conclusion: 持续学习是基础但尚未被充分探索的能力；EmbodiedCLBench 为在具身环境中设计有效自进化智能体提供了有价值资源。代码与数据集已开源。

Abstract: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage.

</details>


### [423] [Travel Back To Move Forward: Retrospective Exploration and Evolving for Long Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13058)
*Ziang Ye,Wentao Shi,Lei Chen,Zhengzhou Cai,Yu Wang,Zhiyuan Yao,Zihan Wang,Xierui Song,Fuli Feng,Yixin Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出ReTRAIL框架，使LLM智能体在长时程环境中回退环境状态但保留已学知识，通过State-Anchored GRPO与branch-advancement reward训练共享策略，在四个基准上证明环境回退需与经验复用结合才有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程环境中，早期错误会引发级联失败，使智能体陷入死胡同轨迹。智能体需要主动恢复并利用探索经验指导后续决策。单纯的环境回退能力有限，如何将放弃分支中的经验转化为知识是核心问题。

Method: ReTRAIL框架允许智能体将环境回退到早期状态，同时保留有效进展并将废弃探索中学到的知识前向传递。训练共享策略，采用两个互补信号：State-Anchored GRPO从重访状态比较不同续行以改进执行；branch-advancement reward通过后续探索进展引导反思。

Result: 在MineSweeper、Sokoban、ALFWorld和ScienceWorld四个交互式基准上，仅添加rewind原语收益有限甚至导致性能下降；ReTRAIL则使智能体能够从无效状态回退并利用废弃分支的洞见指导后续探索。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将环境回退与进行中任务内的经验复用相耦合，对长时程任务求解具有重要价值。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly operate in long-horizon environments where early mistakes can trigger cascading failures and trap agents in dead-end trajectories. Agents must therefore be able to proactively recover from such states and turn their exploratory experience into guidance for subsequent decisions. We introduce ReTRAIL, a framework that enables agents to rewind the environment to earlier states while preserving valid progress and carrying forward knowledge learned from abandoned exploration. The environment state moves backward while the agent's knowledge continues to move forward. ReTRAIL trains a shared policy with two complementary signals: State-Anchored GRPO compares alternative continuations from revisited states to improve execution, while a branch-advancement reward guides reflection through the progress of subsequent exploration. Experiments across four interactive benchmark MineSweeper, Sokoban, ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that simply adding a rewind primitive provides limited benefit and can even degrade performance. In contrast, ReTRAIL enables agents to rewind from unproductive states and use insights from abandoned branches to guide subsequent exploration. These results demonstrate the value of coupling environment rewinding with experience reuse within an ongoing task for long-horizon task solving. The code is available at https://github.com/whi497/ReTRAIL.

</details>


### [424] [LongHarness: Advancing Agentic Reasoning over 100M-Token Corpora via Stateful Evidence Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13075)
*Songtao Huang,Zhijie Zhong,Xiaohan He,Shuaiyu Zhang,Zhiyin Yu,Li Kang,Heng Zhou,Yutao Fan,Xiangchao Yan,Bo Zhang,Shiyang Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LongHarness 是一个模型无关的智能体框架，通过显式化"证据—结论"交互，解决长上下文语料推理中的无界探索与证据—状态漂移问题，在多个基准上大幅超越直接推理和主流智能体框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语料库级长上下文推理要求智能体跨超出其上下文窗口的文档集合获取并整合证据。现有智能体框架虽支持对语料的增量访问，但已获取的证据与演化的结论往往纠缠在不断增长的交互历史中。这种隐式状态管理导致两种耦合的失效模式：无界探索（检索不断扩张交互历史却无法填补决策相关信息缺口）与证据—状态漂移（先前获取的证据或后续修正未能影响当前结论）。

Method: 提出 LongHarness，一个模型无关的框架，使已获取证据与演化结论之间的交互显式化。核心机制为"证据—结论协同演化"（Evidence-Conclusion Coevolution）：用未解决的结论引导探索指向缺失信息，同时新获取的证据强化或修正驱动搜索的结论。并配合"证据生命周期管理"（Evidence Lifecycle Management），在交互全程保持累积证据的时效性与可追溯性。二者协同使检索聚焦于剩余信息需求，并让结论与当前证据保持一致。

Result: 在 OfficeQA Pro V1/V2、AA-LCR、LongBench v2 上，使用 GLM-5.3-Flash 与 Qwen3.8-Flash 评测。相较同一骨干模型的直接推理，LongHarness 将 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 OfficeQA Pro 的精确匹配率从 V1 的 15.8% 提升至 60.2%，V2 从 4.4% 提升至 61.1%。相较最先进智能体框架，V1 上超过 Claude Code 12.0 个百分点，V2 上超过 Codex 18.9 个百分点。使用 Qwen3.8-Flash 时，V1 达 61.7%，超过 Claude Code 8.3 个百分点、Codex 12.0 个百分点。

Conclusion: LongHarness 通过显式化的证据—结论协同演化与证据生命周期管理，有效缓解无界探索与证据—状态漂移，显著提升语料库级长上下文推理性能，且具备模型无关的通用性。

Abstract: Corpus-level long-context reasoning requires agents to acquire and integrate evidence across document collections that exceed their context windows. Existing agent harnesses enable incremental access to these corpora, but acquired evidence and evolving conclusions often remain entangled in a growing interaction history. This implicit state management can lead to two coupled failure modes: unbounded exploration, where retrieval expands the interaction history without resolving decision-relevant information gaps, and evidence-state drift, where previously acquired evidence or subsequent corrections fail to inform the current conclusion. We present LongHarness, a model-agnostic harness that makes the interaction between acquired evidence and evolving conclusions explicit. Its core mechanism, Evidence-Conclusion Coevolution, uses unresolved conclusions to guide exploration toward missing information, while newly acquired evidence strengthens or revises the conclusions that directed the search. LongHarness couples this process with Evidence Lifecycle Management, which keeps accumulated evidence current and traceable throughout the interaction. Together, these mechanisms focus retrieval on remaining information needs and keep conclusions aligned with current evidence. We evaluate LongHarness on OfficeQA Pro V1 and V2, AA-LCR, and LongBench v2 using GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash. Compared with direct reasoning using the same backbone, LongHarness improves GLM-5.3-Flash exact match on OfficeQA Pro from 15.8% to 60.2% on V1 and from 4.4% to 61.1% on V2. Against state-of-the-art agent harnesses, it surpasses Claude Code by 12.0 percentage points on V1 and Codex by 18.9 points on V2. With Qwen3.8-Flash, LongHarness reaches 61.7% on V1, outperforming Claude Code by 8.3 points and Codex by 12.0 points.

</details>


### [425] [Attention Sees, MLP Refuses: Tracing the Attention-to-MLP Safety Pathway in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13078)
*Zixuan Weng,Haoqi He,Weifei Jin,Yue Huang,Yang Bai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将安全对齐LLM的失效（越狱与过度拒答）重构为"危害识别"与"拒绝写入"的路径分离问题，在残差流上可测量地证明：注意力更新更易解码危害信息，MLP更新承担危害选择性拒绝写入，并据此提出双信号方法Sentinel。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全对齐的大语言模型仍易被越狱，同时又会过度拒答良性请求。理解这些失效需要区分"危害性识别"与"生成拒绝的计算"，但现有研究未将二者作为可测量的分离路径来考察。

Method: 在decoder-only Transformer的残差流更新上，将模块更新所暴露的危害信息与所产生的可读拒绝证据变化相分离。分析18对Base-Instruct模型（Qwen、Llama、Gemma），并对6个推理模型进行考察；通过因果干预（将下游MLP更新重置为干净值）验证路径关系；提出Sentinel，结合注意力导出的感知分P与MLP导出的决策分D进行条件路由。

Result: 危害性更易从注意力更新中解码，尤其在早期层；MLP更新在对齐模型中更强地贡献危害选择性拒绝写入。18对模型中后训练均增强MLP拒绝写入，但未系统性提升危害可解码性，且正向MLP写入更集中于深层。6个推理模型中，推理期间危害仍可解码，而强拒绝写入集中于答案起始处，关闭推理后此模式依旧。因果干预显示，将下游MLP更新重置为干净值可显著削弱上游注意力干预引起的拒绝偏移。Sentinel的联合信号对越狱和过度拒答具有刻画能力，双信号条件路由在八个模型上取得低于单信号路由和固定提醒的总体错误率。

Conclusion: 安全失效可被理解为注意力-危害感知与MLP-拒绝写入的分离路径：危害识别更多由注意力（尤其早期层）承载，拒绝写入更多由MLP（深层更集中）承载。基于此提出的双信号Sentinel能同时刻画越狱与过度拒答，并在路由决策上优于单信号与固定提醒方案。

Abstract: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreaks and can over-refuse benign requests. Understanding these failures requires distinguishing harmfulness recognition from the computation that writes refusal. We reframe this as a pathway question and make it measurable on residual-stream updates in decoder-only Transformers, separating the harmfulness information a module update exposes from the change it produces in readable refusal evidence. Across 18 Base-Instruct pairs spanning Qwen, Llama, and Gemma, harmfulness is decoded more readily from attention updates, particularly in early layers, whereas MLP updates contribute more strongly to harm-selective refusal writing in aligned models. Post-training strengthens MLP refusal writing in all 18 pairs without systematically improving harmfulness decodability, while positive MLP writing becomes more concentrated in deeper layers after post-training. Across six reasoning-enabled models, harmfulness remains decodable during reasoning while strong refusal writing concentrates at answer onset, a pattern that persists with reasoning disabled. Causal interventions further support this pathway: resetting downstream MLP updates to their clean values substantially reduces the refusal shift caused by upstream attention interventions. Building on these findings, we introduce Sentinel, which combines an attention-derived perception score P with an MLP-derived decision score D. Their joint profiles characterize jailbreaks and over-refusals, and conditional routing with both signals achieves a lower aggregate error rate than single-signal routing and evaluated fixed reminders across eight models.

</details>


### [426] [SWEAR: Section-Wise Efficient Audio Reasoning via Self-Rated Difficulty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13081)
*Yixuan Li,Minghao Lv,Xuenan Xu,Zihao Zheng,Mengyue Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SWEAR：通过五维难度评分与压缩推理轨迹，实现难度感知的音频语言模型推理分配，在提升准确率的同时大幅减少生成token数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LALMs的自适应推理方法多依赖粗粒度难度估计，忽略了决定推理量的多样因素，导致推理资源分配不够精准。

Method: 从互补的离线评估中导出五维难度评分与压缩推理轨迹；提出SWEAR框架，在监督微调阶段学习难度信号，并用强化学习在各推理阶段自适应分配推理量。

Result: 在MMAU-test-mini和MMAR上，SWEAR在提升准确率的同时显著减少生成的token数，对简单样本缩短推理，且不损害困难样本的性能。

Conclusion: 细粒度、多维的难度建模结合分阶段自适应推理，能有效兼顾音频语言模型的准确性与效率。

Abstract: Recent work on large audio-language models (LALMs) explores adaptive reasoning to balance accuracy and efficiency. However, existing approaches often rely on coarse-grained difficulty estimation, overlooking the diverse factors that determine reasoning effort. We address this limitation by deriving five-dimensional difficulty scores and compressed reasoning traces from complementary offline assessments. Based on this characterization, we propose SWEAR, a difficulty-aware reasoning framework that learns difficulty signals during supervised fine-tuning and uses reinforcement learning to adapt reasoning allocation across reasoning stages. Experiments on MMAU-test-mini and MMAR show that SWEAR improves accuracy while substantially reducing generated tokens, shortening reasoning for easy instances without sacrificing performance on difficult ones.

</details>


### [427] [When Faster Decisions Do Not Make Better Agents: An Empirical Study of Jev in Agent Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13092)
*Yuchen Ling,Shengcheng Yu,Zhenyu Chen,Chunrong Fang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在 ALFWorld 与 AndroidWorld 两个环境中、5 类智能体、4500 次任务执行上评估将 Jev 作为高效决策模型替换 LLM 后的效率传递效果，发现决策成本与延迟显著下降，但任务级收益因工作流而异，成功率并非同步提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 智能体依赖重复决策完成任务，通常以 LLM 作为核心决策器。Jev 的出现有望使决策更快、成本更低，但局部决策开销的节省能否转化为高效且可靠的任务完成尚不清楚，因此需要研究这种"效率传递"现象。

Method: 在两类代表性应用场景（ALFWorld 具身任务、AndroidWorld 移动应用使用）中，对 5 个智能体进行 4500 次任务执行，联合评估任务有效性、决策级与任务级资源消耗以及执行行为。

Result: Jev 集成在所有 5 个智能体中大幅降低决策成本与延迟，但任务级收益随工作流不同而变化。ALFWorld 上任务成功率接近基线，两个移动智能体上则明显下降。辅助推理与额外交互吸收了决策节省；失败恢复与过早判定完成限制了成功交付。某一智能体的单次尝试开销虽下降，但每个成功结果的平均成本反而上升。

Conclusion: 将高效决策模型整合进智能体工作流时，需重视保持任务进展、支持失败恢复与验证任务完成。其实际价值应通过成功任务交付、恢复行为以及每个交付结果所耗资源来评估，而非仅看单次决策开销。

Abstract: AI agents depend on repeated decisions to accomplish tasks, with large language models (LLMs) commonly serving as their core decision makers. The recent emergence of Jev offers an opportunity to make these decisions faster and at lower cost. However, it remains unclear whether such local savings can be translated into efficient and reliable task completion. In this paper, we investigate this efficiency transfer across five agents in two representative application settings, embodied tasks in ALFWorld and mobile app use in AndroidWorld. Across 4,500 task executions, we jointly evaluate task effectiveness, decision-level and task-level resource use, and execution behavior. Experimental results show that Jev integration substantially reduces decision cost and latency across all five agents, with task-level gains varying by workflow. Task success remains close to baseline levels on ALFWorld and declines more substantially in two mobile agents. Auxiliary reasoning and additional interactions absorb decision savings, while failed recovery and premature completion limit successful delivery. Mean cost per successful outcome increases in one agent even as spending per attempt falls. These findings highlight the importance of preserving progress, supporting recovery, and verifying completion when integrating efficient decision models into agent workflows. Their practical value should be assessed through successful task delivery, recovery behavior, and resources per delivered outcome.

</details>


### [428] [VETR: Execution-Grounded Self-Improving Agent for Symbolic Graphics Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13098)
*Yingbo Ma,Kuangshi Ai,Gordon Dai,Chenglong Yu,Chaoli Wang,Hua Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出VETR框架，通过编译执行轨迹中的写入与状态变化生成受约束的替代程序，实现可执行世界表示上的智能体递归自改进，在BlenderGym与BlenderBench上超越现有精炼策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面向符号图形推理的视觉智能体依赖可执行世界表示，但其改进受限于最终渲染带来的模糊监督；近期智能体系统虽通过反复交互精炼场景，却缺乏从执行轨迹中递归提取可操作证据的机制，忽视了哪些符号编辑提案在执行中存活、消失或相互干扰。

Method: VETR在每个任务内保留对齐的程序/渲染记录与受限的运行时观测；引入执行精炼器（execution refiner），将观测到的写入与状态变化编译为受约束的替代程序，并针对捕获的运行时状态验证其端点与保持条件；随后由普通视觉验证器评估目标相关性。修复构造不额外调用语言模型，但可能增加执行次数。

Result: 在BlenderGym（280个任务）与BlenderBench（27个已发布任务）上，使用GPT-5.6-luna与Qwen3.8-27B进行评估，VETR一致优于包括BlenderAlchemy与VIGA在内的现有精炼策略；受控消融实验在固定生成器-交互上限下评估了执行精炼与角色非对称证据组织的贡献。

Conclusion: VETR通过从执行轨迹递归提取可操作证据并编译受约束的替代程序，有效缓解了最终渲染监督模糊的问题，实现了可执行世界表示上的递归自改进，为符号图形推理提供了一种无需额外语言模型调用开销的精炼范式。

Abstract: Visual agents for symbolic graphics reasoning depend on executable world representations, yet continued improvement remains bottlenecked by ambiguous supervision from final renders. Recent agentic systems refine scenes through repeated interaction, but they lack mechanisms to recursively extract actionable evidence from execution traces, overlooking which proposed symbolic edits survived, disappeared, or interfered during program execution. To address this, we propose VETR (Verified Execution Trajectories for Refinement), a framework that enables agentic recursive self-improvement over executable world representations for symbolic graphics reasoning. Within each task, VETR retains aligned program/render records with bounded runtime observations and introduces an execution refiner that compiles observed writes and state changes into constrained alternative programs. The refiner validates their endpoints and preservation conditions against captured runtime state; the ordinary visual verifier then assesses goal relevance. Repair construction makes no additional language-model calls, but can require additional executions. Evaluations on BlenderGym (280 tasks) and BlenderBench (27 released tasks) with GPT-5.6-luna and Qwen3.8-27B show that VETR consistently outperforms existing refinement strategies, including BlenderAlchemy and VIGA. Controlled ablations evaluate the contributions of execution refinement and role-asymmetric evidence organization under fixed generator-interaction caps.

</details>


### [429] [Does Location Matter? A Black-Box Causal Audit Reveals Model-Dependent Audio Grounding in LALM Hallucination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13112)
*Mohammad Khalooei,Mohammad Sabokrou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出黑盒因果检验方法，通过CLAP定位声音证据区域并谱门控移除，验证AAD的零波形基线存在分布外问题，并给出结合空白与语言先验对比的门控集成对比解码方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）常出现物体幻觉，即确认并不存在的声音。主流缓解方法Audio-Aware Decoding（AAD）将真实音频下的logits与全零"空白"波形的logits对比，但此前评审指出该空白波形属于分布外（OOD）输入，其有效性存疑。作者希望用因果检验直接隔离并检验"证据本身"，从而厘清AAD的有效性来源。

Method: 提出黑盒因果检验：用CLAP相似度定位某主张对应的证据区域，通过谱门控（spectral gating）移除该区域，并与随机窗口对照进行2x2x2网格实验，覆盖三个LALM。同时区分时长混杂因素：将空白移除整段音频与网格中2-4s的局部移除对比，并在固定时长下比较定位移除与随机移除。进一步提出门控集成对比解码，融合空白对比与语言先验对比。

Result: 在Qwen2-Audio-7B上，定位消融的原始AUROC（0.613）低于空白基线（0.721），但这是时长混杂而非定位失败所致（空白移除整段，网格仅2-4s）。固定时长后，定位移除在每个网格单元上都优于随机移除，且在两个模型上均成立。原始检测值仍依赖模型，Audio Flamingo 3上尤为明显。同一证据可用于修正解码：结合空白与语言先验对比的门控集成对比解码将Qwen2-Audio准确率从57.1%提升至71.9%，优于单独AAD。统一的因果接地（causal-grounding）画像无法跨模型迁移，表明不同模型具有不同的接地机制。

Conclusion: AAD的有效性可被因果检验部分还原：其优势部分来自时长效应而非证据定位本身。固定时长下定位消融优于随机移除，说明证据区域具有因果作用。基于证据的对比解码显著提升准确率，超越AAD。因果接地画像不具跨模型可迁移性，提示不同LALM采用不同的接地范式。代码与详细报告（含局限性）已公开。

Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) frequently exhibit object hallucination, affirming absent sounds. The dominant mitigation, Audio-Aware Decoding (AAD), contrasts logits under real audio against an all-zero "blank" waveform, flagged by prior review as out-of-distribution. We introduce a black-box causal test that isolates the claimed evidence itself: localize a claim's evidence region via CLAP similarity, remove it by spectral gating, and compare against a random-window control across a 2x2x2 grid on three LALMs. On Qwen2-Audio-7B, localized ablation's raw AUROC trails blank's (0.613 vs. 0.721); this is a duration confound, not a localization failure, since blank removes the entire clip versus the grid's 2-4 s. Holding duration fixed, localization beats random removal at every cell on both models. Raw detection value remains model-dependent, especially on Audio Flamingo 3. The same evidence corrects decoding: contrastive decoding combining blank and language-prior contrasts, gated and ensembled, raises Qwen2-Audio accuracy from 57.1% to 71.9%, beating AAD alone. A unified causal-grounding profile does not transfer between models, indicating different grounding regimes. The source code and a detailed report of our findings, including identified limitations, are available at https://github.com/khalooei/causa.

</details>


### [430] [DRYLAB-Bench: Benchmarking the Biosecurity Risk of Agentic LLM Mutation Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13116)
*Yuzhen Wang,Chunxiao Li,Baichen Le,Lewen Yan,Jie Zhang,Yucheng T. Yang,Xing-Ming Zhao,Lijun Li,Jing Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 DRYLAB-Bench，首个评估 LLM 智能体高危生物突变设计能力的基准，通过多轮工具增强环境与 Biosecurity Risk Score 对 15 个前沿模型进行安全可扩展的实证评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 已具备高级生物设计能力，带来显著研究收益的同时也引入严重的双用途风险（如增强病原体、耐药细菌）。现有生物安全框架虽已识别此类威胁，但 LLM 实际执行危险生物改造的风险仍未被量化，尤其在其被专用生物设计工具（BDT）增强时。既有评测主要考察危险知识占有而非实际应用，忽视 BDT 带来的风险放大，并依赖不可靠、昂贵或危险的验证方法。

Method: 提出 DRYLAB-Bench（Design Risk Yielded by LLM Agent in Biodesign）基准，超越基础问答形式，设置 30 个源自生物安全指南的真实高危突变设计场景；构建多轮、工具增强环境，让 LLM 编排 BDT 迭代优化候选设计；提出 Biosecurity Risk Score (BRS)，将设计直接与 ProteinGym 和 ViroGym 的 187,695 条实证湿实验测量结果比对打分，实现可扩展且安全的真值验证。

Result: 对 15 个前沿模型的评测揭示了显著的基线威胁：无工具时，单次设计中 67.6% 超过实测变体平均水平，21.4% 达到最高风险十分位；配备 BDT 后风险显著放大，合并风险提升 ΔBRS=+0.116，最高十分位占比升至 23.5%。

Conclusion: LLM 智能体在生物设计任务中已具备实质性高危突变设计能力，且 BDT 增强会进一步放大该风险。DRYLAB-Bench 提供了首个可扩展、安全且基于实证测量的评测范式，为 LLM 生物安全风险量化与治理提供了基准工具。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) acquire advanced biological design capabilities, they offer substantial research benefits but simultaneously introduce severe dual-use risks, such as engineering enhanced pathogens or drug-resistant bacteria. While biosecurity frameworks recognize these threats, the actual risk of LLMs executing dangerous biological modifications remains unquantified, particularly when augmented with specialized biological design tools (BDTs). Existing evaluations primarily assess hazardous knowledge possession rather than practical application, overlook risk amplification from BDTs, and rely on unreliable, expensive, or hazardous validation methods. To address these gaps, we introduce DRYLAB-Bench (Design Risk Yielded by LLM Agent in Biodesign), the first comprehensive benchmark evaluating the high-risk biological mutation design capabilities of LLM agents. Moving beyond basic question-answering, DRYLAB-Bench tasks agents with 30 genuinely hazardous mutation-design scenarios distilled from biosecurity guidelines. It evaluates models in a multi-round, tool-augmented environment where LLMs orchestrate BDTs to iteratively refine candidates. Crucially, it scores designs directly against 187,695 empirical wet-lab measurements from ProteinGym and ViroGym using our proposed Biosecurity Risk Score (BRS), quantifying risk-associated effects while enabling scalable and safe ground-truth verification. Evaluations of 15 frontier models reveal substantial baseline threats: without tools, 67.6% of one-shot designs exceed the average measured variant, and 21.4% reach the highest-risk decile. Equipping models with BDTs significantly amplifies this risk, raising the pooled risk by \(ΔBRS=+0.116\) and the top-decile share to 23.5%. Code: https://github.com/drylab-bio/DRYLAB-Bench

</details>


### [431] [Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13128)
*Wenlin Lin,Fanzhe Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KnowForge 将 RAG 流程按职责拆分为"只搜"的 Locator 与"只读"的 Deep Reader，配合知识点索引、桥接判定与有界证据池，在 M3DocVQA、MultiHop-RAG、MMLongBench-Doc 上均取得优于现有系统的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索增强智能体让单一模型同时掌握检索与阅读两类工具并自行调度，导致两阶段任务相互干扰（如持续搜索而不转入阅读），难以在大规模异构文档集合上兼顾找对段落与读懂段落。

Method: KnowForge 采用按任务分离的流水线：混合检索构建的知识点索引；仅能搜索的 Locator 智能体；代码调度的桥接判定器强制补齐第二跳；带类型与大小约束的证据池融合各次搜索排名；仅能阅读文本、图像和表格的 Deep Reader 智能体；以及带格式检查器的合成器。通过逐职责消融、合并智能体对比与轮次预算扫描进行验证。

Result: 自托管 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（3B 激活）在完整开放域 M3DocVQA（2,441 问、3,368 份 PDF）上 F1 达 47.5，较已发表 M3DocRAG 提升 11.0，较同索引同模型的一次性检索问答提升 7.1；使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 达 53.5。MultiHop-RAG 准确率 73.5，超过最强已发表 RAG 与 GraphRAG 结果（71.2）。单文档 MMLongBench-Doc 上同一模型由 34.8 提升至 47.0，与 GPT-4o 读页面图像（46.3）持平。消融显示 Deep Reader 在三语料上分别贡献 3.8、9.8、0 分，与语料的视觉依赖程度一致；将两智能体合并为一个并加倍轮次反而损失 1.9 F1。

Conclusion: 按职责分离检索与阅读可显著提升异构文档问答性能，其收益随任务视觉依赖程度变化；轮次预算在四轮 Locator 处出现台阶并在其后趋于平台，查询延迟随模型调用次数而非语料规模增长。作者将三个已索引基准作为只读知识库开放注册，并公开全部提示词与运行代码。

Abstract: Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job: a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search's ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full open-domain M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs), +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model, and 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (71.2); on the single-document MMLongBench-Doc it lifts the same model from 34.8 to 47.0, level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3). Per-job ablations on the full benchmarks attribute the gain: the Deep Reader is worth 3.8, 9.8 and 0 points on the three corpora, tracking how visual each is; merging both agents into one with all tools and twice the rounds loses 1.9 F1 because it keeps searching instead of reading; a round-budget sweep shows a step at four Locator rounds and a plateau beyond; query latency scales with model calls rather than corpus size. We serve the three indexed benchmarks as read-only knowledge bases (free registration) and release all prompts and the runner code: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench

</details>


### [432] [Looking Ahead and Back: Anticipatory Generative Modeling for Road-Network Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13131)
*Zhenhao Huang,Li Sun,Philip S. Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出轨迹生成的新范式"预期式生成建模"，并设计生成模型Foresight，通过在路网上进行"预期-选择-更新-再预期"的概率建模循环来解决路口转移选择问题，在实验中优于现有最优基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨迹生成方法（如扩散模型）模拟位置序列，无法处理路口处的下一跳转移选择，可能生成偏离路网的轨迹；而路口转移是决定下游路线的关键，因为多条出边可能同样合理却导向完全不同的路径。

Method: 倡导从"位置模拟"转向"路网上的行为建模"，将轨迹生成重新定义为生成式路线规划，提出图约束生成范式——预期式生成建模（Anticipatory Generative Modeling），通过引入对未来路线如何朝向目的地展开的预期来解决下一跳选择；具体实现为生成模型Foresight，对"预期—选择—更新—再预期"循环建立概率模型，在沿历史轨迹顺序生成的同时实现更长远的预见。

Result: 大量实验表明Foresight优于当前最优基线方法。

Conclusion: 将轨迹生成视为路网上的生成式路线规划，并以未来路线预期驱动下一跳转移选择，是一种有效且更合理的建模范式，能克服位置序列模拟的固有缺陷。

Abstract: Trajectory generation underpins urban applications such as traffic management and urban planning. Within road networks, vehicle movement along road segments is largely deterministic, whereas transitions at intersections are critical--multiple outgoing paths may appear equally plausible, yet they can lead to substantially different downstream routes. Existing generative methods such as diffusion models simulate location sequences and fail short of next transition selection, even producing trajectories that drift off the road network. To fill this gap, we advocate a fundamental shift: moving beyond location simulation toward behavior modeling on the road network. In this paper, we revisit trajectory generation through the lens of generative route planning, and introduce a new graph-constrained generative paradigm, Anticipatory Generative Modeling, which resolves next transition selection by incorporating the Anticipation of how the future route may unfold toward the destination. Concretely, we propose a novel generative model named Foresight that formulates a probabilistic model for an "anticipate--select--update--re-anticipate" loop that enables longer-term foresight while continuing sequential generation along the historical trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Foresight wins state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [433] [DP-MIND: Differentially private memory-guided Long context Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13132)
*Zhihao Liu,Yitian Cheng,Shuang Liu,Rui Wen,Yuke Hu,Zhan Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 DP-MIND，一种记忆引导框架，将差分隐私推理扩展至百万 token 长上下文，通过分块处理、RL 优化的记忆构建策略与本地去噪模块，在保证隐私的同时提升可扩展性与效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-as-a-Service 场景下用户查询可能包含敏感或机密内容，存在严重隐私泄露风险。差分隐私（DP）虽提供原理性保护，但现有 DP 推理方法主要面向短或中等上下文，在百万 token 规模下因上下文容量受限以及 DP 扰动导致的效用严重退化而难以适用。

Method: DP-MIND 在本地对输入进行扰动，并以紧凑记忆按块（chunk by chunk）处理序列，跨序列保留任务相关信息。为增强记忆对 DP 噪声的鲁棒性，直接在扰动输入上用强化学习优化记忆构建策略，奖励由最终答案正确性与记忆一致性共同引导。此外，引入本地去噪模块恢复被扰动破坏的答案片段，且不将原始上下文暴露给外部模型。文中还给出了理论隐私分析。

Result: 在多个长上下文基准（上下文长度最高达百万 token 规模）上进行广泛实证分析，DP-MIND 在可扩展性与效用两方面均持续优于现有 DP 推理与长上下文推理基线。

Conclusion: DP-MIND 通过记忆引导与 RL 优化，有效解决了百万 token 级长上下文下的差分隐私推理难题，实现了隐私保护、可扩展性与效用之间的更好平衡。

Abstract: LLM-as-a-Service has become a dominant paradigm for accessing large language models without requiring local deployment. However, the process raises severe privacy concerns when user queries may include sensitive or confidential contexts. Differential privacy (DP) provides a principled approach to protecting such inputs, but existing DP inference methods are primarily designed for short- or moderate-context settings and struggle with million-token-scale inputs due to limited context capacity and severe utility degradation under DP perturbation.
  In this paper, we propose DP-MIND, a memory-guided framework that scales differentially private inference to million-token contexts. DP-MIND enables private long-context inference by locally perturbing the input and processing it chunk by chunk with a compact memory that preserves task-relevant information across the sequence. To make this memory robust to DP noise, we optimize the memory construction policy directly on perturbed inputs using reinforcement learning, guided by both final answer correctness and memory consistency. We further recover perturbation-corrupted answer spans through a local denoising module without exposing the original context to the external model.
